m400135.あなた、その内魔物討伐の遠征で\n海を渡る機会が来るんじゃない？: You'll soon have a chance to cross the sea on an expedition to hunt monsters, won't you?
m400135.さて、私の話は置いといて仕事の話をしましょう？\n実はあなたに折り入って依頼した: Now, let's set aside my story and get down to business. I have a favor to ask of you—don't worry, it'll benefit you too.
m400135.それこそ近海に棲む魔物とは、\n比べ物にならないくらいにね……。\n今や安全に航: They're a whole different level compared to the ones that linger near the coast… these days, safe sailing is a thing of the past.
m400135.それじゃ王子様？ 魔物たちを一網打尽に\nしてみせてちょうだい。\n『大討伐ミッ:
Well then, Prince? Show us you can wipe out all those monsters
for us.
The Great Hunt Mission begins.
m400135.それと、敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできないか:
Also, even if you defeat enemies you won't get any EXP, gold,
or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400135.それに、海の魔物に困っている人たちを\n救うことにも繋がる……でしょ？: Plus, it'll help the people plagued by sea monsters… right?
m400135.そ・こ・で、依頼の話に戻るのだけど。\n遠海の魔物たちは、昔の海賊たちの\n根城: Anyway, back to the request. Those distant sea monsters have taken up residence on an island that used to be a pirate stronghold.
m400135.たとえライフが０になってもクリアになるわ。\nその場合、それまでに倒した敵の数が: Even if your life gauge hits zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've taken down is recorded as your achievement.
m400135.でもね、海の魔物っていうのは陸地から\n離れるほど強さが増すのよ。: The thing is, sea monsters grow stronger the farther they are from land.
m400135.ふふっ……。良い子ね。\nじゃあ、作戦を説明するわね。:
Heh… good kid.
Alright, I'll explain the plan.
m400135.まず大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的よ。: First off, the only objective is to annihilate the foes.
m400135.今回の戦いは、敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』よ。: This battle is a “Grand Hunt Mission,” focused solely on defeating the enemy.
m400135.今回は出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないの。\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、ワ: This time, the deployment cost won't recover over time, so be sure to include someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or a Valkyrie in your squad.
m400135.伝説といっても、賞金目当ての奴らを来るたび\nなぎ払ってたら勝手にそんなふうに言: As for the “legend,” I earned that title by sweeping away anyone after they came looking for a bounty. Well, I haven't exactly brought anyone back alive…
m400135.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念するのね。: Don't fear getting hurt—focus on cutting down as many monsters as possible.
m400135.大討伐ミッションは、通常のミッションと\nいくつか違う点があるから\n注意したほ: Grand Hunt Missions differ from regular ones in a few key ways, so you'd be wise to take note.
m400135.悪くない取引だと思うのだけれど……。\nどう？ 受けてくれない？: Sounds like a fair deal to me… What do you say? Will you take it?
m400135.私があなたをその島へ案内するから、\n兵を率いて退治して来てくれない？: I'll guide you there—lead your troops and wipe them out, will you?
m400135.私のこの銃の腕があれば、離れた敵だろうが\n確実に仕留めて見せるわ。: With my gun skills, I can take down any foe, no matter how far away.
m400135.私の名はミネルバ。\n巷じゃ『伝説の海賊』なんて言われてる\n名の知れた海賊よ。:
My name is Minerva.
They call me the “legendary pirate” out on the streets—quite the famous pirate, indeed.
m400135.自軍の被害を抑えるより、\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかっていうのが\n重要ね。: It's less about minimizing your own losses and more about how many enemies you can slay.
m400135.遠海の魔物たちを一網打尽にできれば、\n遠征の足がかりにならないかしら。: If we can clear out those deep-sea beasts, it'll give us a foothold for the expedition.

m400206.……んにゃッ？\n手伝う！？ 一緒に来てくれるのか？\nホントーだな？ ウソはキ: …What? You'll help? You'll actually come with me? Really? I hate lies.
m400206.あ、忘れるところだったぞ……あのな、敵を倒しても\nEXPやゴールド、ドロップ品: Oh, I almost forgot… even if you defeat enemies, you won't get any EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind!
m400206.あれ？\nアタシ、なんでこんなこと喋ってるんだ？\nえーっと、もっと大事な何かを: Huh? Why am I saying all this? I feel like I was trying to tell you something more important…
m400206.うぅーッ！！ どうすればいいんだ！！\n考えたりするのはキライだぞ！ 今はとにか: Ugh!! What should we do!! I hate thinking about it! All we can do now is neutralize the beasts and restore the forest to peace!
m400206.うぶるるる……いっぱいの魔獣と戦うのかと思うと、\nなんだか身体がぶるぶるってな: Ugh… just thinking about fighting a ton of beasts makes my body all jittery.
m400206.そうだ！\n魔獣の森が大変なんだぞッ！\n森の魔獣達がとつぜん暴れだしたみたいな: That's it! The Beast Forest is in trouble! The beasts there have suddenly started rampaging.
m400206.それなのに、魔獣が暴れだしたっていうことは……、\nもしかしたら森の魔物使いに何: So if the beasts are rampaging, maybe something happened to the Beast Tamers… I'm worried.
m400206.だから、ライフが0になってもクリアになるんだぞ。: That means you can clear it even if your life gauge hits zero.
m400206.だから自分達の仲間の被害を抑えるよりも、\nどれだけたくさんの敵を倒せるかってい: So it's more about how many foes you can kill than protecting our own side.
m400206.だけどな、今回の戦いは出撃コストが時間経過で\nは回復しないから注意が必要なんだ: But be careful—this battle's deployment cost won't recover over time.
m400206.はぁ、なんだかしゃべりすぎて疲れたぞ……。\nもー説明はおしまいだぞ！: Hah, I'm exhausted from talking so much… That's all the briefing!
m400206.ほらー、はやく行こーよ？\nそうそう、アタシと一緒に\n魔獣たちを倒して森を静か: Come on, let's go already! Yeah, let's team up and wipe out those beasts to quiet the forest!
m400206.もしアンタがやられちゃっても、それまでに倒した敵の数も\nカウントされて戦果とし: Even if you get taken out, the number of enemies you've already defeated still counts toward your record, so just focus on slaying as many as you can!
m400206.やっっったぞーッ！\n噂どおりのいいヤツだな！\nよーし、そうと決まれば早速森へ: Yes! Just like the rumors said—you're a great guy! Alright, now that it's decided, let's head to the forest!
m400206.ん？ どんなヤツか、だって？\nんーとね、獣人で、狩猟が得意で、あとはなぁ……\: Huh? You want to know what I'm like? Well… I'm a beast-person, great at hunting, and… oh! I hate shoes, so I never wear them! Yeah!
m400206.アンタと一緒ならたくさん頑張れる気がするぞ！\n仲間たちとも協力して、一体でも多: I feel like I can really give it my all with you! Let's work with the others and take down as many enemies as possible. I can't wait to see who slays more!
m400206.人間なんか餌のひとつくらいにしか考えてないんだぞ。\nそれを森の魔物使いが大人し: Humans are nothing more than a snack to them. The Beast Tamers kept them calm, but now…
m400206.今回の戦いは、とにかく敵をたくさん倒すことを\n目的とした『大討伐ミッション』な: This battle's goal is simple: a “Grand Hunt Mission” where we just take down as many enemies as possible.
m400206.倒すことに夢中になって部隊をどんどん展開して\nいくと、戦況が急に変わったときに: If you keep throwing more units into the fray while chasing kills, you won't be able to place allies when the situation suddenly changes, so watch out for that.
m400206.大討伐ミッションていうのはだな、\n通常のミッションとはいくつか違う点が\nある: A Grand Hunt Mission differs from a normal mission in a few ways, so you'll want to be careful.
m400206.大討伐ミッションの最大の目的はだな、\nずばり『敵を撃破すること』なんだ！: The main objective of a Grand Hunt Mission is, plain and simple, “defeat the enemies.”
m400206.怖いのか……だって？ ち、ちがうぞ！\nこれはワクワクの前のゾクゾクだ！\n大事: Scared? N-no, that's not it! This is the thrill right before the excitement! It always feels like this before a big fight!
m400206.普段は魔物使いが森の魔獣たちをぜーんぶ管理して、\n悪さしないようにしてるんだ。: Normally the Beast Tamers keep all the forest beasts under control so they don't cause trouble.
m400206.最近じゃ、この近くの森にも魔獣がちらほら姿を\n見せるようになったし、もしかした: Lately even the nearby woods have started showing signs of beasts, maybe they're being controlled by them…
m400206.準備はいいか？ いいよな？\nよーし、それじゃあ\n『大討伐ミッション』の始まり: Ready? You are? All right, then… let the Grand Hunt Mission begin!
m400206.王子！ 一緒に森にきてくれよ！\nアタシ聞いたんだぞ！？\n王子はスゴく強くて、: Prince! Come with me to the forest! I heard it yourself—you're incredibly strong and kind to beast-people!
m400206.知ってるか？\n魔獣っていうのは、そもそも、とっても凶暴な獣たちなんだ。: Did you know? Beast-type monsters are originally extremely ferocious creatures.

m400231.そのため出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないので\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、: Therefore, deployment cost won't recover over time, so be sure to include someone with the ‘Call Reinforcements' skill or a Valkyrie in your sortie.
m400231.その手紙の内容によりますと、\nどうやら王子との再戦を望んでいるようですね……。:
According to the letter,
it seems he wants a rematch with you….
m400231.それでは、\nデシウスの元へと向かう前に、\nこれからの戦いの説明をさせていただ:
Then, before we head to Desius,
let me explain the upcoming battle.

Yes!
Then let's march out, Prince.
m400231.まず大討伐ミッションとは\n『敵を撃破すること』のみを目的とします。: First, the Grand Hunt Mission's sole objective is ‘to defeat enemies'.
m400231.また、今回は急な遠征となりますので、\nいつものような部隊展開はできません。: Also, this is a sudden expedition, so we can't deploy troops as usual.
m400231.もし自分の申し出を断るようなら、暗黒騎士の\n大軍勢で以て王城へ攻め込むとも書い: He also wrote that if you refuse his offer, he'll march a massive dark knight army against the royal castle.
m400231.わざわざ場所を指定するところをみるに、\nデシウスは王子打倒の為に周到な準備を\: Given that he even specified the place, we can be sure Desius is making thorough preparations to defeat you.
m400231.今回の戦いは、\n一人でも多くの敵を倒すことを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』: This fight will be a ‘Grand Hunt Mission', aiming to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400231.何度も王子に敗北してきたが、それでも諦めていないぞ、\nということが、かなりの字:
He's been defeated by you many times, yet he still hasn't given up—
that's written in a fairly long text with heavy strokes, but
since it doesn't seem that important, I'll skip the details.
m400231.場所は、地下洞窟……。: The location is the underground caves….
m400231.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありますのでご注意く: The Grand Hunt Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please take note.
m400231.実は先程、デシウスから王子宛に手紙が届いたのです。: Actually, a letter from Desius arrived for you just now.
m400231.更に、今回のミッションにおいては、\nライフが0になってもクリアとなり、それまで: Furthermore, in this mission, even if your life reaches zero you'll still clear it, and the number of enemies you've defeated will be recorded as your achievement.
m400231.王子……。\n何度も戦っている相手ではありますが、\nくれぐれも油断はしないでく:
Prince….
We've faced them many times,
but please don't let your guard down.

m400278.……と、こんなところか。では共に行こう、王子。\n世の希望として、まずは入り江に: ...That's all for now. Come with me, Prince. As the world's hope, let's restore peace to this cove first. Let's begin the Grand Annihilation Mission!
m400278.……ふむ。入り江の見取り図を確認するに、\n敵の侵攻が予想される箇所は複数存在す:
…Hmm. Looking at the cove's layout, there appear to be multiple points where enemy incursions are expected.
In other words, there are several defensive positions. Stay alert.
m400278.『大討伐ミッション』では1体でも多くの敵を倒す、\nそれだけが目的だ。: In a Grand Annihilation Mission, the goal is simply to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400278.『援軍要請』スキルを持つメンバーやワルキューレを\n編成に入れるのを忘れないよう:
Make sure to include members with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or Valkyries in your lineup.
…Heh, you might not need this briefing, but the basics are important.
m400278.お目に掛かれて光栄だ、王子。私の名はイブキ。\n私の国にまで武名が響いていた偉大:
It's an honor to meet you, Prince. My name is Ibuki.
To be asked for assistance by a great prince whose fame even reaches my own kingdom—truly the highest honor.
m400278.それから、船の移動に狭い足場。\n行軍にも部隊展開には不都合な戦場だ。\n時間経:
Also, the ship's movement is limited by narrow footing.
The terrain is inconvenient for marching or deploying troops.
The sortie cost won't recover over time, so keep that in mind.
m400278.たとえ拠点に攻め込まれライフが0となっても\nそれまでの討伐数を戦果としてクリア: Even if your base is overrun and your life reaches zero, the number of enemies you've slain counts toward victory. So don't fear getting wounded—focus on the kill count.
m400278.また、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品の獲得は期待できない。\n『大:
And even if you defeat enemies, you won't earn EXP, gold, or item drops.
Those are the main points for a Grand Annihilation Mission.
m400278.今は亡き祖国の名誉と誇りに懸けて、\nキミの協力要請に応えてみせよう。: In the name of my late homeland's honor and pride, I'll answer your call for aid.
m400278.優に100を超える魚人の群れ。普段よりも大規模な\n魚人との戦いを想定したキミは: Over a hundred fish-people, a massive herd. Anticipating a larger-than-usual battle, you've requested my support as a sailor for your naval operations.
m400278.報告によれば敵は群れて行動しているらしい。\n範囲攻撃が可能な人員が作戦成功の要:
Reports say the enemies move in groups.
Having units capable of area attacks might be the key to success.
m400278.我々が才幹を持ってキミの軍を支援させてもらうよ。\nさて、今回のミッション形式は: We'll lend our talents to support your army. This mission will be a “Grand Annihilation Mission,” with enemy extermination as the primary objective.
m400278.戦場の注意点としては、今回の戦場は珊瑚礁の入り江。\n敵は半魚人や魚人の群れ。龍:
As for the battlefield, this one is the coral reef cove.
The enemies are half-fish-people and swarms of fish-people. Dragon sightings have also been reported.
m400278.最後に、航海士が気にしていたんだが、\n魚人達が流木を運ぶ不穏な動きをしていたら: Finally, the navigator mentioned that the fish-people have been shuffling driftwood around in a shady manner. They might be plotting something.
m400278.状況の確認だが、キミの国にある入り江の一つ……\n珊瑚礁の入り江に魚人たちが集結: Let me confirm the situation: one of the coves in your country—the coral reef cove—is said to be swarming with fish-people. Apparently those fish-people are trying to summon a dragon.
m400278.私のような水兵は常から対魚人用の訓練を行っている。\n練度の高い水兵を取り立てれ:
Sailors like me are constantly trained for anti-fish-people combat.
If you recruit highly-trained sailors, they'll certainly prove useful.
Just keep that in mind when forming your squad.

m400317.……ふふっ、心配いらないわ。\nあなたは強硬派氏族の同盟者でしょう？\nそれじゃ: …Hehe, no need to worry. You're an ally of the hardline clan, right? Then, Prince, the “Great Extermination Mission” begins!
m400317.……雲の動きが怪しいわね。\n雲で月の光が遮られた『闇夜』では、\n吸血鬼達の動: …The clouds are moving oddly. When the clouds block the moonlight, creating a “dark night,” the vampires become even more active.
m400317.──え？ 同盟者として共に戦う？ ふふっ、\nありがたい申し出だけれど、本当に良: Huh? Fight alongside me as an ally? Heh, it's a generous offer, but are you sure you want to?
m400317.──お邪魔するわね。\n早急に、あなたに伝えたいことがあるの。: ──I'll be intruding. I have something urgent to tell you.
m400317.──ちょっと待って。もしそれが本当なら、\n公爵は神獣スフィンクスを\nヴァンパ: ──Hold on. If that's true, the duke must have turned the divine beast Sphinx into a vampire…?
m400317.『ヴァンパイア公爵』のことは覚えてる？\n──そう、私と王国が同盟を結ぶ契機とな: Do you remember the Vampire Duke? —the enemy that sparked our alliance with the kingdom, you could say. It's not exactly what I wanted, but…
m400317.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ兵士を\n出撃メンバーに編成しておいた方が良さそうよ。: It'd be wise to include a soldier with the “Request Reinforcements” skill in your deployment team.
m400317.あと、霧の魔物が移動している間は、\n遠くから姿を捉えることが難しいようだから、: Also, while the mist monster is moving, it's hard to spot from afar, so halting its legs will make it easier for the archers to engage.
m400317.あなたは人間を助けてあげて。\n私は公爵を探して……。: You rescue the humans. I'll go after the duke.
m400317.えっと、出発する前に、今回のミッションについて\nいくつか伝えておくことがあるわ: Before we set out, there are a few things I should tell you about this mission.
m400317.そうね……吸血鬼やアンデッドに対して\n効果的な能力を持った仲間を\n編成に加え: I think you should add allies with abilities effective against vampires and the undead to your formation.
m400317.その公爵が吸血鬼の軍勢を引き連れて、\n市街地への侵攻を始めたの。\n近くにいた: That duke has led his vampire army to begin an invasion of the city. Nearby units have set up a defensive line and are fighting back.
m400317.それと、吸血鬼化した魔物達の爪牙には\n麻痺毒があることを忘れないで。\n設置し: And don't forget the vampiric monsters' claws are coated with paralytic poison. Use the barricades you've set up to your advantage.
m400317.ちなみに、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品は手に入らないから気を付け: By the way, defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400317.とにかく気を付けて。\n他にも、霧の魔物に遭遇した兵士達は、\n身体の痺れを訴え: Anyway, stay on guard. Soldiers who've run into the mist monster are complaining of numbness in their bodies.
m400317.もし、ライフが0になってもクリアよ。\nそれまでに倒した敵の数は全てカウントされ: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission still clears. All the enemies you've slain will be counted toward your record, so don't worry.
m400317.公爵のやつ、襲ってきたタイミングといい、\n今日のために周到な計画を立ててきたよ: The duke timed his attack perfectly and seems to have planned everything for today. Make sure you don't neglect your preparations.
m400317.兵士の話を聞くに、前にも同様のことがあったみたいね？\n吸血鬼狩人たちが周辺を監: From what the soldiers say, something similar happened before, right? The vampire hunters were monitoring the area… but the duke was a step ahead.
m400317.報告では、スフィンクスの形状をした\n霧の魔物が目撃されたみたい。: Reports say a mist monster shaped like a sphinx has been sighted.
m400317.大討伐ミッションでは通常のミッションと違って、\nより多くの敵を倒すことを重視し: In a Grand Hunt mission, unlike normal ones, the focus is on defeating as many enemies as possible.
m400317.急な侵攻に対する出撃だから、\n出撃コストの回復には期待できないわね……。: Since this is a sudden-strike sortie, don't expect the deployment cost to recover quickly…
m400317.数えきれないぐらいの吸血鬼の数だもの。\n『多くの敵を撃破すること』を目的にして: There are countless vampires. The goal is simply “defeat a large number of enemies,” so we just need to thin their ranks.
m400317.闇夜に紛れた襲撃で、逃げ遅れた人間たちも大勢いるわ。\n兵士達がバリケードを設置: There are many humans who were caught off-guard by a night-cloaked assault. The troops are putting up barricades to buy time, but if this keeps up, the city will fall sooner or later.

m400439.――よし、じゃあ教えてやろうか。\nまずあの辺りの海岸だが、海流の影響で、\n満: — All right, then I'll tell you. First, that stretch of coastline is subject to extremely strong tides because of the currents.
m400439.おっと、それから出撃コストも時間経過じゃ回復しない。\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持: Oh, and the deployment cost won't recover over time. You might want to bring someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or take the Valkyries with you.
m400439.お前も俺が見込んだ男なら、\n傷つくことを恐れず、\nとにかく魔物をぶっ倒してや: If you're the man I think you are, don't fear getting hurt—just go out there and smash those monsters.
m400439.さぁて、それじゃあ戦場に行こうか王子。\n『大討伐ミッション』開始だぜ？: Well then, let's head to the battlefield, Prince. The Grand Annihilation Mission begins!
m400439.さっきまで陸地だった場所が\n今は海に沈んでる、なんてよくあることさ。: Places that were land just a moment ago are now submerged—nothing unusual.
m400439.さて、さっそくだが本題と行こうか。\n――漁村で頻発してる、魔物の襲撃は知ってる: Now then, let's get straight to the point. — Have you heard about the frequent monster raids on the fishing village?
m400439.それからこいつは、あくまで海賊連中の噂話だが、\n海から這い出てくる魔物ども、ど: And this is just rumor among us pirates, but the monsters that crawl out of the sea don't seem to be landing on pure instinct.
m400439.それから何だっけか、ライフが０になってもクリア、\nそれまでに倒した数がカウント: And remember, even if your life hits zero you still clear the mission; the number of monsters you've slain is tallied and recorded as your achievement.
m400439.だがちょっと待ちな。\n海賊ならではの情報ってやつを、\nこうして持ってきてやっ: But hold on a second. I brought you some pirate-style intel, after all.
m400439.ははっ、さすがは王子だな。\nもう魔物討伐の準備まで整えているとは。: Ha, just as I expected of you, Prince. You've already got the monster-hunting preparations ready.
m400439.まさかとは思うが、\n魔王軍が暗躍している可能性もあるだろ？\n注意しておくに越: It sounds unlikely, but there's a chance the Demon King's army is pulling the strings behind the scenes. We'd be wise to stay on guard.
m400439.よぉ王子。遅かったじゃないか。\nほら、軍議の時間だぜ？: Hey, Prince. You're late. Come on, it's time for the council meeting.
m400439.よし、じゃあ改めて出撃準備だな。\n今回の戦いは『大討伐ミッション』って形になる: All right, time to gear up again. I heard from Katie that this battle will be a “Grand Annihilation Mission.”
m400439.沈まない岩場もあるはずだが、\n兵の配置には気をつけることだ。: There should still be some rocky outcrops that stay above water, so be careful where you position your troops.
m400439.漁村の連中が腕利きの傭兵を雇って、\n魔物を討伐してもらおうとしたんだが、\n統: The villagers hired some top-notch mercenaries to take care of the beasts, but they were completely overwhelmed by the well-coordinated monster hordes.
m400439.漁村の連中の平和を守るのが最優先だからな、\nとにかく『多くの敵を撃破すること』: Protecting the villagers is our top priority, so crushing as many enemies as possible is key.
m400439.ＥＸＰやゴールドも手に入らないが、\n――ハハッ、別に俺達が奪ってるわけじゃない: You won't earn any EXP or gold… — Ha, it's not like we're stealing it anyway. I'd never chase after petty loot.

m400447.……ふふっ、心配いらないわ。\nあなたは強硬派氏族の同盟者でしょう？\nそれじゃ: …Hehe, no need to worry. You're an ally of the hardline clan, right? Then, Prince, let the “Great Extermination Mission” begin!
m400447.……雲の動きが怪しいわね。\n雲で月の光が遮られた『闇夜』では、\n吸血鬼達の動: …The clouds are moving oddly. In a “dark night” when clouds block the moonlight, the vampires become even more active, you know?
m400447.──え？ 同盟者として共に戦う？ ふふっ、\nありがたい申し出だけれど、本当に良: ──Huh? Fight alongside us as an ally? Heh, it's a generous offer, but are you sure you want to?
m400447.──お邪魔するわね。\n早急に、あなたに伝えたいことがあるの。: ──I'll be intruding. I have something urgent to tell you.
m400447.──ちょっと待って。もしそれが本当なら、\n公爵は神獣スフィンクスを\nヴァンパ: Hold on a sec. If that's true, then the duke turned the divine beast Sphinx into a vampire…?
m400447.『ヴァンパイア公爵』のことは覚えてる？\n──そう、私と王国が同盟を結ぶ契機とな: Do you remember the "Vampire Duke"? —the enemy that sparked our alliance with the kingdom, you could say. It's not exactly my favorite, but…
m400447.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ兵士を\n出撃メンバーに編成しておいた方が良さそうよ。: It'd be wise to include a soldier with the "Request Reinforcements" skill in your deployment.
m400447.あと、霧の魔物が移動している間は、\n遠くから姿を捉えることが難しいようだから、: And while the mist monster is moving, it's hard to spot it from a distance, so stopping its feet will make it easier for the archers to fight.
m400447.あなたは人間を助けてあげて。\n私は公爵を探して……。: You should rescue the humans. I'll go after the duke…
m400447.えっと、出発する前に、今回のミッションについて\nいくつか伝えておくことがあるわ: Before we set out, there are a few things I need to brief you on about this mission.
m400447.そうね……吸血鬼やアンデッドに対して\n効果的な能力を持った仲間を\n編成に加え: I'd suggest adding allies with abilities effective against vampires and the undead to your lineup.
m400447.その公爵が吸血鬼の軍勢を引き連れて、\n市街地への侵攻を始めたの。\n近くにいた: That duke has led a horde of vampires in an invasion of the city. Nearby troops have set up a defensive line and are fighting back.
m400447.それと、吸血鬼化した魔物達の爪牙には\n麻痺毒があることを忘れないで。\n設置し: And don't forget, the claws and fangs of the vampiric monsters are coated with a paralyzing toxin. Use the barricades you've set up to your advantage.
m400447.ちなみに、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品は手に入らないから気を付け: By the way, defeating enemies won't grant you EXP, gold, or any drops, so keep that in mind.
m400447.とにかく気を付けて。\n他にも、霧の魔物に遭遇した兵士達は、\n身体の痺れを訴え: Anyway, stay on guard. Also, soldiers who've encountered the mist monster are complaining of numbness in their bodies.
m400447.もし、ライフが0になってもクリアよ。\nそれまでに倒した敵の数は全てカウントされ: Even if your life drops to zero, the mission still counts as cleared. All the enemies you defeat before that are tallied and recorded as your achievement, so don't worry.
m400447.公爵のやつ、襲ってきたタイミングといい、\n今日のために周到な計画を立ててきたよ: The duke timed his attack perfectly and seems to have planned everything for today. Make sure you don't neglect your own preparations.
m400447.兵士の話を聞くに、前にも同様のことがあったみたいね？\n吸血鬼狩人たちが周辺を監: From the soldiers' reports, it seems something similar happened before. The vampire hunters were monitoring the area, but the duke was one step ahead.
m400447.報告では、スフィンクスの形状をした\n霧の魔物が目撃されたみたい。: Reports say a mist monster shaped like a sphinx has been sighted.
m400447.大討伐ミッションでは通常のミッションと違って、\nより多くの敵を倒すことを重視し: Unlike a normal quest, a Grand Hunt mission places extra emphasis on slaying as many enemies as possible.
m400447.急な侵攻に対する出撃だから、\n出撃コストの回復には期待できないわね……。: Since this is a sudden-response sortie, you can't expect any recovery of sortie costs…
m400447.数えきれないぐらいの吸血鬼の数だもの。\n『多くの敵を撃破すること』を目的にして: There are countless vampires out there. The goal is simply "defeat as many enemies as you can," so just focus on thinning their numbers.
m400447.闇夜に紛れた襲撃で、逃げ遅れた人間たちも大勢いるわ。\n兵士達がバリケードを設置: There are many humans who missed the chance to escape in the night-time raid. The soldiers are putting up barricades to buy time, but if this keeps up the city will fall soon enough.

m400470.――まさか、ハロウィンパーティの会場を、\nそのまま迎撃拠点に流用することになる: ――I never imagined we'd have to turn the Halloween party venue straight into a defensive base… and that it would be a crisis threatening the very existence of the world.
m400470.『先行偵察ビーコンによる現地調査を開始する』: "Initiating local survey via forward reconnaissance beacon."
m400470.『情報体の転送と再構築の所要時間を計測中──』: "Measuring the time required for data transfer and reconstruction—"
m400470.『次元間航行に不明なエラーを確認。\n目標地点到達までの時刻を下方修正──』: "Detected an unknown error in interdimensional navigation. Adjusting arrival time downward—"
m400470.いいえ、あれはホロウクルスの幻影。\n莫大な情報量を保有する彼奴は、\n次元間の: No, that's just an illusion of the Holloculus. That creature, which holds an enormous amount of data, still needs time to travel between dimensions.
m400470.いいえ、それだけではありません。\n取り込んだ現地生命体に自身の情報を上書きし、: T.O.W.E.R.: No, that's not all. It can also overwrite the data of native lifeforms it assimilates, bringing them under its control.
m400470.おそらくは皆さまの世界の情報を吸収し、\n学習したものかと思われます。\n今回の: It's probably absorbed information from your world and learned from it. In this case, it's Halloween.
m400470.おっ、良好良好。\nいいね、頭に直接たわーの声が聞こえる感じだ。: Looks good, looks good. Nice, it's like hearing Tawa's voice directly in my head.
m400470.これから皆さまには各世界の拠点にて、\n現在次元間を高速で航行中の、\nホロウク: From now on, you'll be intercepting the Holloculus minions—currently racing through the dimensions—at each world's stronghold.
m400470.これはまた……何かと物騒ですね。\nしかし、すべての世界の勇士たちが集まれば、\: Well now… this is getting dangerous. But if heroes from every world gather, there's nothing to fear.
m400470.しかし、あまりに強すぎるエネルギーが、\n幻として各世界に顕現しているのでしょう: However, its overwhelming energy is manifesting as an illusion in each world.
m400470.それでは早速ですが、現在の状況と、\n今後の作戦について説明いたしますね。: Then, without further ado, let me explain the current situation and our upcoming strategy.
m400470.そんなにも危険な存在だったなんて……。\nこの戦い絶対に負けるわけにはいきません: I never realized it was that dangerous... We can't afford to lose this battle.
m400470.なぜカボチャの姿なのでしょう……？: Why does it look like a pumpkin...?
m400470.にゃふ、こいつは長い夜になりそうだ。: Nyaf, looks like this one's going to be a long night.
m400470.はろうぃんを楽しむためにかい？\nそいつはちょいと笑えない冗談だ。: To enjoy Halloween, huh? That's a joke that hardly makes me laugh.
m400470.ふぅん、つまりは陽炎みたいなものかい。: Huh, so it's like a heat haze, then.
m400470.コンッ！？ アレはなんなの！？\nみなさん！ 見てください！\n空に謎の巨大な影: What the—!? What is that!? Everyone! Look! There's a mysterious huge shadow in the sky…!!
m400470.テスト、テスト……。\n皆さま、通信状況はいかがですか？: Test, test… Everyone, how's the communication?
m400470.モウバンファーラ。仕方ないわね。\nこんなところで死ぬわけにはいかないし、\n子: Moubanfara. It can't be helped. I won't die here, and kids, you'll have to hold off on Halloween just a little longer.
m400470.世界の危機……ですか。\nイケオジが滅んだ世界に意味はありません。\nそれだけは: A world in crisis…? There's no meaning to a world where the cool old man has perished. I must stop that at any cost.
m400470.世界の危機なんざよくあることさ。\n事前に察知できただけ儲けものだよ。: World crises are a regular thing. The fact we sensed it in advance is a profit for us.
m400470.先遣隊ですが、かなりの大軍です。\nまずはこれに打ち勝ち、\n敵の戦力を減らさぬ: They're a vanguard, but a massive army. We have to defeat them first and cut down the enemy's forces, or else there's no point in talking.
m400470.全てはあらゆる環境に適応するため。\n超次元生命体は異世界へと侵攻するに際し、\: T.O.W.E.R.: Everything adapts to any environment. When a hyperdimensional lifeform invades another world, it reconfigures its body into the optimal form.
m400470.皆さまの世界の命運は、\nこの戦いに懸かっていると言えるでしょう。: The fate of your world hangs on this battle.
m400470.確かに……よく見ると、いえ、よく見なくても、\n頭がカボチャになってるの……。: Come to think of it… even without looking closely, its head is a pumpkin…
m400470.良かった！\nなにぶん古いシステムなので、\nちゃんと機能するか心配だったのです: Great! Since it's an old system, I was worried whether it would actually work.

m400528.――大変です王子！\n開拓地がサボテンに襲われちゃいましたっ！: —This is terrible, Prince! The settlement's been overrun by cacti!
m400528.さ、サボテンって、あのサボテンですか……？: So… the cacti are… those cacti?
m400528.さぁ、『大討伐ミッション』開始だ。\nアタシたちの街を奪い返すよ！: Alright, the “Grand Extermination Mission” begins. We'll take our town back!
m400528.そいつらのためにも、\nサボテン退治を手伝ってくれないかい？: For their sake, could you help us wipe out those cacti?
m400528.その、街の皆さんは無事なのでしょうか？: Um, are the townsfolk all right?
m400528.それと、好戦的な銃士の何人かが\nサボテン側に寝返っています。\nそうすれば街を: Also, a few aggressive gunmen have defected to the cactus side, thinking they could fight the Prince who came to save the town.
m400528.そんな感じでなにが起こるか分からない状況なので、\nしっかり準備してから向かって: Since we have no idea what's going to happen, make sure you're well prepared before heading out!
m400528.ちなみにですけど、\n今回は敵を倒してもEXPやゴールドを入手できませんっ。\n: By the way, you won't earn any EXP or gold from this—cacti don't drop anything!
m400528.ってもサボテンの数がエグかったからよォ。\nアタシは『大討伐ミッション』の発令を: Though the cactus numbers are insane, I'm recommending we issue a “Mass Eradication Mission.”
m400528.まぁ、今回はある意味では\n自然災害への対処みたいなものですからね。: Well, in a way this is just dealing with a natural disaster.
m400528.サボテンに占拠された街ではろくに補給できません！\n出撃コストが回復しないので、: In a town occupied by cacti, supplies are scarce! Since sortie costs won't recover, we'll need someone with a “Reinforcement Request” or to field a Valkyrie.
m400528.マァ、連中が馬鹿やって怪我するのは自己責任だと思うが、\n開拓地には一応、真っ当: Well, if they're idiots and get hurt, that's on them, but there are still some decent folks left in the settlement.
m400528.助かるよ、王子サマ。\nそれじゃサボテン狩りと洒落込もうか。: That'd be a huge help, Your Highness. Then let's make a day of this cactus hunt.
m400528.善良な市民は無事ですよ。\n善良でもなければ正気でもない無法者は\nサボテンに突: The good citizens are fine. The lawless, who aren't exactly sane or virtuous, charged the cacti and got torn to shreds.
m400528.大群で押し寄せてきて、\n街はあっという間に占拠されちまったよ。: They came in massive hordes and the town was seized in an instant.
m400528.植物のサボテンだよ。\n突然変異だかなんだか知らないが、\n連中、荒野で根を張る: Yeah, the plant kind. I don't know if it's a mutation or what, but they got bored just rooting around in the wasteland.
m400528.目標はサボテンの数を減らすことだ。\n一体でも多くの敵を撃破することに集中してほ: The goal is to cut down the cactus count. Focus on taking down as many enemies as you can, even if it's just one at a time.
m400528.荒くれ者共も弾丸で蜂の巣になる覚悟はあったと思うが、\nサボテンに穴だらけにされ: Those rough-and-tumble types probably expected to turn into a hive of bullets, but they never imagined being riddled with holes by cacti.
m400528.街の無法者が迷惑かけて申し訳ないぜェ。\n手間かけさせて悪いが、軽くあしらってく: Sorry the town's troublemakers are causing a hassle. I know it's a pain, but just brush them off.
m400528.魔物の数は非常に多いと予想されます。\nライフが０となっても、それまでに倒した敵: We expect an extremely high monster count. Even if your life reaches zero, the number of enemies you've defeated will still be tallied, so prioritize total annihilation.

m400556.――王子、東の砦より伝令！\n正体不明の魔物の軍勢、さらに増加！: —Prince, a messenger from the eastern fortress! Unidentified monster forces are swelling!
m400556.……それもそうですね。\nあっ……でも、ここだけ微かに読み取れそうです。: …You're right. Ah… but I think I can make out something faint here.
m400556.……どうやら、消耗戦を\n続けろとは言わなくて済みそうね。: …Looks like we won't have to tell anyone to keep grinding this war.
m400556.……なるほど、つまりあの謎の敵対生物は、\n突然、どこかから出現したのだ、と。: …I see. In other words, that mysterious hostile lifeform just appeared out of nowhere.
m400556.あぁ、アルレットさん。\nいえ、どうにも気になることがありまして。: Ah, Arlette. It's just… there's something that's been bothering me.
m400556.あぁっ、それはさっき買った焼きたてのー！？: Ah, that's the fresh-baked one I just bought!?.
m400556.あっ、それはとっておきの！\n返してくださいよー！: Ah, that's a secret! Give it back to me!
m400556.あなたは、アイギス神殿防衛部隊の！\n部隊はどうなったのですか！？: You're from the Aegis Temple Defense Unit! What happened to your forces?!
m400556.あれが生物なのかどうか、\nその定義から始めないといけないくらい、\nアタシたち: We'd have to start by defining whether it's even a living thing. To us, it's such an alien existence.
m400556.あんなものが今までに存在していたのなら、\n必ずどこかに記録が残っているはずだか: If something like that ever existed, there must be some record of it somewhere.
m400556.いいえ、それがまったく……。\n魔物、事件、伝説、ありとあらゆる資料をあたっても: No, nothing at all… We've scoured every record on monsters, incidents, legends—nothing shows up, which is oddly suspicious.
m400556.これだけの数の魔物――いや、\n魔物かどうかすら分からないわけだが、\nそいつら: Such a massive number of monsters—actually, we don't even know if they're monsters—where have they been all this time?
m400556.その可能性もありますが……。\nでも、何かが引っかかっているんです。: That's a possibility, but something feels off.
m400556.それはつまり、確認されていない、\n完全に新種の魔物ということなのでは？: So, it could be an unconfirmed, completely new species of monster?
m400556.それも何というのか、\n自分で消したかのような痕跡もあって……。: And there's even evidence that it was erased as if I did it myself…
m400556.そろそろ反撃ですよぉ……？\nアルレットさんのおやつ、いただきっ！: Time for a counter-attack, huh…? I'll have your snack, Arlette!
m400556.はぁ……分からないってことが分かってしまった。\nこのまま消耗戦を続けろなんて、: *sigh*… I've finally realized we don't know anything. As a strategist, I can't in good conscience tell you to keep grinding this war.
m400556.ふふん、あんまり気にしてると、\n美味しいお菓子が美味しくなくなっちゃうぞっと♪: Heh, if you worry about it too much, even tasty sweets will lose their flavor♪
m400556.ぶっちゃけ何も分からない！\nあえて記録を残さなかったんじゃないかって、\n疑い: Honestly, we have no clue! It's almost like they deliberately left no records—there's just no information at all!
m400556.むぅ、自分の癖くらい分かりますよ。\nこの消し方は間違いなく、自分自身のものです: Hmm, I know my own habits. This kind of erasing is definitely my own style.
m400556.もしやと思い、古代文明の資料や、\n専門家にもあたってみたのですが……。: I even checked ancient civilization documents and consulted experts…
m400556.もっと悪い事態になったかもしれないけどね。\n若！ アイギス神殿の偵察に向かおう: It could've gotten even worse, you know. Young man! Let's head out to scout the Aegis Temple!
m400556.アイギス神殿防衛部隊からの連絡途絶！\n魔術師ギルドによる通信魔法にも応答ありま: Communications are down from the Aegis Temple Defense Unit! Even the mage guild's transmission magic gets no response!
m400556.イタズラで、誰かに消されちゃったとか？: A prank? Maybe someone deleted it?
m400556.エフトラ、エフトラかぁ……。\nふふ、ちょっと神秘的で、かわいい名前だね。: Eftra, huh… Hehe, it's a mysterious and cute name.
m400556.レーヴさん、書庫に何か\n参考になりそうな資料はありましたか？: Reve, did you find anything in the archives that might be useful?
m400556.何かあったし、それを覚えていない、\nでも、きっとそれは悪いことではなかったんじ: Something happened and you don't remember, but it probably wasn't a bad thing, right?
m400556.名前、なんでしょうか……？\nうーん、うーん？: What could the name be…? Hmm, hmm?
m400556.報告いたします。\nアイギス神殿北の山脈が崩壊！\n巨大な……その……なんという: Report: The mountain range north of the Aegis Temple has collapsed! A massive… uh… what's the word…
m400556.悪いことが起きてたなら、\nこんな風におしゃべり出来ていないだろうし。: If something terrible had occurred, we wouldn't be able to chat like this.
m400556.敵はいったい何者なんだ……。\n見たこともない魔物の群れに、\nそれを生み出す能: Who on earth are these enemies…? A horde of monsters we've never seen, and the ability that creates them—information is all over the place!
m400556.確かにつけていたはずの日記が、\nほんの数行、なぜか抜け落ちているんです。: The diary I was keeping is missing a few lines, for some reason.
m400556.被害は甚大ですが、まだ持ちこたえています。\nしかしそれも時間の問題かと……。: The damage is severe, but we're still holding on. Though it's only a matter of time…
m400556.超巨大生物の頭部と思われるものが\n山脈を割って出現しました……！！: Something that looks like the head of a colossal creature has ripped through the mountains and emerged…!!
m400556.青白い肌と、生物の常識を無視した肉体、\nそして自身を複製するあの特性……。: Pale blue skin, a body that defies all biological logic, and that self-replicating trait…
m400556.（……忘れているだけでなく、\n自ら消した痕跡があるということは、\nきっと誰か: (…Not only have I forgotten, but the fact that there are traces I erased myself means someone must have performed large-scale memory manipulation…)
m400556.（でも、悪い気はしないですね。\nアルレットさんの言うとおり、\nきっと何か、良: (But it doesn't feel bad. Like Arlette says, it was probably a good encounter.)

m400561.――竜将クロコによる、\n工業都市襲撃から数日後。: ――A few days after Dragon General Kuroko's raid on the industrial city.
m400561.……いえ、まだ大丈夫です。\n私よりも民の方が苦しんでいるのですから、\nまだ立: …No, we're still okay. The people are suffering more than I am, so we can't just stand still.
m400561.……じゃ、こんな感じで皆眠らせるから。\n休暇交代の順番と、人員配置は全部任せる: …Alright, I'll put everyone to sleep like this. I'll leave the rotation schedule and staffing entirely to you.
m400561.……では。\n皆さまに、愉快で穏やかなひとときの夢を……。: …Then. A pleasant and peaceful moment of dreaming for everyone…
m400561.……エレオノーラ様、\n目の下に特大のクマができてますよ。: …Eleonora, you've got a massive dark circle under your eye.
m400561.あとは……そうね……。\n夢の中だから、何が起きてもおかしくないわ。\n……お祭: And then… well… anything can happen in a dream. Just think of it as a festival and have fun.
m400561.あなたの方こそ、寝不足で顔真っ青ですよ……？: You're the one who looks pale from lack of sleep…?
m400561.あなたもちゃんと休むのよ？\n皆寝ないから、強制的に睡眠とらせよう作戦、\n発案: You too, make sure you rest properly. Since nobody's sleeping, we'll force a sleep mission—the one who came up with it is you.
m400561.いい？\nたぶん夢の中では『大討伐ミッション』が始まるわ。: Listen up. In the dream, the “Great Hunt Mission” will probably kick off.
m400561.くっ……手当てはもういいわ。\n今すぐ訓練を再開しなくちゃ！: Ugh… I'm done with medical care. We have to resume training right now!
m400561.そういうあなたが！\n一番休暇が必要だと自覚なさい！: And you! You should realize you're the one who needs a vacation the most!
m400561.なっ……これは眠りの魔術……！？\nくっ……私たちを眠らせて、どうする、つもり―: What… is this sleep magic…!? D-darn… putting us to sleep, what do you intend to do—
m400561.はぁ……本当は、\nこういう無理やりな手段は嫌いなのだけれど……。: Haa… Honestly, I dislike these forced measures, but…
m400561.ふぁ……あふ……。\nえぇ、そろそろ限界だったしね……。: Ugh… ah… Yeah, I was reaching my limit anyway…
m400561.ふふっ、お任せあれ。: Hehe, you can count on me.
m400561.スキル『援軍要請』を持つメンバーや、\nワルキューレを編成に入れておきなさい。: Make sure to include members with the “Reinforcement Request” skill, and put a Valkyrie in your formation.
m400561.ヘカティエ様？\n打ち合わせどおりお願いできるかしら。: Hecatie? Can we proceed as discussed?
m400561.全員が一度に休むわけにはいかない、\nというのは分かっているわ。\nでも交代で休: I know we can't all rest at once. But we could at least take turns, couldn't we?
m400561.冥神殿の言うことは、正しい。\n貴様らが民の為に無理をしているのはわかるが、\n: The Underworld Temple's words are correct. I understand you're pushing yourselves for the people, but if you can't fight when it matters, it's meaningless.
m400561.夢が、混線してるわね……。\n大規模な戦闘に巻き込まれる夢かしら。\n一応注意事: The dream's getting tangled… I wonder if it'll turn into a massive battle. I should at least give you the precautions…
m400561.夢の中だから、普段のような補給はできないわ。\n出撃コストが時間経過で回復しない: Since it's a dream, you can't get supplies like you normally do. Your deployment cost won't recover over time.
m400561.当然だけど、夢の中で敵を倒しても\nEXPやゴールドは手に入らないからね。: Naturally, even if you defeat enemies in the dream, you won't earn any EXP or gold.
m400561.手を貸した人間たちが、\n過労で冥界の世話になるような事態は避けたいし……。\n: I don't want the humans who helped us to end up overworked and stuck in the afterlife… ―Orphie, do it.
m400561.拠点のライフが0になっても、\nそれまでの討伐数が記録として残るの。\n倒れる事: Even if your base's life drops to zero, the number of defeats you've logged will still be recorded. So don't fear falling—stand up to the enemies.

m500190.――よくぞここまで参った。\n我ら邪仙に仇なす愚か者共よ。:
――Well done making it this far.
You foolish ones who dare oppose us evil immortals.
m500190.……いえ、あれは通天教主の宝貝『万仙陣』により\nつくり出された、いわば本人の複: …No, that's a replica created by Tsuten Kyoushu's treasure shell “Ten Thousand Immortals Formation,” essentially a copy of him.
m500190.……だが、ぬしらの望む通りにはゆかぬ。\n覚えておれ。再び相まみえる時、塵と化す: …But it won't go the way you wish. Remember this: when we meet again, you'll be the ones reduced to dust.
m500190.……ですが、十天君を模したその力。\nたとえ複製とは言え、微塵の油断もなりません: …but the power modeled after the Ten Heaven Lords. Even as a replica, we can't afford any slip-up.
m500190.……ですが、此度は東の国の人々を救うための戦い。\n消耗戦となっては、東の国の被: …Nevertheless, this battle is to save the people of the Eastern lands. A war of attrition will only worsen their suffering. A swift, decisive strike is the only path to victory.
m500190.……勇敢なるご決断、恐れ入ります。\n出立前に、通天教主の持つ宝貝について\nお: …Your courageous decision is most appreciated. Before we set out, I must brief you on the Archmaster's treasured relics.
m500190.……妖術の類だろうね。\nそんな力が残っていたようには見えなかったけど。: …Probably some kind of sorcery. I didn't think any such power remained.
m500190.……更に、奴はその力を他の宝貝と組み合わせる事で、\n自身を守護する『防壁』のよ: Moreover, I've heard he can combine that power with other relics to create a protective “wall” around himself.
m500190.……話は済んだか。邪仙郷の十傑、十天君が織りなす\n『十絶陣』に相対して生き残っ: …Is the matter settled? None survived confronting the Ten Tenkyu's “Ten-Absolute Formation” woven by the ten heroes of Jasenkyou. Foolish brigands, may you die regretting your short-sightedness.
m500190.あれは――妖天君！\n彼なら東の国にいるはずでは……？: That's… Yotenkun! He should be in the eastern lands, shouldn't he?
m500190.いざという時には使い手を守れるよう、矢刃を通さぬ\n圧倒的な硬度を備えた強力な宝: It's a powerful treasure shell with overwhelming hardness that won't let arrowheads pierce it, so it can protect its wielder in a pinch. One of the reasons the evil immortals are after Shinsenkyou is probably that.
m500190.こうも守りが手薄じゃ、いかにも罠だと\nいわんばかりだね。それに、神仙郷から奪わ: With such thin defenses, it's practically a trap, isn't it? And we haven't seen any sign of the “Yellow Turban Strongman” taken from Shinsenkyou…
m500190.ここが邪仙郷……邪仙たちの本拠地ですか。: This is Jasenkyou… the stronghold of the evil immortals?
m500190.ここまでは順調……ですが、気を抜いてはなりません。\n敵がどこに伏兵を忍ばせてい: So far so good… but we mustn't let our guard down. We never know where the enemy's ambushes lie.
m500190.このままでは、東の国全土の陥落も時間の問題。\n戦局を覆すには、彼我の戦力差を無: If things continue as they are, the entire Eastern realm will fall—it's only a matter of time. To turn the tide, we'll need a brilliant, unconventional strategy that nullifies the disparity in our forces.
m500190.ご存知のように、東の国は現在、\n華の国の邪仙たちから成る軍によって侵攻を受け、: As you know, the Eastern lands are currently under invasion by an army of evil hermits from the Flower Kingdom, and the situation is looking grim across the region.
m500190.その中には戦場の敵全てを氷塊へ包み込む、\n強力な力を秘めた術師もいると聞く。十: Among them is a sorcerer who can encase every enemy on the battlefield in a block of ice. Assess the Ten Heaven Lords' abilities and give us calm orders.
m500190.その奇策とは、\n邪仙たちの本拠、邪仙郷を奇襲し、\n総大将である通天教主を討つ: That strategy is a surprise assault on the evil hermits' stronghold, the Evil Hermit Village, to eliminate their supreme commander, the Archmaster of the Celestial Tower.
m500190.それが最も手早かろう。\nいでよ、邪仙郷最強の十将――十天君よ！:
That will be the quickest way.
Come forth, the ten strongest generals of Jasenkyou—Ten Heaven Lords!
m500190.たとえ一人では力及ばずとも、皆の力を合わせれば\n奴の防壁も貫ける筈……通天教主: Even if a single person can't match his power, together we can break through his defense… Let's defeat Tsuten Kyoushu and claim victory.
m500190.ですが、あの様子では\n当分の間はまともに行動することはできないでしょう。: But given the state of things, they won't be able to act properly for a while.
m500190.もしも敵に使われるような事があれば、\n魔法での攻撃を心掛けて頂ければと……。\: If the enemy were to get their hands on it, I'd ask you to focus on magical attacks… …! Everyone, watch out!
m500190.キミは――通天教主か。\n邪仙郷の総大将が直接出迎えてくれるとはね。: You are… Tsuten Kyoushu, aren't you? The commander-in-chief of Jasenkyou greeting us personally.
m500190.不安があるとすれば、王子の軍が邪仙郷に進軍する間、\n東の国の防衛にあたる戦力が: My only concern is that while your army advances on Evil Hermit Village, the defenses of the Eastern lands will be weakened...
m500190.使い手の望む最強の兵を創り出す宝貝、『万仙陣』。\n自我のない操り人形となるが故: The treasure shell “Ten Thousand Immortals Formation” creates the strongest soldier the wielder desires. Because it's a mind-less puppet, its combat power doesn't quite match the original…
m500190.古来より、兵力で劣る軍が\n危険を冒さずに勝利を収めた例はありません。\n虎穴に: Throughout history, an outnumbered army has never secured victory without taking risks. You can't catch a tiger cub without entering the tiger's den.
m500190.四宝剣は全てを貫く天雷を操りし宝貝。\nその雷の前には、いかなる鎧、\n魔法への: The Four-Treasure Sword commands a heaven-piercing thunder that renders any armor or magical resistance meaningless.
m500190.失礼いたします、王子。\n華の国の仙人、太公望。意見具申したく参りました。: Excuse me, Prince. I am Taigong Wang, the hermit of the Flower Kingdom, and I've come to offer my counsel.
m500190.強力な宝貝を同時に操るのは、並大抵の事では\nありません。例え通天教主と言えど、: Manipulating multiple powerful relics simultaneously is no small feat. Even the Archmaster has his limits—his stamina will eventually run out.
m500190.強力な宝貝を組み合わせた防壁の前には、生半可な\n攻撃は一切通用致しません。痛烈: Against such a wall forged from potent relics, half-hearted attacks are useless. You'll need a decisive blow to breach it, or your strikes won't reach him at all.
m500190.戦闘の目的はほぼ果たせた、ということです。\n我らの戦略的勝利と見ても良いでしょ: That means we've essentially achieved our objective. We can consider this a strategic victory.
m500190.無論、それは言うほど容易なことではありません。\nですが、敵が戦力の大半を東の国: Of course, it won't be as easy as it sounds. However, with the enemy concentrating most of their troops on the Eastern front, their own headquarters is left relatively undefended—another fact we can exploit.
m500190.無論、本物の十天君を倒したわけではないので、\n彼らとの戦いは続くことになります: Of course, we haven't slain the true Ten Tenkyu, so the fight with them will go on. However, their leader's defeat should severely crush their morale.
m500190.王子……ここが勝負所です。\n通天教主を討つために挙兵して頂けないでしょうか。: Prince… this is the decisive moment. Will you raise your forces to strike down the Archmaster?
m500190.王子、やりましたね。\nそれでは皆さん、帰還いたしましょう。: Prince, we did it. Then everyone, let's return.
m500190.王子、知っての通り十天君はそれぞれが\n特殊な能力を備えている。炎や雷、時に天候: Prince, as you know, each Ten Heaven Lord possesses a unique ability—fire, lightning, even weather control. They're wielders of incredibly powerful treasure shells.
m500190.神仙郷に住まう仙人をサポートすべく、\n人を模して造られた宝貝です。皆さんで言う: It's a treasure shell forged to support the sages of Shinsenkyou, modeled after a human. You could think of it as a “kugutsu”—that might make it clearer.
m500190.邪仙たちを束ねる総大将だけあり、奴は\n多彩な宝貝を操ると言われています……その: As the supreme commander of the evil hermits, he's said to wield a variety of powerful relics… Among them, the most dangerous is his “Four-Treasure Sword.”
m500190.馬鹿な……邪仙郷の長たるこの私が、\n俗界の者どもにここまで追い詰められるとは。: Impossible… That I, the lord of Jasenkyou, could be driven this far by mortals of the mundane world.
m500190.黄巾力士、ですか？: The Yellow Turban Strongman, you say?

m500417.……まあ、今回はそれで良しとしてやるとするか。\nお前たち帰るまでが航海だ、最後:
……Very well, I'll allow it this time.
Remember, the voyage doesn't end until you're home. Stay sharp to the very end.
m500417.……イヴリール、あなたの野望とは、\nこの世全ての海を制覇することでしたね？:
……Ivril, your ambition is to conquer
all the seas in this world, correct?
m500417.……何故再会して五秒で喧嘩ができるのですか。\nまったく、千年経っても落ち着きが:
...Why can you start a fight five seconds after reuniting?
Honestly, you haven't mellowed out even after a thousand years.
m500417.……気が変わった。偶には星の海も悪くはない。: ……I've changed my mind. The Sea of Stars won't be so bad, after all.
m500417.……珍しいこともあるものですね。\n国家という仕組みを嫌ったあなたが、\n我々の:
……How unusual.
You, who despise the very concept of a nation,
actually offering to cooperate with our plan.
m500417.……駄目そうね、私たちの身体には毒みたい。: ……It seems to be toxic to our bodies.
m500417.……魔神二体の沈黙を確認。討伐、完了です。: ……Confirmed the silence of both Demon Gods. Subjugation complete.
m500417.──いざ実物を見ると凄まじいね。\n全くの無から魔界に海を創り出すとは、\n魔神:
—Seeing it in person is truly formidable.
To create a sea in the Demon Realm out of nothing…
Is this the extent of Vepal's power?
m500417.──おれたちは海賊、あらゆる全てを奪う者！: —We are pirates, those who seize all things!
m500417.──さぁて、後日談を始めるとしようか。: ──Well then, let us begin the epilogue.
m500417.──やあやあ諸君、全員お集まりのようだね。\n早速だが王国と帝国による合同作戦の:
──Ah, hello, everyone. Looks like we're all here.
Let's get straight to it. The joint operation between the Kingdom and the Empire is about to begin.
m500417.──ッ！？ 気を付けろ！\nグラシャラボラスの様子がおかしい！:
──What! Stay alert!
Glasharablas is acting strange!
m500417.──待て、魔界に船だと？\nそんな話は聞いたことがない。:
──Wait, a ship in the Demon Realm?
I've never heard of such a thing.
m500417.──海賊王イヴリール。\nかの千年戦争において英雄王に雇われ、\n数多の海戦を勝:
──The Pirate King, Ivril.
A legendary sailor who was hired by the Hero King during the Millennium War
and led countless naval battles to victory.
m500417.──試しで殺されちゃあ堪らないねぇ！\n海から這い上がるのも大変だったんだよ！:
──I can't afford to get killed in a test!
Climbing out of the sea was hard enough!
m500417.──駄犬のせいで話が逸れたな、本題に入るぞ。: —That mutt derailed the conversation. Let's get down to business.
m500417.──魔神の二体同時の暴走。\n一度ならば偶然で片付けられるが、\n二度も続けば必:
──Two Demon Gods going berserk simultaneously.
One instance could be dismissed as a coincidence,
but two in a row compels us to suspect a necessity.
m500417.あなた以上の船乗りを私は知りません。\nしかし、世に名高き海賊王とて限界はあるも:
I know no sailor greater than you.
But even the most renowned Pirate King has limits.
Have you not felt frustration at the charts that remain forever blank?
m500417.いいえ、私は何もしていませんよ。\n全ては王子が自ら切り開いた道です。:
No, I haven't done anything.
This path was opened by the Prince himself.
m500417.いやはや、何はともあれ一件落着だね……ん？: Well, well, crisis averted, I suppose…… Hm?
m500417.うるさい、いいから一回行ってこい。: Shut up. Just go try it once.
m500417.ええ、随分と怒らせたみたいね。\nさっきよりも強力な一撃を溜めてるわ。\nねぇメ:
Yes, he appears to be quite enraged.
He's charging up a strike far more powerful than before.
Now, Mephisto, just for a test──
m500417.えーっ！ そんな薄情な！\nほら、王子くんですよ王子くん！\nなんとあの英雄王く:
What! That's so heartless!
Come on, Prince! It's the Prince!
The descendant of that legendary Hero King!
m500417.おお、やってみろよ、犬っころ。\nお望み通りタコ殴りにしてやろう。:
Oh, go ahead, mutt.
I'll beat you up with all my tentacles, just as you wish.
m500417.おれの船に乗った以上、\n敗北は許さん、勝利も要らん。\n蹂躙だ、蹂躙のみを許可:
Now that you're on my ship,
I won't tolerate defeat, and I don't need a mere victory.
I permit only annihilation.
m500417.おれは奪う、お前は差し出す──お分かり？: I take, you give── Do you understand?
m500417.おれを雇いたいのなら、\n相応の報酬を用意するんだな。\n話はそれから聞いてやろ:
If you want to hire me,
prepare a commensurate reward.
Then I'll hear you out.
m500417.お前たち、ここから先はもう後戻りできん。\n人間の形で死にたいのなら今が最後の機:
You lot, there's no turning back from here.
If you want to die in human form, now is your last chance.
m500417.お前たち仕上げだ！ 最大火力を持って来い！: Finish them off! Bring your full firepower!
m500417.この程度で騒ぐな、雑魚の無駄な抵抗だ。\n奴め、まだ自分の立場を理解していないら:
Don't make a fuss over something this trivial. It's just a useless resistance by the weak.
That fool still doesn't understand his position.
m500417.これで……私の領地も……水没しないで済みます……。: With this…… my territory…… will be spared from submersion……
m500417.これは……さすがに驚いたわね。: This is... quite the surprise, indeed.
m500417.そうかなー、普通に泳げそうだけど。\nむしろ海の中にいるみたいで元気かも！:
I don't know, it looks swimmable.
I feel like I might even be more energetic in there!
m500417.そうだな、報酬には色を付けさせてもらおう。\n無事帰還した暁には国を挙げての宴も:
Indeed, I intend to make sure the compensation is substantial.
If we return safely, I promise a feast for the entire nation.
m500417.そうねメフィスト、\nちょっと泳いでみてくれない？:
Yes, Mephisto.
Could you try swimming a bit?
m500417.そこでおれの出番というわけだ。\nおれの船でお前たちを魔神の前に連れて行く、\n:
That's where I come in.
I'll take you to the Demon Gods on my ship.
After that, just beat their faces in until you drop.
m500417.そこで我々は当該地域を『危険海域』と認定。\n領主であるパヤモ氏からの緊急の要請:
We have designated the area as a "Dangerous Waters Zone." In response to an urgent request from the local lord, Payamo,
we decided to dispatch an airship for investigation. You're all aware of that, right?
m500417.そりゃあウェパルは海を司る魔神だ。\n君たち魚人が適応できても不思議じゃない。\:
Well, Vepal is the Demon God of the sea.
It's no surprise you fish-folk can adapt.
But for us, who live on dry land—
m500417.だが、空をグラシャラボラス、\n海をウェパルがそれぞれ見張っている以上、\n我々:
But with Glasharavos watching the skies
and Vepal patrolling the seas,
we can't just waltz in there on our own.
m500417.だが昨日、その飛空船が落とされた。: But yesterday, that airship was shot down.
m500417.ちょちょちょ、もう出て行くんですか！？\nこの流れで！？ かつての戦友を置いて！:
W-wait, wait, you're just walking out like that!?
In the middle of all this!? Leaving your old comrades behind!?
m500417.はいはい、聞き飽きたよキャプテン。\nもっと他に言うべきコトとかないの？:
Yeah, yeah, I've heard it all before, Captain.
Isn't there something else you should be saying?
m500417.ははは、面白い冗談だアブグルント。\nあれはウェパルの血潮のようなものだぜ？\n:
Haha, that's a funny joke, Abgrund.
That's like Vepal's blood.
It's basically telling me to die.
m500417.ふむふむ、自らの魔力を込めた羽根を撒き散らして、\nその周辺の眷属たちに透明化を:
Hmm, seems he's scattering feathers infused with his own magic,
granting invisibility to the minions in his vicinity?
m500417.ふん……大した戦利品は無しか。\n魔神を名乗る割にはしけてやがる。\n描き上げた:
Hmph…… not much in the way of valuable spoils, I see.
For beings who call themselves Demon Gods, they're a disappointment.
The charts they drew are little more than trash.
m500417.まあまあキャプテン、\n魔神を二体も同時に倒したんだよ？\nこれは恩賞もたんまり:
Now, now, Captain,
we just took down two Demon Gods at once, didn't we?
The reward is bound to be bountiful!
m500417.まず前提となる情報を共有しておこう。\n今回の発端は魔界の辺境、地図で言えば右下:
First, let's share some essential background information.
The incident started in the remote frontier of the Demon Realm, which is in the bottom-right corner of the map.
A mysterious lake suddenly appeared there. That's how it all began.
m500417.むむむ、確かに正論ではありますけど……。: Mmm, it's a fair point, I suppose……
m500417.わわわっ！？ なんか変な感じ！\n船の上なのに水の中にいるみたい！:
W-w-what! It feels weird!
I'm on the ship, but it feels like I'm underwater!
m500417.んなぁっ！？ ほほほ、本物ォ！？: Whaaat!? Ho ho ho, the real deal!?
m500417.アブグルント、何か気になることでも？: Abgrund, is something on your mind?
m500417.イルドナ貴様……やってくれるな。: Ildona, you…… you really know how to push a button.
m500417.ウェパルが『暴走』を始めました。\n自らの領域で周囲を強引に浸食しています。\n:
Wepar has begun to "go berserk."
He is forcibly encroaching on the surroundings within his own domain.
Be on guard. This place is no different from the deep sea.
m500417.ウェパルとグラシャラボラス、\n両魔神の肉体の消滅を先ほど確認した。\n現状、復:
I have just confirmed the destruction of the physical forms
of both Wepar and Glasharablas.
There are no signs of resurrection or reincarnation at this time.
m500417.ウェパルの血潮というのも本当だったみたい。\nこの海も三日もすれば消えるんじゃな:
So Vepal's blood-tide was real after all.
This sea will likely vanish within three days.
m500417.ウェパルはあらゆる生物の傷口を腐らせてきます。\nダメージの増加には最大限の注意:
Vepal rots the wounds of any living thing.
Please exercise the utmost caution regarding damage amplification.
m500417.サーではない、次間違えたら銃殺だ。: Not "sir." Get it wrong again, and it's a firing squad.
m500417.パヤモ氏の領地の復興も迅速に進んでいるようだし、\nおおよそハッピーエンドと言っ:
The reconstruction of Payamo's territory is also proceeding swiftly,
so it would be fair to call this a happy ending.
m500417.二度あることは三度ある、ですか。: Two times is already a pattern, I suppose.
m500417.何らかの大きな禍の予兆か、\nそれとも誰か裏で手を引いているのか。\n今の状況で:
Is it a harbinger of some great calamity,
or is someone pulling the strings from the shadows?
It's hard to say with certainty in the current situation, but……
m500417.借りパク野郎が、胡散臭ぇ面しやがって黙ってろ。: Shut up, you thief who took my loan and ran. Your shady face is giving me a headache.
m500417.冥途の土産だ、まとめて消えろォ！: A parting gift for the afterlife! Vanish, all of you!
m500417.前回に引き続き二体同時のご登場というわけさ。\nこのまま奴らを放置すれば海面の上:
Here they are again, making a double appearance.
If we leave them be, the sea level will keep rising,
and eventually the entire Demon Realm will be submerged.
m500417.前回のアモン、キメリエスの件と、\n今回の事件は何かつながりがあると？:
Are you suggesting that the previous incident with Amon and Chimierus
is connected to this event?
m500417.勘違いするなよ、イルドナ。\nおれがお前たちに協力するのではない。\nお前たちが:
Don't get the wrong idea, Ildona.
I'm not cooperating with you all.
You're cooperating with my voyage.
m500417.千年以上もずっと、航海を続けてきたのです。\nあなた自身、手詰まりを感じているの:
You have been sailing for over a thousand years.
Surely you yourself feel that you have reached a dead end?
m500417.千年疎遠なら他人も同然だろ。\nおれは忙しいんだ、他を当たれ。:
After a millennium apart, we're as good as strangers.
I'm busy, so try someone else.
m500417.可能性は否定できないね。\n少なくとも、魔界の監視は強化するべきだろう。:
We can't rule out the possibility.
At the very least, we should strengthen our surveillance of the Demon Realm.
m500417.喚くなメフィスト、さっさと構えろ。\n本当に死にたいなら止めはしないがな。:
Shut up, Mephisto, and get in position.
I won't stop you if you really want to die.
m500417.喧しいぞ、偉そうに人を批評できる立場か。\nお前、おれが貸した船を返してないだろ:
You're loud. Do you think you're in a position to criticize others?
You never returned the ship I lent you, didn't you?
m500417.回りくどいぞ、何が言いたい。: You're being roundabout. What are you getting at?
m500417.圧倒せよ！ 圧倒せよ！\n奴らの尊厳を奪え、矜持を嘲笑え！\n存在そのものを根底:
Overwhelm them! Overwhelm them!
Strip them of their dignity, mock their pride!
Deny their very existence down to the root!
m500417.太陽とは名ばかりの詐欺師に……その面は駄犬か、\n相変わらずご主人様に尻尾を振っ:
A fraud who only has the name of the sun... and that face belongs to a mongrel, doesn't it?
Still wagging your tail for your master, I see?
m500417.安心しろ、死者は出ていない。\n海上への不時着に成功後、\n近海に停泊中の船に救:
Don't worry, there are no casualties.
They made a successful emergency landing on the water
and were rescued by a ship that was anchored in the nearby waters.
m500417.当該地域は乾燥地帯であり、降雨は稀だ。\nしかし、この湖は十数日前から急激に水位:
The region is an arid zone where rainfall is rare.
However, this lake's water level has risen rapidly over the past ten or so days,
and it has now grown to a scale that can be called a sea, submerging the entire area.
m500417.念のためおさらいしておきましょうか。\nグラシャラボラスは透明化する眷属を使役す:
Just to be safe, let's run through the plan one more time.
Grashalabos commands transparent minions.
If you want to land a hit, you'll need to pin them down and catch them.
m500417.抜錨だ、運が悪ければ死に損なうこともあるだろう。: Cast off. If we're lucky, we might just survive.
m500417.敵も追い詰められている！\n総員、ここが正念場だ！\n今日こそ奴との長き因縁を断:
The enemy is cornered!
Everyone, this is the decisive moment!
Today, we end this long-standing feud!
m500417.未踏の海路におれはいる。魔界だろうと例外はない。: ????: I am on an uncharted sea route. Whether it's the Demon Realm or not makes no difference.
m500417.死んだ人間に興味はない。\nよってその子孫にも興味はない。:
I have no interest in the dead.
And therefore, no interest in their descendants.
m500417.残念ね、面白くなると思ったのに。: What a pity. I thought it might get interesting.
m500417.海図の製作に邪魔な害獣の駆除を、\n特別に手伝わせてやると言っている。:
I'm just letting you help with the charting
and the extermination of those pesky vermin.
m500417.王子、当代の英雄か。顔は覚えた。\nお前に海賊王の流儀を教えてやろう。:
Prince, hero of the current age. I've memorized your face.
I'll teach you the ways of the Pirate King.
m500417.用は終わった、おれは帰るぞ。: My business here is done. I'm leaving.
m500417.私も報告聞いたときは耳を疑ったよ。\nだが、本人を目の当たりにして納得した。\n:
I was skeptical when I heard the report too.
But seeing the person in question, I was convinced.
You'll all be surprised. Excitement level: 1000%.
m500417.突入と同時に戦闘開始だ。\n各員、作戦は頭に入ってるな？:
Combat begins the moment we board.
Everyone, do you have the plan memorized?
m500417.精神体の崩壊も始まっているようだ。\nあとはただ消えゆくのを待つのみだろうね。:
It seems their mental collapse has already begun.
All that remains is to wait for them to fade away.
m500417.総員照準合わせ！ 王子、合わせろ！: All hands, take aim! Prince, take aim!
m500417.良い度胸だなフレイ。だが、その通りだ。: Bold words, Frey. But you're right.
m500417.茶番は終わったか。\n雑魚と野良犬がこちらに気づいた、\nこのまま墜落船に乗り込:
Is the show over?
The grunts and strays have noticed us.
Let's board the wreck.
m500417.落とされたって……乗組員は無事なのですか！？: Shot down... Are the crew members safe?!
m500417.誰かと思えば航海狂いか。\n千年戦争後にすぐ海に消えたお前が、\nまさかまだ生き:
So it's a sea maniac.
You vanished into the sea right after the Millennium War,
and I didn't expect you to still be alive.
m500417.開戦だ！ 奴らの首を船の上に掲げてやれ！: Battle begins! Hold their heads aloft above the deck!
m500417.魔界でお前たちの飛空船を襲ったのは魔神だ。\nウェパル、そしてそれを守るグラシャ:
The ones who attacked your airship in the Demon Realm are Demon Gods.
Vepal, and Glasharavos, who protects him.
m500417.魔神に喰われて死にたいやつから船に乗れ。\n遺書を書くための紙と筆はこちらで用意:
Anyone who wants to be eaten alive by the Demon Gods can board.
I'll provide the paper and pen for your last wills.
m500417.（あ、コレットが部屋の隅で舌噛んでる）: (Ah, Colette is biting her tongue in the corner of the room)
m500417.（グラシャラボラスは死んだ。\nだけどウェパルはまだ運命に抗っている。\nもう、:
(Glasharablas is dead.
But Wepar is still defying fate.
Even though there's nothing left he can do.)
m500417.（確かイヴリールちゃんへの依頼料って、\n城どころか国が建つ金額でしたよねぇ……:
(I recall Ivril's fee was enough to buy not just a castle,
but an entire country……)
m500417.（精神体が消えるまであと少し。\nその死に体でこの世に何かを遺せるのか。\nそれ:
(His spirit is on the verge of vanishing.
Can he leave anything behind in this dying state?
Or is he just prolonging his own suffering?)

m500531.……ボクも、引き受けるべきだと思います。\n魔神モラクスは本来とても心優しい人類:
...I think we should accept.
Morax was originally a very kind ally of humanity.
I want to end this before he suffers any more.
m500531.……気のせい、ではないかもしれません。\n洞窟の奥から魔界に似た瘴気が漂っていま:
……It might not just be your imagination.
I can smell a miasma similar to the Demon Realm drifting from deep within the cave.
m500531.……重大な案件ですね、皆さんの意見はどうですか？: ...This is a serious matter. What do the others think?
m500531.──ちっ、奴さんも本気になったようですね。: ──Tch, it looks like he's getting serious.
m500531.──アンナさんはいらっしゃいます？\nお客様がいらしているようですわよー。:
──Is Anna here?
It seems we have visitors.
m500531.──ッ、ゴーレムの魔力反応近いです！ 接敵間近！:
──There! I'm detecting a Golem's magical signature!
Hostile contact imminent!
m500531.──モラクスに異変！ 総員警戒態勢！: ──Something is wrong with Morax! All units, prepare for a full alert!
m500531.──レームノス島に魔神が現れた。: ──A Demon God has appeared on the island of Lamnos.
m500531.──僕が王国に協力するからね。: ──I will be cooperating with the kingdom.
m500531.──自分も同意ですね。:
──I agree.
I'm thoroughly tired of chasing after Foofour.
It's about time we settled our score with that wretch.
m500531.──隠れ家って言う割には、普通の洞窟だな。\nお前、普段からこんなところに住んで:
──For a "hideout," it's just a regular cave.
Is this really where you live day-to-day?
m500531.あ、亜神ヒュープ！？ どうしてここに！？: Oh, Demi-God Hupe! What are you doing here?
m500531.あたしは行くぜ、自分の庭を荒らされて黙っていられるか。: I'm going. I can't just stand by while someone trashes my backyard.
m500531.あの二体を同時に相手なんて、本当に悪夢だわ……。: Facing those two at the same time… this is truly a nightmare.
m500531.あら、どういう心境の変化？: Oh my, what has gotten into you?
m500531.あれは……千年戦争で最後に見せたという暴走状態！？: Is that…… the berserk state he displayed at the end of the Millennium War?
m500531.いいえ、そんなことはありませんよ。: No, that is not the case at all.
m500531.いいえ、もう終わりのようです。\nモラクスの身体が、崩壊して……。:
No, it seems it's truly over.
Morax's body is… collapsing…
m500531.いいや、その場から動く気配はなさそうですね。\nとはいえ、じゃあ置物かっていうと:
No, I don't sense any intention for them to move from their spots.
That said, calling them mere decorations would be──
m500531.いい加減フールフールとの追いかけっこも飽き飽きだ。\nここらで奴さんとの因縁にも:
──I agree.
I'm thoroughly tired of chasing after Foofour.
It's about time we settled our score with that wretch.
m500531.いい考えですね！ 経済効果がありそうです！: That's a brilliant idea! It has great economic potential!
m500531.いえ、指に少し違和感があるような気がして……。: Oh, I just felt a slight tingling in my fingers…
m500531.いつどこでも相手を眠らせることができる。\nどんな悩みや不安、ストレスを抱えた患:
I can put anyone to sleep, anywhere, at any time.
No matter what worries, anxieties, or stress a patient is carrying,
my power can guide them into the world of dreams in a single second.
m500531.うん、どうしてもあの目から視線を逸らせない。\nどういう原理なのか現時点では分か:
Yeah, I can't help but feel their gaze.
I don't understand the principle behind it yet, but
it seems we have no choice but to defeat those minions first.
m500531.おおむねその通りだと思うよ。\nこのまま瘴気を放置すれば外部に溢れ出し、\nやが:
I believe that's roughly correct.
If we leave the miasma unchecked, it will spill outside,
and eventually cover the entire island.
m500531.おそらくは、かつてない激戦になるだろう。\n人員の選抜にはくれぐれも慎重を期して:
This is likely to be the fiercest battle we've ever faced.
Please be extremely careful when selecting your personnel.
m500531.お前の島ではねーだろ。: It's not your island, is it?
m500531.お願いしたら工房に混ぜてもらえるかな？\n品物が完成したら王子様に買ってもらおー:
Maybe if we ask nicely, they'll let us join the workshop?
Then we can sell the finished products to the Prince!
m500531.こっちも同様、あの忌々しい鹿頭の匂いがします。: Same here. I can smell that wretched deer-headed one.
m500531.さあ、そこまでは分からない。\n僕も自力での対処を試みたんだが、\n亜神の権能が:
I don't know about that.
I tried to handle it on my own, but
my powers as a Demi-God had absolutely no effect.
m500531.じゃあ、今回の報酬は無し？: So, no reward for this time?
m500531.そこから漏れ出た瘴気が魔神の魔力と混じり、\n洞窟内部を侵食しているということで:
So the miasma leaking from there is mixing with the Demon Gods' power,
eroding the interior of the cave?
m500531.そして、鍛冶神ウルカノの聖地とも呼ばれています。: It's also known as the sacred ground of the Forge God, Vulcano.
m500531.それで、本当に渡しちゃうんですか？\nフールフールの骨とモラクスの宝石……。:
So, are you really going to hand them over?
Fulfur's bones and Moloch's gem……
m500531.それよりも油断しないように。\n見ての通り洞窟の中はこの広さだ、\nどこに敵が潜:
But more importantly, stay on your guard.
As you can see, this cave is quite spacious,
so there's no telling where the enemy is lurking.
m500531.そろそろ旗色を明確にするべき頃合いってことさ。\n近頃は、随分ときな臭いことも多:
It is simply time to make my stance clear.
Lately, things have been smelling quite fishy, after all……
m500531.そんで、お前って何ができんだっけか？\n一層で見せた夢だの洗脳だのは要らねぇぞ。:
And what exactly can you do?
We don't need any of that dream-inducing or brainwashing nonsense you showed off earlier.
m500531.ちょっともったいないかもー？\nすんごい魔剣とか作れそうなのにー。:
That seems like a bit of a waste, don't you think?
You could probably make some pretty awesome magic swords out of it.
m500531.つってもこの島の連中も鍛冶師ばっかりだしな。\n結局は売らずに自分たちで加工すん:
But the folks on this island are all blacksmiths anyway.
They'll probably just process it themselves instead of selling it.
m500531.つまり今回も一件落着、ですわね？: So, this time, the crisis is averted, then?
m500531.ですが、例の如く反撃機能も持っていそうですよね……。: That said, they seem to be equipped with a counterattack function, just like before……
m500531.どうやら彼らは一種の狂騒状態にあるらしい。\n僕が導くまでもなく、すでに夢の中と:
It seems they're in a state of frenzy.
They're already lost in a dream, whether I guide them or not.
m500531.はぁああっ！？ んなもんどうやって倒すんだよ！？: Wha-what?! How are we supposed to defeat him then?!
m500531.はぁああ！？ あれも動くんなら最初に言いなさいよ！？: Wha-what?! If they move, you should have said so from the start!
m500531.はい、査定が済んだら遠征費だけ頂戴して、\n残りは全て島の復興財源に当てる予定で:
Yes. Once the appraisal is complete, we will only take the expedition costs.
The rest is planned to be allocated to the island's reconstruction fund.
m500531.まさか、あの二体の魔神が手を組んだと……！？: You don't mean the two Demon Gods have joined forces...!?
m500531.もう二度と、苦しみに目を覚ますこともない。\n今はただ安らかに、ゆっくりと眠りた:
You shall never again awaken to suffering.
Now, rest in peace, and sleep gently.
m500531.んあ？ また珍しいやつが顔を出したもんだな。: Huh? Another odd one shows up.
m500531.ウルカノか、ちょうど良かった。\n君にも関係のある話なんだが──:
Vulcano, good timing.
This concerns you as well, you see──
m500531.シャルロットさん？\n今日は来客の予定は入ってな──ひゅっ。:
Charlotte?
There's no one scheduled to visit today, though──huh?
m500531.フールフール、そしてモラクス。\n君たちにも覚えのある名前のはずだ。:
Foofour, and Morax.
You should recognize those names.
m500531.フールフール沈黙！ モラクスも行動停止しました！: Foofour has fallen silent! Morax has stopped moving as well!
m500531.レームノス島は世界でも随一となる工芸品の名産地、\nこの島の文化と伝統を失うわけ:
Raemos Island is renowned worldwide for its craftsmanship!
We cannot allow its culture and traditions to be lost!
m500531.上等だ、宝石野郎も鹿頭もまとめて材料にしてやらぁ！: Perfect! I'll turn both the gem merchant and the deer-head into materials!
m500531.亜神ヒュープが仲間になっ、たー！: The Sub-God Hupe has joined our team!
m500531.亜神ヒュープが本格的な助力を約束しよう。\n半端はしない、眠りの神の名に懸けてだ:
The Sub-God Hupe promises to provide full-fledged assistance.
I will not hold back, I swear it by the name of the God of Sleep.
m500531.人類の盾となった誇り高き魔神よ、\n君の永き夜はこのヒュープが預かる。:
O proud Demon God who became the shield of humanity,
this Hupe shall watch over your eternal night.
m500531.今ここで、終わらせるんです！: We'll bring it all to an end here and now!
m500531.今のモラクスに手を出してはいけません！\nありとあらゆる攻撃が跳ね返されてしまい:
Do not engage the current Morax!
Every attack will be deflected!
m500531.僕の島がうるさくなるのは困るんだけどね……。: I'd prefer my island not become so noisy, though……
m500531.労働環境とか見直した方が良いんじゃねーか？:
Maybe you should look into improving the working conditions?
--- scene: Ultra Extreme Grade (battle, route) ---
m500531.反撃のフールフールと、反射のモラクスか。\nさて、ボクたちの戦術がどこまで通用す:
Counterattacking Foofour and reflecting Morax, huh.
Let's see how far our tactics can go…
m500531.叶うならば各個撃破をしたかったところですが、\nやはり二体は連携しながら動いてい:
I would have preferred to take them down one by one,
but it seems they're coordinating their movements.
m500531.命を燃料に無理やり盾の力を増幅させているんです！\nあんな状態、長時間維持できる:
He's forcibly amplifying the shield's power using life force as fuel!
There's no way he can maintain that state for long!
m500531.奴のためにも、私たちがここで死ぬわけにはいかんな。: For his sake, we cannot afford to die here.
m500531.実はレームノス島には僕の隠れ家もあるんだよ。\n少し前からそこで休暇を取っていた:
I actually have a hideout on Lamnos.
I've been taking a bit of a vacation there recently, but...
m500531.少なくとも、この洞窟由来のものではないよ。\nおそらくは何処かに魔界の門が開かれ:
That's certainly not originating from this cave.
It's likely that a gate to the Demon Realm has been opened somewhere.
By whoever summoned the Demon Gods to this island.
m500531.心を失いし悲しき魔神よ。\nせめてその散り際、ヒュープが見届けよう。:
O sorrowful Demon God who has lost his heart.
At the very least, let Hupe witness your final moments.
m500531.想像するまでもなく地獄みたいな状況ですわね……。: I can only imagine how hellish the situation must be...
m500531.感謝するよ。道中の案内は僕が担当する。: Thank you. I'll handle the navigation along the way.
m500531.我々の全滅が先か、モラクスの自滅が先か。\nここからは我慢勝負というわけですか。:
Whether we are annihilated first, or Morax destroys himself.
It seems this is a battle of endurance.
m500531.戦いを司る神々には及ばずとも、\n僕も荒事が苦手ってわけじゃない。:
While I may not match the gods who govern war,
I am not exactly averse to a bit of rough work either.
m500531.新たな敵勢反応！ 結晶の中から追加の眷属が出現！: New enemy signatures! Additional minions are emerging from the crystals!
m500531.時間がなくてね、悪いけど邪魔をするよ。: I'm pressed for time, so forgive the intrusion.
m500531.最後まで油断しない！ 念には念を──: Don't let your guard down until the very end! Better safe than sorry──
m500531.決まりのようですね。王子、出撃の許可を。: It seems we're all in agreement. Prince, do we have your permission to deploy?
m500531.洞窟内部の瘴気も徐々に薄まっていますね、\n魔神が倒れて魔界の門も閉じられたよう:
The miasma inside the cave is gradually dissipating.
It seems the Demon God has fallen, and the gate to the demon world has closed.
m500531.王国から南東の海に浮かぶ大きな島ですね。\n神話や伝承にまつわる逸話が多く残され:
It's a large island in the sea to the southeast of the kingdom.
It's rich in myths and legends, and it's said to be a popular tourist destination bustling with scholars and pilgrims.
m500531.王子、難しい注文にはなりますが、\n火力の出し方には気を付けてくださいよ！:
Prince, I know this is a difficult request, but
please be careful with how you deploy your firepower!
--- scene: Ultra Extreme Grade ---
m500531.現在レームノス島は存亡の危機にある。\nこれは亜神ヒュープからの正式な依頼だ、\:
Lamnos is currently on the brink of destruction.
This is a formal request from Demi-God Hupe.
Please, I ask for your cooperation in subduing the Demon Gods.
m500531.眠るには静かでいい場所だよ、\n魔神さえいなければの話だけどね。:
It's a peaceful place to sleep,
assuming no Demon Gods are around, that is.
m500531.行きましょう、王子。\nフールフールとの長き因縁、\nそしてモラクスの苦しみを─:
Let's go, Prince.
Our long-standing feud with Foofour,
and Morax's suffering──
m500531.首は冗談にしても、骨ぐらいは拾ってやりますかね。\n墓でも建てればちょっとした名:
I was joking about the head, but we could at least gather his bones.
If we build a tomb, it might even become a tourist attraction.
m500531.首を獲って柱にでも吊るそうかしら？: Shall we take his head and hang it from a pillar?
m500531.魔神フールフール、魔神モラクス。\n両者の完全消滅を確認とのことです。:
Demon God Fulfur and Demon God Moloch.
We have confirmed the complete annihilation of both.
m500531.（さようなら、おとぎ話の優しい魔神──）: (Goodbye, gentle Demon God of the fairy tale──)

m920019.……っと、そういえば自己紹介が遅れました。\n私はくぐつ使いのリッカと申します。:
...by the way, I realized I never introduced myself.
I'm Rikka, a Masked User.
m920019.あ、ドワーフたちが連れている\n機甲兵に遠距離攻撃タイプがいます！: Oh, the armored soldiers the Dwarves brought have a ranged-attack type!
m920019.あなたたちが機甲兵の封印を解いたの\nですか？ \n知識がない人が扱うには危険な:
Did you break the seal on the armored soldiers?
It's something dangerous for those without knowledge…
m920019.あの女性……。\nいや、機甲兵……でしたか。:
That woman...
No, it was an armored soldier...right.
m920019.あの機甲兵はいままで出てきた\n機甲兵と違って保存状態がよくないみたいです。: That armored soldier looks less preserved than the ones we've seen before.
m920019.あの魔物たちも機甲兵に\n追われていたみたいですね。: It seems those goblins were also being chased by the armored soldiers.
m920019.あれは人間にみえるけど兵器です！: It looks human, but it's a weapon!
m920019.ええい！ 力ずくでも連れて行ってやる！: Damn it! I'll force you to go!
m920019.おい！ お前くぐつ士と言ったな。\nあの機甲兵が言うことを聞かなくなった！: Hey! I called you a “cave-walker,” didn't I? That armored soldier stopped obeying!
m920019.お前たちも機甲兵を狙った侵入者じゃな！\nこの洞窟に立ち入る事は許さん！:
You're also intruders after the armored soldiers!
We won't let you set foot in this cave!
m920019.くぐつ使い……？ 初めて聞く職業ですね。: Masked User...? That's a profession I've never heard of.
m920019.くぐつ士として、機甲兵たちを\n暴走させるわけにはいかないんです……！: As a rogue, I can't let the armored soldiers go berserk…!
m920019.くっ……、魔物たちに見つかったようです。: Damn… we've been spotted by the goblins.
m920019.ぐぅぅ……。言うことを聞かなくなった\n機甲兵たちが迫っておるというのに……！: Ugh… even though the armored soldiers that won't listen are closing in…!
m920019.ぐぬぬ、お前さんなんとかしろ！\n今すぐ洞窟の奥に来るんじゃ！: Ugh, you… fix this! Bring them deeper into the cave right now!
m920019.ここが洞窟の入り口ですね。\n内部はどうなっているのでしょうか……。:
This must be the entrance to the cave.
I wonder what's inside...
m920019.この魔力は……！\n王子……、聞こえますか？: This magical energy...! Prince... can you hear me?
m920019.こんな危ない代物、二度と使わん。\n今後は機甲兵を見つけても\n触らないようにす: We won't use such dangerous things again. From now on, even if we find armored soldiers, we won't touch them.
m920019.じゃが、この場所はわしらの聖域。\nもう用は済んだじゃろ。早く去ってくれんか。: But this place is our sanctuary. Our business here is done. Please leave quickly.
m920019.そうだ！ あなた方はかなり\n腕がたつようですし、\n調査を手伝ってくれませんか:
That's it! You all seem pretty capable,
so would you help with the investigation?
m920019.その機甲兵とはなんですか？: What exactly is this armored soldier?
m920019.そりゃ……こんな暑い中で動かしてたら、\n熱暴走を起こすに決まってるじゃないです: Well… if you run them in this heat, they're bound to overheat, right…!
m920019.それに、あの人たちは……。\nドワーフですか？:
And those people…
Are they Dwarves?
m920019.それにこの洞窟はわしらの聖域……。\nここで見つけた物をどう使おうとわしらの勝手:
Besides, this cave is our sanctuary…
Whatever we find here, we'll use as we see fit!
m920019.それにこの熱気で、兵士たちの\n体力が奪われてしまいます！: And this heat saps the troops' stamina!
m920019.それに調査の途中であの機甲兵を\nろ獲できたら、私も戦力に加わる事ができます！:
And if we can capture one of those armored soldiers
mid-investigation, I can add it to my forces!
m920019.と……とにかく攻撃してくる以上、\n迎撃しましょう！:
Anyway, since it's attacking,
let's intercept it!
m920019.どうかお願いです。\n機甲兵を封印状態に戻してください！:
Please, I beg you.
Seal the armored soldiers again!
m920019.なんでこんな暑い中で、暑苦しいおっさんに\n連れて行かれなきゃいけないんですか！: Why do I have to be taken by some sweaty old man in this heat!?
m920019.なんとか今回の騒動は収まったみたいですね。\n暴走した機甲兵が洞窟の外に出ずに済: It looks like we've managed to settle this incident. I'm really glad the berserk armored soldiers didn't make it out of the cave.
m920019.なんとか倒すことができましたね……。: We managed to take them down, after all…
m920019.にわかには信じがたいですが、\nそんなものがあの洞窟に……！？:
Hard to believe at first glance,
but something like that in that cave...!?
m920019.ふぅ……。\nなんとかなったみたいですね。:
Phew...
Looks like we managed to get through.
m920019.もう一度言う。\nこの洞窟に立ち入る事は許さん。:
I'll say it again.
You're not allowed in this cave.
m920019.もし制御不能になって洞窟の外に出たら、\n大変な被害を出す存在になってしまいます:
If they go out of the cave uncontrolled,
they could cause massive damage...
m920019.やっかいな物を目覚めさせて\nしまったようですね……。: Looks like we've awakened a troublesome creature...
m920019.わしらが先に見つけたのじゃ！\n横取りは許さん！:
We found them first!
We won't let you steal them!
m920019.ゲゲッ！ オマエタチハ……。\nソコヲドケッ！！:
Heh heh! You guys…
Take this!!
m920019.ドワーフさんたちがこの洞窟を\n守ってくださるのなら安心ですしね。: As long as the Dwarves keep guarding this cave, we'll be safe.
m920019.ドワーフにびびってなんかいられません！\n先に進みましょう、王子！:
We won't be scared off by Dwarves!
Let's move forward, Prince!
m920019.ドワーフに見つかる前に調査を終わらせて\nこの洞窟から出たいものですが……。: I'd like to finish our investigation and get out before the Dwarves find us…
m920019.ドワーフは機甲兵たちがこっちに\n来ていると言っていましたね。: The Dwarf said the armored soldiers are coming this way.
m920019.フン！\nわしらの一族に伝わる文献で知ったんじゃ。:
Hah!
We learned it from the ancient texts of our clan.
m920019.リッカさんは機甲兵の事になると、\n熱くなるようですね。: You really get fired up when it comes to the armored soldiers, don't you, Rikka?
m920019.二つの勢力から追われる身になってしまうとは……。\n王子、どうにかここを突破しま: To be chased by two factions… Prince, let's find a way to get through here!
m920019.今後、残された機甲兵を\n悪用しようとする人たちが来ても、: Even if people come later trying to misuse the remaining armored soldiers,
m920019.今後お前たちを見つけたら\n侵入者として攻撃する。良いな？:
If we spot you again,
we'll attack as intruders. Got it?
m920019.兵器！？ 確かに言われてみると、動きが\n人間のそれとは違うかもしれませんが……:
A weapon!? Now that you mention it, its movements
might be different from a human's...
m920019.向こうからドワーフたちの\n大声が聞こえてきましたね……。: I can hear the Dwarves shouting from over there…
m920019.封印を解かれた機甲兵たちは、\nほとんど壊れちゃったみたいですね……。: The sealed armored soldiers seem to have been mostly destroyed after the seal was broken...
m920019.強大な魔力を感じます。\nどうやら、今回の騒ぎで炎獣が\n目覚めてしまったようで: I sense a tremendous magical power. It seems the disturbance awakened a fire beast.
m920019.性能は劣化しているようですが……。\n手強い事に変わりはないので気をつけてくださ: Its performance is degraded, but it's still just as tough—so stay on guard.
m920019.恐らくドワーフの後に機甲兵たちが\n攻めてくるはずです！: Likely they'll attack right after the Dwarves.
m920019.我々だけで扱おうとした機甲兵が\n暴走して襲ってきたんじゃ。: The armored soldier we tried to handle on our own went berserk and attacked us.
m920019.文献をかじっただけの\n素人が触っちゃだめなんです……！: Amateurs who only skimmed the texts shouldn't be touching them...!
m920019.新たに封印を解いた機甲兵たちで\nこの洞窟から締め出してくれる……！: The newly unsealed armored soldiers will drive you out of this cave…!
m920019.早く原因を調査して、\n機甲兵たちを止めないと……。:
We need to investigate the cause quickly
and stop the armored soldiers...
m920019.暑い……。\nどうやらここが洞窟の最深部みたいですね。: It's hot… Looks like this is the deepest part of the cave.
m920019.暴走していたからとはいえ、\nかわいそうな事をしてしまいました……。: Even though they went berserk, it's still a shame what happened...
m920019.最悪のタイミングでドワーフにも\n見つかったようですね……。: And just at the worst time, the Dwarves found us too…
m920019.最深部までは後少しですね。: Just a little farther to the deepest part.
m920019.機甲兵は知識を持ったくぐつ使いが扱わないと、\n些細なことで制御不能になってしま:
If a knowledgeable Masked User doesn't operate them,
they can become uncontrollable over the slightest thing.
m920019.機甲兵を研究して扱う\n機甲兵の専門家です。:
I'm a specialist who studies and handles
armored soldiers.
m920019.残りの体力に注意しながら\n戦ってください！: Watch your remaining HP and fight carefully!
m920019.気をつけて！ あれは機甲兵です！\nあなた方に攻撃してきます！:
Watch out! That's an armored soldier!
It's attacking you!
m920019.洞窟からでてきたあの女性は一体……。\n魔物たちを攻撃しているように見えますが…:
Who is that woman who came out of the cave...?
She seems to be attacking the White Goblins, but...?
m920019.王子、機甲兵の調査は終わりました。\nこの洞窟から出ましょう。: Prince, the investigation of the armored soldiers is complete. Let's leave this cave.
m920019.王子、機甲兵は大変危険な存在のようですね。\n敵を洞窟から出すわけにはいきません:
Prince, armored soldiers seem extremely dangerous.
We can't let the enemies escape the cave.
m920019.王子、魔物です！\n迎撃の準備を！:
Prince, White Goblins! 
Prepare to intercept!
m920019.王子ミツケタ。ココデコロス……！: Found you, Prince. You'll die here…!
m920019.王子！ 炎獣が発する熱で暴走を起こした\n機甲兵たちが、こちらへ向かっているよう: Prince! The heat from the fire beast has caused the armored soldiers to go berserk, and they're heading this way.
m920019.王子！ 魔物です！\n戦闘の準備を！:
Prince! It's a White Goblin!
Prepare for battle!
m920019.知っているのだったら、\n危険性もわかるでしょ……？: If you know that, you should also understand the danger…?
m920019.私たちもこの洞窟から出て王城に戻りましょう。: Let's get out of this cave and return to the royal castle.
m920019.私たちも調査を手伝いましょう。: We'll help with the investigation too.
m920019.簡単にいうと、古代の人たちが作った\nと言われている、自動で動く兵器ですね。:
Simply put, it's an automated weapon
said to have been created by ancient people.
m920019.見つからないように\nそーっとそーっと進みましょう。: Let's move quietly so we don't get spotted.
m920019.誰かが機甲兵の封印を解き、\n暴れさせているようです……。:
Someone must have broken the seal on the armored soldiers
and set them loose...
m920019.離れた所から攻撃してきますから\n気をつけてください！: They'll be attacking from a distance, so watch out!

m920050.……名残惜しいですが、日が落ちるまでに\nはぐれた本隊を探さなくては。: ...It's a shame, but we have to locate the main force that got separated before sunset.
m920050.……帝国への忠誠に曇りがあってはならない。\nわかった。お前の気が済むようにする:
...Our loyalty to the Empire must never waver.
Understood. I'll see to it that you're satisfied.
I'll keep the captain's seat open so you can return whenever you wish.
m920050.……気持ちはとても嬉しい。\nですが、今は考える時間が欲しいのです。:
...I'm very touched.
But I need time to think right now.
m920050.……目的の為ならば、手段は選ばないと\nいうことですか！？: …So if it's for the goal, you'll use any means necessary!?
m920050.……雑魚が。仕方ない。こうなったらこちらで\n片付けるぞ。住民を無闇に傷つけたく: …These pests. It can't be helped. If it comes to this, I'll deal with them myself. I don't want to recklessly hurt the civilians. Call the Pegasus Knights!
m920050.……！ あれが敵、ですか。\n彼らは魔物たちと戦っている小国の生き残りでは……。:
…! Is that the enemy?
Are they the surviving remnants of a small nation fighting the monsters…?
m920050.あなたたちの裏切りが帝国に知れれば\n国に残った家族や友人の身が危うい。\n愛す:
If your betrayal reaches the Empire, the families and friends left behind will be in danger.
I can't let the ones I love be lost.
m920050.あなたたちも、付き合ってくれてありがとう。\n団員は速やかに帝国に戻りなさい。:
Thank you all for going along with this.
Members, return to the Empire at once.
m920050.あなた方がどなたかは存じませんが、\nその風貌。どこかの国の兵士とお見受けします:
I don't know who you are,
but from your appearance, you look like soldiers from some nation.
m920050.ありがとう。あなたたちも元気で。: Thank you. Stay well, all of you.
m920050.いかにも。我々は白の帝国の軍である。\nそちらから出向いてくれるとは好都合だ。:
Indeed. We are the army of the White Empire.
It's convenient that you came forward.
m920050.いずれ帝国を脅かす存在となる者たちだ。\nそうなる前に倒すことが帝国を守ることに:
They'll become those who threaten the Empire someday.
Eliminating them now protects the Empire.
m920050.おやめください！\n万が一のことがあれば、命を落としかねません。\nそんな危険な:
Please stop!
If anything goes wrong, you could lose your life.
We don't need to take such a risk...
m920050.くっ、手強い……。\nそろそろ本気を出した方が良さそうですね。\n飛べ！ イカロ:
Damn, you're tough….
Looks like it's time to get serious.
Fly! Icarus!
m920050.この先は民家になっています。\n急ぎ迎撃致しましょう！: There are houses ahead. Let's hurry and intercept!
m920050.この程度の戦力ではダメか。\n黒の軍団と天馬騎士団との合流を\n優先するほかない: This force is insufficient. We have to prioritize linking up with the Black Legion and the Pegasus Knights.
m920050.これは我が軍の問題です！\n自分たちでケリをつけなければなりません！\n皆のもの: This is our army's problem! We must settle it ourselves! Everyone, follow me!
m920050.さすが……というべきか。\n一旦後退する。態勢を整えるぞ。:
As expected… I should say.
We'll fall back for now and regroup.
m920050.そうすれば我々は大人しく帝国に\n戻ってやる。: Then we'll quietly return to the Empire.
m920050.そうだ。お前が黒の軍団を快く\n思っていないのは知っている。\nゆえに、本隊とは:
Yes. I know you're not fond of the Black Legion.
That's why I kept them separate from the main force.
m920050.その前に決着をつけようと\n我らがやってきたのだ。: That's why we came to settle this once and for all.
m920050.その時に我が帝国の最も邪魔になる存在。\nそれがお前たちと言うわけだ。: At that point, the biggest obstacle to our Empire will be… you.
m920050.それでは、帝国に戻り、\n私たちは貴国と戦う意思はない、と\nお伝えください。: Then return to the Empire and tell them we have no intention of fighting your nation.
m920050.それでは王子、\n城に戻りましょう。:
Then, Prince,
let's return to the castle.
m920050.それでも、どうか我々も一緒に……！\n私たちにとって、騎士団の団長は\nあなただ:
Even so, please let us stay with you...!
To us, the captain of the order is only you!
m920050.それにしても、先ほどの戦いぶりは見事でした。\n戦士たちの個々の能力はもとより、:
Nevertheless, your performance just now was splendid.
