Beyond each warrior's abilities,
your command is truly extraordinary.
m920050.それよりも先ほど『白の帝国』と\n言われていましたが……。: Moreover, you just called yourselves the 'White Empire'…
m920050.だからこそ、強い相手がいると\nつい自分の力を試したくなってしまって、\n皆さん:
That's why, when faced with a strong opponent,
I can't help but want to test my strength,
and I challenged you all.
m920050.ちょ、ちょっと待ってください！\n腕試しならばもう十分なのではないでしょうか。:
W-wait a moment!
Isn't a sparring match enough already?
m920050.できることなら、\n共に魔物に立ち向かいたい……、と。: If possible, I'd like to stand together against the monsters…
m920050.ですが、その魔物の力を利用するという考えに、\n私は疑問を感じるのです。\nこの: But I have doubts about using the monsters' power. Until that doubt is cleared, I cannot return to the Empire.
m920050.どうか私の代わりに皇帝陛下の御身を頼みます。\nこれはあなたたちにしか頼めません:
Please, on my behalf, entrust yourselves to His Majesty the Emperor.
I can ask no one else but you,
the Pegasus Knights of the White Empire.
m920050.どうやら魔物に捕まっているようです。\nすぐに助けましょう！！: It seems they're captured by monsters. Let's rescue them right away!!
m920050.なぜ帝国が王子を狙っているのですか！？\n今は人間同士が争っている場合ではありま:
Why is the Empire after the Prince?!
Now isn't the time for humans to fight each other!
m920050.ならば私たちもお手伝い致します！\n事情はどうあれやはりここは協力を……。: Then we'll help as well! No matter the circumstances, we must cooperate here…
m920050.ふふっ。確かに今は魔物たちのせいで\n人間同士が戦っている場合ではない。\nしか:
Heh. You're right—thanks to the monsters, now isn't the time for humans to war.
But what happens after we drive the monsters away?
m920050.まさか白の帝国のものだったとは……。: I never imagined they'd be from the White Empire...
m920050.まずは先ほどの非礼をお詫びいたします。: First, I apologize for the earlier rudeness.
m920050.まだ魔物と戦う軍隊が残っていたとは……。\n……なるほど面白い。申し訳ありません:
I didn't expect any troops still fighting the monsters…
…Interesting. My apologies, but may I
observe your skill for a moment?
m920050.もう兵力も残っていない。\n……頼む。私はどうなっても構わない。\nだが、部下の: We're out of troops now. …Please. I don't care what happens to me. But could you at least save my subordinates' lives?
m920050.もしよろしければご協力致します。: I'd be glad to help if I can.
m920050.やっと追いつきました！\n見たところ戦いはすでに\n終わってしまったようですが…: We've finally caught up! It looks like the battle's already over…
m920050.やれやれ。せっかく鎧の手入れを\nしたばかりだというのに……。: Good grief. I just polished my armor, and now this...
m920050.よし。黒の軍団を出せ。: Very well. Deploy the Black Legion.
m920050.イザベルさん、お話とは一体……。: Isabelle, what exactly is this talk about...?
m920050.イザベルさん、先ほどの任務というものは\nどのようなものですか？: Isabelle, what exactly was that mission you mentioned earlier?
m920050.イザベルさん。\n経緯はどうあれ、我が軍はあなたを歓迎します。:
Isabelle.
Regardless of the circumstances, our forces welcome you.
m920050.了解、しました。\n……それが、皇帝陛下のご意思ならば……、\n私はそれに従うま:
Understood.
…If that's His Majesty the Emperor's will…
I will obey…
m920050.今はまだ勢力としては小さいが、\nしかし必ず我が帝国の覇道を\n脅かす存在となる: You're still small now, but you'll inevitably become a threat to our imperial destiny…!
m920050.仕える主を変えようというのですよ。\nむしろそれくらいの危険と覚悟がなくては意味:
I'm trying to change the lord I serve.
In fact, without that level of danger and resolve, it means nothing.
m920050.全軍、進め！ この先にある神殿と、そこを拠点と\nしている帝国に敵対する者たちを: All units, advance! Destroy the temple ahead and the rebels using it as a base against the Empire!
m920050.団長……。わかりました。\n私たちは、団長が無事に戻られる日を信じております。:
Captain... Understood.
We believe the day you'll return safely will come.
m920050.団長を置いてそんなことできません！\n我々も残ります！:
We can't do that without the captain!
We will stay as well!
m920050.報告します！ 領内に魔物が侵入！: Report! Monsters have breached the territory!
m920050.報告！ 前方に敵影！ こちらに接近しています。: Report! Enemy sighted ahead! They're closing in!
m920050.報告！ 前方に魔物を多数確認！: Report! We've confirmed a large number of monsters ahead!
m920050.多くの国が滅びた今、世界の覇権を\n手にするのはそう難しくない。: With so many nations fallen, seizing world dominance isn't that hard.
m920050.天馬騎士団も到着した……、\nそろそろだな。:
The Pegasus Knights have arrived…
It's about time.
m920050.実は私も任務の内容までは\n聞かされていないのです。: Actually, I haven't been told the specifics either.
m920050.待ってください！ あなた方は\n白の帝国の軍隊ですか？: Wait! Are you soldiers of the White Empire?
m920050.必ず皇帝陛下に伝えよう。: I'll be sure to report it to His Majesty the Emperor.
m920050.我々の負けのようだな。\n黒の軍団が暴走し、さらにそれを抑えるために\n兵力を消: It seems we've lost. The Black Legion went berserk, and we wasted troops trying to suppress them… What a pathetic story.
m920050.我々を魔物と見間違えているわけでは\nなさそうだな。: Looks like they aren't mistaking us for monsters after all.
m920050.我がままにお付き合いいただいて\nありがとうございました。\n私は今日から王子に:
Thank you for indulging my whims.
I promise to pledge my loyalty to the Prince from today.
m920050.我が帝国と皇帝陛下の御為に、\nそこの王子の首を差し出してもらおう。:
For the sake of our Empire and His Majesty the Emperor,
hand over that Prince's head.
m920050.戦いに慣れているからこそ生き残れたというのは\n皮肉な話ではあるが……。: It's ironic that they've survived precisely because they're accustomed to battle...
m920050.戦いに負けた上に情けまでかけられるとはな……。\nこれ以上ない屈辱だが、\n敗者: To lose the battle and still be shown mercy… That's the ultimate humiliation, but the loser must obey the winner.
m920050.敵軍にいた白い鎧の兵士たち……。\n嫌な予感がするな。: Those white-armored soldiers in the enemy ranks... I have a bad feeling.
m920050.是非我が帝国軍に加わっていただきたいです。\nいえ、加わるべきだと思います。:
I would very much like you to join our imperial forces.
No, I think you should join.
m920050.来たか。実は魔物が急に反抗を始めた。\nすまないが、それを止めてくれ。: You're here. Actually the monsters suddenly started rebelling. Sorry, but I need you to stop them.
m920050.極秘任務とだけ通達があり、\n現地に着くまでは誰にも知らされません。: All we were given was that it's a top-secret mission, and no one knows anything until we reach the site.
m920050.残念ですが、部外者に任務の内容を\n話すことは軍則により禁じられております。: I'm sorry, but military regulations forbid us from sharing mission details with outsiders.
m920050.王子！ 前方に天馬騎士団が……！: Prince! The Pegasus Knights are ahead…!
m920050.王子！ 敵は魔物ではなく人間の部隊です！: Prince! The enemies aren't monsters—they're a human squad!
m920050.田園の砦を占領しているとの報告が入った。\n生き残った我々で倒しにいくぞ！！: We've received reports that the countryside fortress has been occupied. We'll go defeat them with the survivors we have!!
m920050.白の帝国ですって……！\nちょっとお待ちくださいっ。一体なぜ……。:
The White Empire, you say…!
Hold on a second. Why on earth…?
m920050.白の帝国とは、\n一言で言えば軍事国家みたいなものだ。\n戦いによって発展し、戦: The White Empire is basically a militaristic state. It grew through war and exists for war.
m920050.白の帝国はこの地よりはるか遠くに存在する、\n我ら人間最後の希望なのです。:
The White Empire lies far beyond these lands,
the last hope of humanity.
m920050.白の帝国をご存じなのですか？: Do you know about the White Empire?
m920050.皇帝陛下の御旗の下に、\nこの力を振るえる身であることを誇りに思い、\n日々鍛錬:
Under the Emperor's banner,
I take pride in wielding this power,
and train daily.
m920050.祖国が魔物に滅ぼされ、敗残兵だった自分に\n天馬騎士団として戦いの場を与えて下さ: My homeland was destroyed by monsters, and as a defeated soldier I was given a place on the battlefield as a Pegasus Knight. I'm grateful for that.
m920050.私はこの帝国軍の騎士であり、\n天馬騎士団の団長を務めています。:
I am a knight of this imperial army,
and serve as commander of the Pegasus Knights.
m920050.私はまだ本気で、王子たちと戦ってはいません。\nもし本気の私に勝てたら、\nその:
I'm not yet fighting the Prince seriously.
If you can defeat the real me,
then I promise to pledge my loyalty to the Prince.
m920050.私は白の帝国の騎士、名をイザベル！！: I am a knight of the White Empire, known as Isabelle!!
m920050.私は皇帝陛下にお仕えする、\n白の帝国の騎士イザベルと申します。:
I serve His Imperial Majesty,
I am Isabelle, a knight of the White Empire.
m920050.聞きたいことは勝利してから聞いてやる。\nまずは帝国の敵を打ち倒せ！！:
I'll answer your questions after we win.
First, crush the Empire's enemies!!
m920050.腕試しをしましょう。もし私に勝てたら我が帝国の\n傭兵として雇って差し上げます。: Let's spar. If you can defeat me, I'll hire you as a mercenary for my empire.
m920050.行ってしまいましたか……。\nそれにしても王子。\nまだ魔物と戦っている国がある:
She's gone...
And Prince, it's reassuring to hear that there are still countries still fighting monsters.
m920050.軍師どの……。\nお気遣い、感謝いたします。:
Strategist... 
Thank you for your concern.
m920050.軍師どの。私は……帝国には戻れません。: Strategist, I… I can't return to the Empire.
m920050.軍師どの！ 魔物が命令を聞きません！\nこのままでは住民に被害が……。:
Strategist! The monsters aren't obeying orders!
If this continues, the civilians will suffer…
m920050.返答はすぐにとは言いません。\nこの地での任務が終わったら、立ち寄らせていただき:
I won't demand an answer right away.
After your mission here ends, I'll stop by.
Until then, please make up your mind.
m920050.遅かったな。\n……さてお前たち。敵は目の前だ。\n今こそその翼で敵を蹴散らせッ:
You're late.
…Well then, you there. The enemy is right before us.
Now is the time to drive them back with those wings of yours!!
m920050.魔物ども！\nあくまでも標的は王子とそれを邪魔する者たちだ！\n人間に手出しする: Monsters! The target is the Prince and anyone who gets in his way! We won't allow you to lay a hand on humans!
m920050.魔物の撃退を確認しました。\n王子、お疲れ様です。:
The monsters have been repelled.
Prince, good work.
m920050.魔物の群れが暴れていると聞いてきたのですが……。\nどうやら倒された後のようです:
I heard a horde of monsters was running rampant…
It seems they've already been dealt with.
m920050.魔物はここで食い止めましょう！\n王子、戦闘の準備を！:
Let's stop the monsters here!
Prince, prepare for battle!
m920050.黒の軍団……っ！？\nあの魔物共を連れてきたのですか……っ！:
The Black Legion…?!
You brought those monsters with you…?!
m920050.（……よかった。）\nもしよろしければ、詳しいお話を\nお聞かせくださいませんか:
(...Thank goodness.)
If you don't mind, could you tell me the details?
m920050.（しまった。つい熱くなってしまいましたね。）\n確かに。久しぶりに手強い相手に出:
(Damn, I got too heated.)
Indeed. It's been a while since I've faced such a tough opponent, and I got carried away.

m920067.――ええッ！？ また時空の門が開いてる！？\n……そ、そっか、師匠の力を使えば何: —What!? Another temporal gate opening!? …I see, using my master's power we can open the gate as many times as we want… Damn it.
m920067.――えッ！？\nい、今……そいつ何て言ったんだ！？\nおい、ちょっと待てよ！ な: …Wha-!? What did he just say!? Hey, wait a minute! Hey!
m920067.――ぐッ……はぁ、はぁッ……なんて、強さだ。\nいったい、貴様は……何者なんだ…: Guh… huff, huff… such strength. Who on earth are you…? Why are you attacking our kingdom?
m920067.――それでは王子、\n過去のお前を殺しに行くとしよう。\n我は100%勝てる戦い:
Then, Prince,
let me go back and kill your past self.
I only fight battles I can win 100%… Heh heh.
m920067.――はぁ……ハァ……ぐゥ、ぅぅッ……。\nそんな、ばかな……我は、時を超越した…:
—Ha… Haa… Guh… uhh…
How… impossible… I am the Chrono Demon, one who transcends time…
m920067.――グハハハ！ 待っていたぞ王子よ！\nその様子を見るに、どうやら我は\n過去の:
――Guhahaha! I've been waiting for you, Prince!
Judging by how you look, it seems I failed to assassinate the past Prince.
m920067.――何者だ貴様ら！？\n……なるほど、人間どもの増援か……。\nクロノデーモン様: ――Who are you, you fools!? …I see, reinforcements for the humans… I won't let Chrono-Demon be disturbed!!
m920067.――報告ッ！\n魔物の軍勢が、これまで以上の数で\n王都へ向け、進軍しているとの: —Report! The monster army is marching toward the capital in greater numbers than ever before…
m920067.……………………………………。\nおかしいな、過去の王子たちめ、\nいつまで我を: ……………………………………. Strange… those past Princes… how long will they keep me waiting?
m920067.………………行っちゃったね、アンナさん。\nデーモンはまた時空の門を使って過去へ: ………………She's gone, Anna… The demon used a temporal gate to jump back to the past… We have to hurry, too…
m920067.……うぉぉぉおおおッ！！！\n力が湧いてくるぞ！\nうぬらも感じるか、この燃える: …Whoa!!! The power is surging! Can you feel it too, this burning magic?
m920067.……うん！ わかった！\n師匠から教わったいろんなこと、\n王子の為に役立ててみ:
…Yeah! Got it!
Everything you taught me, Master, I'll put to use for the Prince's sake!
m920067.……う～ん、まだ辿り着けてないのかもしれない。\nはっきりとは分からないけど、慣:
…Hmm, maybe we haven't reached it yet.
I can't say for sure, but until we get used to it, we might not be able to jump properly.
m920067.……え？ \nで、でも私……まだまだ未熟だよ？\nそれでもいいの……？:
…Eh?
But I… I'm still so inexperienced.
Is that okay…?
m920067.……ぉぉぉおおおっ！ 感じますッ！\n熱いほどの力が身体中を駆け巡ってます！\n: …Whoa! I feel it! A scorching power races through my whole body! With this, I could even beat the Prince… Ahh!?
m920067.……ぐ、偶然に決まってる！\nこの山賊頭モーティマの名が\n世に広まってたって事:
…It was just a coincidence!
My name, Mortimer the Bandit Chief, must've spread around!
m920067.……さあ帰りましょう、王子。\n私達が戦うべき世界に。:
…Come on, let's go back, Prince.
We'll return to the world we're meant to fight in.
m920067.……はぁ、ハァ……よ、ようやく過去へと\nくることができたか――って、何ぃっ！？: …huff, huff… Finally made it back to the past—what the—! Everything's already over!
m920067.……ん？ ああ～っ！？ 見て見て王子！\n洞窟内の召喚獣も正気に戻ったみたいだよ: …Huh? Ah—! Look, Prince! The summoned beast in the cave seems to have regained its senses!
m920067.……アンナちゃん、これから様々な事があると\n思うけど、貴方が仕える人は、何があ: Anna-chan, many things will happen from now on, but whoever you serve will always protect you, no matter what. So… keep pushing forward.
m920067.……何も喋らない男の子……。\nおそらく、王子で間違いないでしょう。: …A boy who doesn't speak at all… He must be the Prince, no doubt.
m920067.……全軍、至急撤退の準備をしてください。\n東西に散開して逃走し、敵の追撃を避け: …All units, prepare to withdraw immediately. Scatter east and west, escape the enemy's pursuit, and head toward the forest leading to the Goddess's temple.
m920067.……彼奴は魔界へと還っていったのじゃ。\nこれ以上の追撃は意味を成さんじゃろうて: …He's returned to the demon realm. Pursuing him any further would be pointless…
m920067.……王子の反応が薄いのは、\n子供の時から変わらないのですね。: …Your reaction's still as flat as it was when you were a child.
m920067.……行ってしまいましたね。\nでは、私達も仲間のもとへ戻りましょうか。: …She's gone, isn't she? Then, shall we return to our comrades?
m920067.あ、あれは！？\nヴァンパイアロードと死者の王！？\n確かに滅ぼしたはずなのに…: Ah, what's that!? The Vampire Lord and the King of the Dead!? I was sure we'd destroyed them…
m920067.あっちが戦ってるドサクサにまぎれて\n忍び込むよ！: While they're busy brawling over there, we'll slip in unnoticed!
m920067.あの……もう、行っちゃうの……？\nお礼もまだしてないのに……。: Um… are you really leaving already? We haven't even thanked you…
m920067.あの……もしよければ、これからも、\n私達の仲間として行動を共にしませんか？\n:
Um… if you don't mind, would you continue to act with us as a comrade?
We need your power, Kokoro-san.
m920067.あの伝説の魔神を退けられたというだけでも\n奇跡という他ありませんね。: Even just repelling that legendary demon god is nothing short of a miracle.
m920067.ありがとうございます。\n貴方たちが仲間になってくれたら……、\n彼らはすごく感: Thank you. If you join us, they'll be immensely grateful.
m920067.あれは、デーモン……！？\nしかし、顔が半分人間の様にも見えますが……。:
That… is the Demon…!?
But its face looks half human…
m920067.あんなに強い魔神をやっつけちゃうなんて、\n王子はすっごいんだね！ 見直しちゃっ: You took down such a powerful demon god—you're amazing, Prince! I've got a whole new respect for you♪
m920067.あー、くっそ……頭がクラクラするぜ……。\n時をさかのぼるってのは気持ちわりぃも: Ah, damn… my head's spinning… Going back in time feels sickening. Geez, no matter how many times I try, I can't get the hang of it.
m920067.いえ、ここは王子の城の前よ。\n約１０年ほど前の……王子のお城……。\n魔物たち: No, this is the castle in front of the Prince… about ten years ago… before the monsters revived. We've ended up in that era.
m920067.いかにも。\n我は時空を操る力を持つ魔術師を、\n我が身に取り込んだからな。:
Indeed.
I have absorbed a sorcerer who can manipulate time and space into myself.
m920067.いまも兵士さんたちが戦ってくれてるんだけど、\nぜんぜん歯が立たなくて……\nだ: The soldiers are still fighting, but they can't make a dent… That's why I came to call for help!
m920067.いや、失礼。\nさすがは伝説の英雄の子孫！ 実に健気だ！\nいいだろう、英雄らし: Ah, my apologies. As befits the descendant of a legendary hero—how noble! Very well, die like a true hero, sword in hand!
m920067.う、ぐぁぁあッ……。\nそんな……ばか……な…………。\n完璧な計画……だった…:
Ugh… Gah…
How… foolish…
It was supposed to be a perfect plan…
m920067.うぅ……魔力がカラッカラで、\nもう一歩も歩けないですぅ……。: Ugh… my magic's completely drained, I can't even take another step…
m920067.うるせぇ！\n誰にだって勘違いはあらぁッ。\nいったん退くぜぇ！:
Shut up!
Everyone makes mistakes.
We'll retreat for now!
m920067.うるっさーーーーーいッ！\n過去は変えてはいけないものなの……。\nそれがどんな:
So annoying!!!
The past isn't meant to be changed… no matter how painful or tragic it was.
m920067.うん、アンナは王子様にお仕えするの！\nお父様と約束したんだもん！: Yeah, Anna will serve the Prince! I promised Dad!
m920067.ええ、私たちがきっと助けて見せます。\nそれじゃあ、王子様の場所まで\n案内して: Yes, we'll definitely save him. So, could you lead us to where the Prince is?
m920067.ええ！？ 拙者らもですか――ってちょっと！\n――うぶッ……ふご……ゴクリ、ゴク: What!? You want us to… wait a second! — *gurgle* …
m920067.えっとね……お城の中に、\nとつぜん魔物たちがあらわれたの！: Well… monsters just appeared inside the castle!
m920067.え！？\nあの子、王子様だったの？\nじゃあ、なおさら助けに行かないとだめだよ！: What!? That kid was the Prince? Then we have to rescue him even more!
m920067.お、王子……。\nここは我らが王城ではありませんか……？: Oh, Prince… Could this be our royal castle…?
m920067.おい、その子供をつれていくってのか？\nムチャだ、危険すぎるぞ！: Hey, you want to take that child with you? That's reckless, far too dangerous!
m920067.おい、ちょっと待てハリッサ！ あそこ見ろ！\nありゃデーモンだ。とてもじゃねえが: Hey, hold up, Harissa! Look over there! That's a Demon. There's no way we can take it on—let's run!
m920067.おぉ？ そりゃお安い御用だぜ！\n本当ならおめえらに殺されてたって\nおかしくね: Oh? That's a piece of cake! Honestly, you'd have been dead by now. I'll gladly help.
m920067.おそらく子供のころの王子を\n狙っているのでしょう。\nぐずぐずしていられません: He's probably targeting the Prince as a child. No time to dither—let's move!
m920067.おのれ……。\nこれでは過去にきた意味がないではないか！？: Damn… This makes my trip to the past pointless!
m920067.お待たせしました、ココロさん。\nさぁ、行きましょう！: Sorry to keep you waiting, Kokoro. Come on, let's go!
m920067.お頭見てましたかい？\nあいつら魔物を全部倒しちまいやがった！:
Hey boss, you see that?
We took out all those monsters!
m920067.き、気合いだッ！ 気合いで、\n魔神の力を我が物とするのだぁぁッ！\nゆくぞぉ！: This is… spirit! With spirit, we'll claim the Demon God's power! Let's go!
m920067.きゃぁ～ッ！！\n魔物たちが追ってくるー！\nだ、誰か、助けてくださいぃー！: Kyaa—!! The monsters are after us—! Someone, please help—!
m920067.くそっ……。\n魔物どもめ……、一体どれだけ倒せば……！\n王子、ここは私達が引: Damn it… Those monsters… How many must we slay…! Prince, we'll keep holding this ground!
m920067.くっ……。\n……つまり、我は過去の王子達がここを通る\n時間よりだいぶ前の時点: …So that means I've ended up at a point far earlier than the time the past Princes will pass through!
m920067.ぐわあああっ！？\n身体から炎が溢れて……熱ッ、熱ぃぃいっ！！: Gwaaah! My body's overflowing with flame… It's so hot, so hot!!
m920067.こ、これでも全力で走っているのですよ……。 \nしかし、デーモンが時空を超えるな: I—I'm doing my best to run, you know… But the idea of a Demon crossing time… it's hard to believe.

Demon, deal with them.

Mortimer,

Come forth, minions of darkness!

Y-yes…

Do your best to entertain me in the next race.

Well, that is, if you can manage it.
Hehehe.

Until the final race,
if you don't come in last I'll let you go.
I've taken all your tech, and you were useless anyway.

m920092.流石の乗りこなし……見事なものでしたね。: As expected, your handling was superb—truly impressive.

the goblins barged in, and there might be more traps set.

Prince, about the goblins.

m920108.おうとも、弟よ！\n各地の防衛に戦力を割き過ぎたせいで、\n肝心の都を守りきれぬ: That's right, little brother! Because we spread our forces too thin defending everywhere, we can't protect the capital—those fools!
m920108.おかげさまで『風水尺』もたくさん集まりましたけど、\nまだ回収してないのが落ちて: Thanks to you we've gathered a lot of ‘Feng-Shui rulers', but we can't be sure we've collected every single one, so just in case they're misused again…
m920108.お二人とも……ありがとうございます。\nそれでは、まずはこの地が邪仙の手に落ちな:
Both of you… thank you.
First, let's make sure this land doesn't fall into the Jōsen's hands.
Please continue to focus on its defense.
m920108.お前たちには失望した。\nこれからは己の力だけで道を追求する。:
I've been disappointed in you.
From now on, I'll pursue the path with only my own strength.
m920108.お前は――妖天君！\nそっか、わかったぞ！ \nお前らの狙いはこの山を覆う大地の: You… Yotenkun! I get it! Your aim is the earth's qi that blankets this mountain!
m920108.お願いします。\nそれでは皆さん、急ぎ参りましょう！: Please. Everyone, let's move out quickly!
m920108.くぐつではない、これは我らの宝貝（パオペエ）だ。\nなァ、兄者？:
???: It's not a thing, it's our treasure (Paopee).
Come on, brother?
m920108.くっ……この屈辱、必ず雪がせてもらうぞ！\n貴様ら全員、灰となるまで灼き尽くして: Damn… I'll make sure this humiliation is repaid in snow! I'll scorch you all to ash!
m920108.くっ……東天君、いつの間に。: Damn… East Sky Lord, since when?
m920108.くッ……外道め。\n仲間を盾にして逃げるとは。:
Damn… you scoundrel.
Using comrades as a shield to flee.
m920108.くッ……強い。\n人間如きが、これほどの域に達するとは……。: Ugh… strong. To think a mere human could reach such heights…
m920108.ぐぬぅぅッ……おのれ、太公望ッ！\nかくなる上は、貴様を巻き添えにして――: Grrr… You, Taigong Wang! Since it's come to this, I'll drag you down with me—
m920108.ぐぬぅぅッ……もう辛抱ならん！\n道士ども、出陣だ！\nワシの『烈焔陣』で灰にさ: Grrr… I can't hold back any longer! Taoists, to battle! If you don't want to be turned to ash by my “Flame Formation,” then step back!
m920108.ぐぬぬぬ……こうも早く来るとは計算外ですねェ。\nですが、これ以上私たちの邪魔は: Gnununu… I didn't expect you to arrive so quickly. But you won't get in our way any longer!
m920108.ぐぬぬぬぬぬ……て、撤退ですねェ！\n都の中枢は依然我ら邪仙郷の支配下、\nあの: Gnununun… retreat, then! The heart of the capital remains under our Evil-Immortal Village's control; those three won't take it back so easily.
m920108.ここは……天狗山？\nそれじゃあ、迅天君が言っていた\n重要な土地っていうのは…: This is… Tengu Mountain? So the “important land” Jinten mentioned must be…
m920108.この国がなくなるかもしれないって時だもんね。\nわかった。私たちも人間たちに手を:
This is a moment when the kingdom might vanish, right?
Got it. We'll lend a hand to the humans too.
And we'll avenge our fathers as well.
m920108.この地に拠点のひとつを設けるつもりだったけど、\nいまは一旦退くのが賢明のようだ:
I was going to set up a base here, but
it seems wiser to retreat for now…
m920108.ご、ごめんなさい……。\nでも、近くで急に邪気が増したのを\n『風水尺』が感知し: I-I'm sorry… But the Feng-shui meter just picked up a sudden surge of evil energy nearby.
m920108.しくしく……うぅ……邪仙たちが、\n華の国の、わたしの故郷を襲って……、\nひっ: Sniff… sob… The Evil Immortals attacked the Land of Flowers—my hometown… and then… they moved on to the Eastern Kingdom…
m920108.す……すごい。\n神仙郷の仙人様たちが助けに来てくださるなんて。\nこれならきっ: A-amazing. The immortals of Shenxian Village are coming to help. With this, we can surely defeat the evil sages!
m920108.す、すみません、出過ぎた真似を。\nでも、戦いではお力になれないかわりに、\n少: I-I'm sorry for overstepping. I may not be able to help in battle, but I want to be of any use to you all, even just a little…
m920108.すまないねぇ、見せ場を与えてやれなくてさ。\nさぁコヨミさんとやら、早く村を渡し: Sorry about that, couldn't give you a proper showdown. Come on, Koyomi, get us across the village quickly. I hate being late.
m920108.すまぬ……天狗山は邪仙どもの手に落ちてしまった。\n我らも防戦したのだが、多勢に:
I'm sorry… Tengu Mountain fell into the hands of the evil sages.
We tried to defend it, but we were outnumbered…
m920108.すみません、コヨミさん。\nトドメを刺すことができず……。: I'm sorry, Koyomi. I couldn't finish them off…
m920108.そ……そう簡単にやられるもんですか！\nこれでも私はこの村を守る陰陽師――: N-no, you can't just take me down that easily! I'm still the onmyōji protecting this village—
m920108.そうですね……守勢に回るばかりではなく、\nどこかで危険を冒しても攻勢に転じなけ: Indeed… we can't just stay defensive; we have to turn the tide, even if it means taking a risk somewhere. Let's get our preparations in order first.
m920108.そうですね。\nカゲロウさん、次に私たちが救援に向かうべきは――: That's right. Kagerou, the next place we should go to for reinforcement is—
m920108.そうとも。この地の龍脈を流れる膨大な気は\n我ら邪仙郷の覇業を支える糧とさせても:
Indeed. The vast qi flowing through this land's dragon veins will
be the sustenance for our evil-sage ambitions.
With that, a tiny country like this is a piece of cake! Right, brother?
m920108.そうならないように、急いで次の場所に向かいましょう。\nメイファさん、引き続き案: Then let's hurry to the next location so that doesn't happen. Mei-Hua, could you keep guiding us?
m920108.そうはさせません！\n王子、彼らを撃退し、天狗山を奪還しましょう！:
I won't let that happen!
Prince, let's drive them off and retake Tengu Mountain!
m920108.そうよ。私とクーコもそれぞれ雷神と風神の娘ってわけ。\n……でも、聞けば父ちゃん:
That's right. Kuuko and I are each daughters of the Thunder God and the Wind God.
…But, from what I hear, our fathers were just… that Yotenkun fellow…
m920108.そして何を隠そう、我らは血を分けた双子の兄弟！\nそう、二人合わせて――超頂兄弟:
And let's not hide it—we're twin brothers who share the same blood!
Together we are— the Super-Top brothers!!
m920108.その、わたし……まだ修行中の身なんですけど、\n風水士としての筋がいいって、\n: Um, I'm still in training, but my master often says I have a good knack as a feng shui master, and—
m920108.そも、先刻送り出した尖兵たちが\nうぬの言う鬼の小娘どもに敗れておるのだ。\n敵: Besides, the vanguard we sent out earlier was defeated by those demon girls you mentioned. Since the enemy's strength is unknown, a reckless push isn't wise.
m920108.それと、もうひとつは……。\n実は、邪仙たちに奪われてしまった『風水尺』を\n取: And also, there's another thing… Actually, I'd like you to retrieve the “Feng Shui Ruler” that the evil spirits stole…
m920108.それに、今頃アイツらがこの村よりも\nよほど重要な土地を落としている頃だろうしな: Besides, those guys are probably already taking even more important land elsewhere. —All right, everyone, retreat!
m920108.それは無理な望みです。\n彼は王子たちに敗れ、本陣から遁走したのですから。: That's an impossible wish. He was defeated by you princes and fled the main camp.
m920108.そんな……っ。\nでしたら、私たちはどうすれば……。: That…! Then, what are we supposed to do…?
m920108.そんな……どうして侵入されたの？\n今朝も術で結界を強化したばかりだったのに。: How… how could they break in? We just reinforced the barrier with spells this morning.
m920108.そんな……死した父様たちの魂パクが\nまた操られるなんて……。\n今の私たちに父: No… the souls of our fallen fathers being used again… We can't stop them now…
m920108.そんなの……わたし、耐えられません。\n村のみんなと作った『風水尺』が悪事に使わ: I can't stand that… The ruler we made with the villagers being used for evil…
m920108.だが、未だ楽観視できる状況とは言えぬ。\n敵が兵力に任せて各地を同時に襲撃してき:
But we still can't be complacent.
Since the enemy is attacking multiple sites with sheer numbers,
the places where their aid is delayed will gradually fall into disadvantage.
m920108.だったら、なおさら邪仙たちには渡さない！\nこの山は昔、みんなで遊んだ思い出の場: Then we mustn't let the evil sages take it! This mountain is a place of our childhood memories…!
m920108.ちょっ……リンドウ。あんまり煽りすぎないでよ？\n敵が本当に本気で来たらマズいし: Hold on… Rindou. Don't tease them too much, okay? If the enemy really comes at full force, it'll be trouble… And you're tired from the earlier fight, right?
m920108.ったく……ほら、さっさと邪仙郷に戻るわよぉん！\nもう一度態勢を立て直さないとい:
Geez… let's hurry back to Jasenkyō!
We need to reorganize our forces!
m920108.ったく、誰がクマだっつうの。\nおい嬢ちゃん、怒らねえからなんでも話してみな？: Good grief, who's calling me a bear? Hey, little one, I won't get angry—just tell me anything.
m920108.って、ちょっと！ どこ行くのよ！\nアイツ、言いたいだけ言って、逃げちゃうわよ！: Hey, wait! Where are you going! He'll just say whatever he wants and run off!
m920108.って、わたしの話はどうでもいいんです。\nええと、王子様にご相談したかったのはで: Anyway, my story isn't important. What I wanted to ask the Prince about is…
m920108.っと、思い出したでござる。\n殿、これは邪仙たちが持っていた物でござるが……。:
Ah, I just remembered.
My lord, this is something the evil sages were carrying…
m920108.で、でしたら、このままの勢いが続けば\n邪仙たちを東の国から追い出せるんですね？: So if this keeps up, we can drive the Jasenkyō out of the Eastern lands, right?
m920108.で、でしたらわたしも、もっと頑張ります！\n『風水尺』が邪仙たちの悪事に使われる: Then I'll work even harder! If I can stop the Feng Shui Ruler from being used for the evil sages' deeds… I'll do anything!
m920108.でしたら、そちらへ向かえば邪仙の攻勢に\n苦戦している味方の許に辿り着けそうです: In that case, if we head that way we should be able to reach our allies who are struggling against the evil spirits' assault. Mei-Hua, could you guide us?
m920108.ですが、一時的にでも司令塔を失ったことで\n敵軍の指揮系統が乱れ始めることは必至: However, even a temporary loss of the command tower will inevitably cause the enemy's command structure to start unraveling.
m920108.ですが、尊天君の周囲を取り巻く砂の守りは堅牢無比。\nあらゆる守りを貫くような攻: However, the sand defenses surrounding Sonten are unmatched. Only an attack that can pierce any defense will break through; half-hearted strikes won't work. Be careful.
m920108.でも……あの迅天君ってヤツ、\n今頃仲間が別の地を落としてる頃だとか言ってたわね: But… that Jinten guy said his comrades are probably already taking other lands now.
m920108.ということは……この国は守られたのね。\n王子、みんな……本当にありがとう。:
So that means… the country is safe.
Prince, everyone… thank you so much.
m920108.とにかく助けに行きましょう！\n王子、ご指示をお願いします。: Let's go rescue her! Prince, give us orders.
m920108.ど……どうしても戦わなければいけないのでしょうか？: Do… do we really have to fight?
m920108.どこも形勢逆転してるよ。\n指揮官からの司令が届かないっつって、\n邪仙どもの軍: Everywhere the tide's turned. The commanders can't get through orders, so the Jasenkyō troops are in total chaos.
m920108.どのみちお前ら人間に都を明け渡すつもりはない。\nこの都には俺たちの前線基地を置: Either way, we have no intention of handing the capital over to you humans. We'll set up our forward base here, and eventually occupy the whole country.
m920108.な……どこへ行くつもりだイ？\nまさか、裏切るつもりじゃ……。:
W-where do you intend to go?
You don't… intend to betray us, do you…?
m920108.なに、王子殿が渡来の珍しい物差しを\n集めていると風の噂で聞きましてな。\n世の:
I heard rumors that Your Highness collects rare measuring tools from abroad.
In this world, we're supposed to help each other.
m920108.なにを言う皇天君、ここからが本番ではないか。\n死力を尽くしても尚、破れぬ壁に直:
What are you saying, Imperial Heavenly Lord? Isn't the real battle just beginning?
Now that we've faced an unbreakable wall even after giving our all, it's precisely the moment a path opens to strength beyond our limits.
m920108.なにッ！？\n王子たち、なぜここが？: What!? Princes, why are you here?
m920108.なんて言ってる場合じゃないでしょ。\n早く防戦してる人たちを助けにいかなきゃ！: This isn't the time for chatter. We have to rush to help those defending the front!
m920108.なんとか撃退はできましたが、\nまんまと足止めされてしまいましたね……。: We managed to drive them back, but we've been completely stalled…
m920108.ぬぐわぁあああッ！？\nあ……兄者ッ！ こいつら、できるぜぇッ！！:
Nguwaaah!?
Ah… brother! These guys, we can do it!!
m920108.は……はひっ！\nええと、邪気が強まっているのは……あっちです！: I… I! Uh, the evil energy's stronger over there!
m920108.は、早まるな狛天君！\nいまヤツと刺し違えたとて邪仙郷の為にはならぬ！\n此処は: Hold your horses, Komaten! Even if we clash now, it won't help Jasenkyō. We should retreat for now and regroup.
m920108.はぁ、はぁ……頑張って、ラミィ。\nもうすぐ王子たちが来てくれるはずだから……。: Haa, haa… Hang in there, Ramii. The Prince should be here soon…
m920108.はぁっ、はぁっ……。\nシズカ様、余りご無理をされては……。: Haa… haa… Shizuka-sama, please don't push yourself too hard…
m920108.ひぃぃッ！ \nな、なんですか、この変な人たちは？:
Eek!
W-what are these weird people?
m920108.ひぃぃッ！ く……クマさんですかっ！？: Eek! Is... is that a bear!?
m920108.ひぃいッ！ も、もうぶたないでくださいぃ！: Eek! P-please, don't bite me anymore!
m920108.ひえッ！ すすす、すごい邪気ですぅ！\nひょっとして、この怖そうな人が……。:
Eek! Such a terrible evil aura!
Could it be that this scary person…?
m920108.ひとまず天狗山は奪還できたのです。\nいまは反撃よりも、防衛線の再構築を優先しま:
For now we've reclaimed Tengu Mountain.
Now we should prioritize rebuilding the defenses rather than counter-attacking.
m920108.ふぅん、訳ありみたいね。\nお嬢ちゃん、王子にどんな用かしら？: Hmm, seems there's a reason. Little girl, what do you need from the Prince?
m920108.ふぇっ！？ \nそれは――風水尺！\nどうしてそれを……？:
Huh!? That's— a Feng-Shui ruler!
Why… why do you have it?
m920108.ふぇっ？ \nあ……あなたが噂の王子様ですか？: Huh? …Ah, so you're the famed Prince?
m920108.ふぎゃッ！\nふぇぇ……どうしてぶつのさぁ。:
Agh!
Ugh… why did this happen…
m920108.ふふ、ありがとうございます。\nお疲れのようですし、後は我々にお任せください。: Hehe, thank you. You look tired, so leave the rest to us.
m920108.ふふ、大丈夫ですよ。\n魔物は退治しましたし、私たちは味方ですから。\nね、王子: Hehe, it's all right. We've slain the monster, and we're on your side. Right, Prince?
m920108.ふふっ、なに遠慮してるの？\nほら……おいで、フーコ。\n久しぶりにギュ～ッてし:
Heh, why the hesitation?
Come on… here, Fuuko.
Let me give you a big hug after all this time.
m920108.ふふふ……王子、待っていたぞ。\n初めての逢瀬に臨む娘のように、\nお前が来るの: Heh heh… Prince, I've been waiting. Like a maiden awaiting her first rendezvous, my heart has been racing for your arrival.
m920108.ほう……なかなか勇ましいではないか。\nだが、口でどう言おうが行動に移さねば無意: Hmm… quite bold. But words mean nothing unless you act on them.
m920108.ほ～う、元気になってきたじゃねえか！\n最初に見たときはずっとオドオドしてたのに: Huh, you're getting lively! When I first saw you, you were all timid.
m920108.ぼくら神仙郷の仙人も\n東の国の防衛に手を貸そうと思ってね。\n困った時はお互い: We, the immortals of Shenxian Village, thought we'd lend a hand to defend the Eastern lands. When trouble comes, we help each other—that's how it works.
m920108.ま、それも計算通りですが、解せませんネェ。\n各地の民を見捨てて都の守りに専念し: Well, that was part of the plan, but it's unsatisfying. If we'd abandoned the provinces and focused on defending the capital, we might have lived longer.
m920108.ま、待たぬか狛天君！\n……くっ、忍耐を知らぬ狂犬めが……。: Then don't keep us waiting, Komaten! …Ugh, you wild dog who knows no patience…
m920108.まぁいい。\n奴らとは再び戦うことになるだろう。\nその時が来たら、全力で相手を: Well, that's fine. We'll meet them again someday. When that day comes, I'll give them everything I've got.
m920108.むぅ……もう少し早く奇襲に気づいていれば……。\n残念ですが、ここは放棄するしか:
Hmm… if only I'd noticed the ambush a bit sooner…
Unfortunately, I have no choice but to abandon this place.
m920108.やりましたね、王子。\n……ええ、わかっています。\nご協力してくださった多くの:
We did it, Prince.
…Yes, I understand.
It's thanks to the many who lent their aid.
m920108.よしよし……ただいま、フーコ。\n……さて、私が家を出て旅をしてた間に\nいろん:
There, there… welcome home, Fuuko.
…Now then, while I was out traveling,
things seem to have changed a lot.
m920108.わかりました。\n王子、急ぎ救援に――: Understood. Prince, we must hurry with the rescue—
m920108.わたし……できることはなんでもします。\nですから、どうか……どうかお願いします: I'll do anything you ask. So please… please help me!
m920108.んな怖がらねえでも大丈夫だっつうの。\n取って食ったりはしねえんだからよ。: Don't be scared, it's fine. I won't go around snatching and eating you.
m920108.アハハッ！ やれるもんならやってみなさぁい！\nアチキら三人が全力で相手してア・: Ahahaha! If you think you can, give it a try! The three of us will go all out against you—A-GE-RU♪
m920108.アンナさん！ それに他の皆も！\n助けに来てくれたのね……！: Anna-san! And everyone else! You came to help…!
m920108.イヤダ、返サナイ！\nコレデモ、喰ラエ！: No way, I won't give it back! I'll eat you with this too!
m920108.ギャギャッ！ \nカッコイイ物差シ、拾ッタ！\nコレデ、ニンゲン、タオス！: Grrr! I found a cool ruler! With this, I'll take down humans!
m920108.ククク……流石は太公望、目ざといですねェ。\n然らば、華の国の仙人、十天君が一人:
Kukuk… as expected of Taigong Wang, sharp as ever.
Then, the Immortal of the Flower Kingdom, one of the Ten Heavens—Futen-kun—shall we make our entrance?
m920108.クックック……卑劣とは心外ですねェ。\n戦においては勝利こそが正義。\nそのため:
Kukuk… calling it vile is unexpected.
In war, victory is justice.
For that, any means are justified, you know?
m920108.クックック……滑稽ですネェ。\n本陣は既に落ちたというのに、\n未だ無意味な抵抗: Kukukuku… how amusing. The main camp has already fallen, yet you keep up this meaningless resistance.
m920108.クーコ姉様！\n今までどこに行って――:
Kuuko-senpai!
Where have you been all this time—?
m920108.グファアアァッ！！\nえ、淵天君からの連絡さえ来ておれば……ッ！: Gufaaaar!! If only we'd gotten a message from Fuchiten…!
m920108.コイツさえあれば東の国の占領もあっという間だ。\nいやぁ、文明の利器ってのは素晴: With this thing, occupying the Eastern Kingdom will be a breeze. Ah, the wonders of civilization's tools.
m920108.サイゾウさん、\nこのあたりで苦戦が予想される地域は？: Saizou, which areas around here are likely to see heavy resistance?
m920108.シズカ様……拙者も最後までお供しますぞ！: Shizuka-sama… I will stand by you to the very end!
m920108.チッ、たかが村ひとつと侮りすぎたか。\nまぁいいさ。こんな村くらい、いつでも落と: Tch, I underestimated a single village. Whatever. A place like this falls any time.
m920108.ナタク、口車に乗ってはなりません。\n敵はこの会話の間にも陣形を整えつつあります:
Nataku, don't fall for his smooth talk.
The enemy is already arranging their formations even as we speak.
m920108.ヒィイッ！ こ、こんなはずでは……。: Hii! This… wasn't supposed to happen…
m920108.ヒッ……も、もうほとんどの部隊がこの国から\n撤退していて、残るはキミたちだけな:
Heh… almost all the troops have already pulled out of this country, leaving only you behind.
Please, think of the future of Jasenkyō—
m920108.フッ、怯えて言葉も出んか。\n無様な死に様を晒したくなければ、\n大人しく山を下:
Huh, you're too scared to even speak.
If you don't want to show a pathetic death,
just calmly descend the mountain.
m920108.フハハハハ！ 教えてやろう、娘よ！\n私は華の国の仙人、十天君が一人の超天君！\:
Hahaha! Let me tell you, daughter!
I am the immortal of the Flower Nation, the one called Choten-kun!
Wielder of the treasure “Earth-Raging Formation,” which commands the earth's wrath!
m920108.フハハハハ！ 笑止ッ！\nたかが数人の兵になにができる？ なァ兄者！: Fuhahaha! Ridiculous! What can a handful of soldiers possibly do? Come on, brother!
m920108.フフ、これを見た後でも\n同じことが言えるかナ……ホホイッ！: Heh, after seeing this, can you still say the same…? Hoho!
m920108.フン。邪仙の品格を落としたのは、兵力で勝りながら\nこの程度の小国も落とせなかっ: Hmph. The ones who have tarnished Jasenkyō's dignity are you, who could win battles with sheer numbers yet couldn't even topple this little nation.
m920108.ホホッ、完全に心が折れたみたいだネェ。\n安心するといい。そのまま大人しくしてい:
Hoho, looks like your spirit's completely broken, huh.
Relax then. If you just stay quiet, I'll send you to the same place as your fathers…

m920108.勝手なことを言わないで！\n私たちの国を貴方たち邪仙の好きになんかさせないわ！: Don't make such reckless claims! We won't let you evil immortals take our country!

m920108.姉ちゃんに一言も告げずに\n勝手に家を飛び出した罰だ！\n……すっごく心配したん:
You ran off without telling your sister a word—
that's your punishment!
…I was really worried, you know?
m920108.当然だ。我らの野望を阻む者は排除する。\nそれが誰であろうとな。: Of course. Anyone who stands in the way of our ambition must be eliminated, no matter who they are.
m920108.彼が戦線に現れたら、速やかに撃退してください。\n対応が遅れれば甚大な被害を被る:
If he appears on the front lines, take him down quickly.
Delay will cause massive damage.
m920108.悪いねぇ陰陽師さん、頑張りを無駄にしちまって。\nこの『風水尺』で結界の薄い箇所: Sorry, onmyōji, I wasted all your hard work. I just used this “Feng Shui Ruler” to sniff out the thin spots in the barrier.
m920108.愚物めが。淵天君の司令がなければ何もできぬか。\nあの小娘どもを葬れば村まであと: Fool! Without Fuchiten's orders we can do nothing. If we bury those girls, the village will be within reach…!
m920108.承知いたしました。\n王子、淵天君の動きにご警戒ください。:
Understood.
Prince, stay on guard for Futen-kun's movements.
m920108.敵に奪われた御城の前では、十天君でも上位の\n実力者たちが防衛にあたっていると思:
In front of the castle the enemy seized, even the Ten-Heaven Lord can't hold it—top-tier fighters are defending it.
We have to retake it no matter what… damn it!
m920108.既に我が忠勇なる諸将、十天君率いる精鋭たちが\n各地の要衝を占領する準備を整えた: Our loyal and brave generals, the elite led by Juten-kun, have already prepared to seize the strategic points across the lands. You, on the other hand, are simply too late.
m920108.本陣に控える前線指揮官を叩くことで\n敵の指揮系統を乱し、各地に展開する軍を混乱:
By striking the frontline commander stationed at the main camp, we'll disrupt the enemy's command chain and throw their scattered forces into chaos.
…That was the plan, wasn't it, Taigong Wang?
m920108.村のことは任せてちょうだい。\n王子、他の仲間たちを頼んだわよ！:
Leave the village to me. Prince, I've got the others covered!

m920108.東の国も一歩、平和に近づいたってわけやな！: So the Eastern lands are one step closer to peace!

Futen-kun.
Among the Ten Heavens of Jōsen Village, he's the greatest schemer,
and the very one who once used vile plots to bring down Shenxian Village.
m920108.然して聞くがいい、俗界の愚者どもよ。\n我ら邪仙郷は、ここに東の国に対する戦を宣: Listen well, fools of the mortal world. We, the Jasen Realm, hereby declare war on the Eastern Kingdom!
m920108.父ちゃんたち、覚悟してよね！\n可愛い妹たちをいじめるヤツは\nたとえ父親でも許:
Dads, get ready!
Anyone who torments our cute little sisters—
even if they're fathers—won't be forgiven!
m920108.物差しで？\nいったい何事ですか、その状況は？: With a ruler? What on earth is happening?
m920108.王子、ここからが正念場です。\n城壁の中にいるという十天君の三人を倒し、\n占領:
Prince, this is the decisive moment.
We'll defeat the three Ten-Heaven Lords inside the walls and retake the occupied capital.
--- scene: The Final Battle of the Eastern Kingdom ---
m920108.王子、この地はあてとリンドウに任せて、\n早く都にいる人たちを助けに行ってあげて: Prince, leave this land to Lindou and hurry to rescue the people in the capital!
m920108.王子、敵軍の統率が乱れている今が好機です。\n敵の攻勢に怯まず、ここで敵将を討ち: Prince, now that the enemy's command is in disarray is our chance. Let's strike down their commander without fear.
m920108.王子らの軍が如何に精強であっても、\n兵力で劣る我らは、このままでは……。: Even if the Prince's army is incredibly strong, we, who are outnumbered, will… if we keep going like this.
m920108.申し訳ありません、私がついていながら……ッ。\n妙なくぐつに乗った二人組が、異様:
I'm sorry, even though I was with you…!
Those two on the strange… thing were unusually strong…
m920108.皆さん、この度は本当にありがとうございました。\nそれでは王子、帰還いたしましょ:
Everyone, thank you truly for everything.
Now then, Prince, let's return.
m920108.皆さん、兵卒の動きに惑わされ過ぎぬようご注意を。\n淵天君の得意とする『棺氷陣』:
Everyone, be careful not to be misled by the troops' movements.
His signature “Coffin Ice Formation” attack will freeze all enemies on the battlefield—truly terrifying.
m920108.私は華の国の仙人、十天君が一人の頂天君！\n豪炎の刃で万象を貫く『紅刺陣』の使い:
I am the immortal of the Flower Nation, the one called Chouten-kun!
Wielder of the “Crimson-Piercing Formation,” which pierces all things with blazing blades!
m920108.私は通天教主。邪仙郷の指導者にして、\nぬしらが邪仙と呼ぶすべての者たちの長よ。: I am the Tsuten Kyoushu, leader of the Jasen Realm and the chief of all you call Evil Immortals.
m920108.統率を欠いた二将の率いる軍を攻めることで、\n我々は漁夫の利を得られるかもしれま: By attacking the armies led by those two disorganized generals, we might reap the benefits of a fisherman's luck. Mei-Hua, that's a commendable feat.
m920108.見損なったぞ、尊天君。\n勇猛と名高い鬼の一族とはいえ、\nたった二人の小娘に恐: You've missed the mark, Sonten. Even though they're famed for their bravery, the demon clan cowers before just two little girls.
m920108.話は後。二人とも、よく頑張ったね。\nあとはお姉ちゃんたちに任せなさい。:
We'll talk later. You both did well.
Leave the rest to your older sisters.
m920108.豊富な気が流れる龍脈が多数存在する\nこの国を第二の邪仙郷とすることが、\nアチ: With so many dragon veins flowing rich qi, turning this land into a second Evil Immortal Village is our ultimate goal… Hehe!
m920108.超頂兄弟、私の『棺氷陣』での攻撃が途切れぬよう、\n周囲を巡回し、敵の攻撃から私: Super-top brothers, you'll patrol around me so my “Coffin Ice Formation” attack never stops, protecting me from enemy strikes! See, if you do exactly as I say, everything will go smoothly!
m920108.道士たちよ、ヤツらの相手をしてやれ。\nだが、功を焦ろうとは思うなよ。\n我らの: Priests, take on those foes. But don't rush for glory. Our immediate goal is to hold them off.
m920108.道士たちよ、私の撤退を支援しなさい。\n邪仙郷の勝利のため、将を守る盾となりて死:
Priests, support my retreat.
For Jōsen Village's victory, become the shield protecting the general and die.
m920108.邪仙たちの攻勢に押されていた、\n各地の戦線もじきに持ち直すだろうね。\nぼくた: Being pressed by the evil immortals' offensive, the battlefronts across the lands will soon recover. Let's seize this chance and turn it into a counter-attack.
m920108.邪仙たちはおそらく、『風水尺』で東の国の\n地中を流れる気の通り道――『龍脈』を: I think the evil spirits plan to use the ruler to locate the dragon veins—the flow of qi beneath the Eastern Kingdom—and harness that power for their invasion.
m920108.邪気が増した……ということは、\n邪仙たちが勢いを増した、ということでしょうか？: An increase in evil energy… does that mean the evil spirits are gaining momentum?
m920108.頼りにしてますよ、メイファさん。\nそれでは早速、当地へのご案内をお願いいたしま: We're counting on you, Mei-Hua. Then, please lead us to the area right away.
m920108.（すごい……命がけの戦いの中でも\n誰かのためになることを考えられるなんて。\n:
(Incredible… even in a life-or-death battle, she's thinking of how to help others.
I'm always the one receiving…)
m920108.（わたしももっと、皆さんのお役に立たなくちゃ……！）: (I have to be more useful to everyone…!)

m920141.――そうだ！\n召喚のお勉強も兼ねて、使い魔を呼んで、\n動物を取ってきてもらい:
――That's it!

As practice for my summoning studies, I'll call a familiar and have it hunt some animals! Meat, meat!!

――!! Thank you so much!
I may be inexperienced, but I'll do my best!
m920141.……あ、あの、本当に良いんですか？\nこんな、落ちこぼれデーモンの私なんかを。:
……A-are you really sure about this?
Taking in a drop-out demon like me…

...Why? The procedure was correct.
We summoned powerful demons in stages and offered them as sacrifices.
So why won't it answer? Why, why, why!
m920141.……大丈夫。\n力を使いすぎて気を失っただけ。命に別状はなさそうよ。:
……It's fine.

m920141.……目的は達成した。皆に撤退の指示を。: ……The objective has been achieved. Order a retreat.

Ah, you guys! Please don't come any closer!
If you get close, if you get close, um... it'll hurt!

Ah, you seem... pretty calm...?
P-Please don't bully me~?

Ow, ow, ow...
Geez! If I don't run, they're going to bully me!
m920141.あっち、嫌な感じがします。気をつけてね、王子……。: Over there... I get a bad feeling. Be careful, Prince...

Ah! W-Wait for me!
I'm coming too~! Don't leave me behind~!
m920141.あなた、王子様と一緒に居た子でしょ？\nなんで倒れてるの～？ 大丈夫～？:
You're the one who was with the Prince, right?
Why did you collapse~? Are you okay~?
m920141.あなたはそいつらに騙されているの！\nお願いだから、話を聞いて！:
You're being deceived by them!
Please, just listen to us!
m920141.あの男の動向も気になります。\n王子、ここは彼女たちを迎え撃ちましょう！:
I'm also concerned about that man's movements.
Prince, let's intercept them here!
m920141.あら、王子ならこの子を見捨てたりしないでしょ？: Oh, the Prince wouldn't abandon you, would he?
m920141.あれはまさか、まさかもしや王国軍でしょうか？\n魔王を倒したと道行く人々が噂する:
Could that be… could it be the Royal Army?

That Prince who people say defeated the Demon King!?
m920141.あわわわわ、どうしましょう、近づいてきてます！\nこのままじゃ捕まって、いじめら:
Oh no, oh no, what should we do? They're coming closer!

If we stay here, we'll be caught and bullied!
m920141.いいえ、彼女が応じてくれるなら、\nそのほうが良いですから。:
No, if she is willing to listen,
that would be better.

No, no, no, that's not it!
You're taking me in, feeding me delicious meals,
and I'll be a burden on you for a long time! I-I can't do that!
m920141.いきなり魔神を召喚せず、準備を重ねてきたのも、\nすべてはあなたが確実に魔界へ帰: We didn't rush into summoning the Demon God. We've been preparing for this for a long time, all to ensure you can safely return to the Demon Realm.
m920141.いたたたた……。\nいきなり天使に囲まれて、もう何が何やらです。:
Ow, ow, ow…
I was suddenly surrounded by Angels, and I'm completely dazed.
m920141.うぅ……完全に道に迷ってしまいました。\nちょうどあそこに人がいっぱい……って、:
Ugh… I'm completely lost.
There are so many people over there… Wait, an Angel?!
m920141.うぅぅぅ、何を信じたら良いのかわかりません！: Ugh... I don't know who to believe anymore!
m920141.うっ……ダメ……魔力が……！\n広がって……制御、できません……！:
Ugh… No… My magic power…!
It's spreading… I can't control it…!
m920141.え、エリスさ～ん……。\nやっぱり、ご迷惑ですよ。\nあんな騒動を起こして、居候:
E-Eris-san...
I'm probably causing too much trouble.
After causing such a scene, and staying here as a guest...
m920141.えぇ。ご覧ください、この魔導書を。\nデーモンの敵ならば、こんな物は持っていませ:
Indeed. Please, take a look at this grimoire.

Now then, let us open the gate to the Demon Realm together.

Huh? Oh, thank you...
Is this just another trick to bully me later?!
m920141.おっと、すみません。\n私も彼らには、ほとほと困らされていましてね。:
Oh, my apologies.

I, too, have been quite troubled by them.
m920141.おやおや、どうやら逃げるご様子。\n脱兎のごとく、ですなぁ。:
My, my. It seems they're running away.

Like a hare from a trap, indeed.
m920141.お待ち下さい！ 私はあなたの味方です。\nあなたのような、物質界に取り残されたデ:
Please wait! I am on your side.

I am a friend to demons like you who are stranded in the Material World.
m920141.き、きき、来ましたよ！ あの人たち！: T-they're here! That group of people!
m920141.けど！ 私は魔界へ帰りたいんです！\n邪魔を……しないでください！！:
But! I want to go back to the Demon Realm!
Please... don't get in my way!!
m920141.こ、これから勉強の時間なんです！ 失礼します！: I-I have to study now! Excuse me!
m920141.このままだと、あの子……死んでしまいます。: At this rate, that girl… she's going to die.
m920141.これで一件落着でしょうか。\n王子、此度の遠征、おつかれさまでした！:
I suppose that's a matter settled, then.
Prince, well done on this expedition!
m920141.これは、んっと、翼ある悪魔？\n……えへぇ～いっ！ あっ、うまくできましたです！:
This is… um, a winged demon?

…Hehe, got it! Ah, it worked perfectly!
m920141.これ以上、力を使わせたら彼女が危険です！\n王子、すぐに追いかけましょう！:
If she uses any more power, she'll be in danger!
Prince, let's chase after them!
m920141.ご……ごめんなさい……。\n私、力不足で、魔神を召喚できませんでした……。:
I... I'm sorry...
I wasn't strong enough... I couldn't summon the Demon God...
m920141.ご、ごめんなさい、王子、アンナさん。\n説得する前に、捕まえたほうが良かった？:
I-I'm sorry, Prince, Anna.
Should we have captured her before trying to persuade her?
m920141.ごきげんよう、麗しきデーモン。: Good day to you, beautiful demon.
m920141.ごめんなさい、夜までに、なんとかしますね！: I'm sorry. I'll figure something out by nightfall!
m920141.さぁな。\nだが、俺たちも新たな戦いに備えるべきだろう。:
Perhaps.
But we should prepare for a new battle as well.
m920141.しかし大丈夫です。\n一緒に来れば、彼らに捕まっていじめられたりしません。:
But don't worry.

m920141.して、そちらの首尾は？: So, how did things go on your end?
m920141.じゃ、じゃあ……お話くらいなら。: T-Then... maybe we can just talk.

Sniff, sniff. I smell something suspicious.

It's probably coming from that way.
m920141.せめて最期は安らかにお眠りくだされ。\n貴殿の野望もまた、語られ得ぬ物語。\n後:
May you rest peacefully in your final moments.
Your ambitions will remain an untold story.
Let it pass into legend, becoming a tale for the ages.
m920141.そ、そうなんですか？\nそれは、ぜひお会いしてみたいです！:
R-Really?
I'd love to meet them!
m920141.そうはさせませんよ。さぁ、次はこちらの呪文を。\n強力な魔神の召喚まで、あともう:
I won't let that happen. Now then, try this next incantation.

We're only a little further from summoning a powerful Demon God!
m920141.そう言われると弱いですけど！\nうぅ、エリスさんのいじわる～。\nそこまではっき:
Don't say things like that!
Ugh, you're so mean, Eris-san~.
You didn't have to be so blunt about it!
m920141.それでも許してくださるのなら、\n私はここに、住まわせていただきたいです！:
If you'll still have me,
I'd like to stay here, please!
m920141.それはそれは恐ろしいやり方でね。\nさ、行きましょう。私はあなたの味方ですから。:
In the most terrifying ways, I assure you.

Come, let's go. I am on your side.
m920141.だが、魔界を遠ざけた憎き王国軍が彼女を狙っている。\n悲願達成のため、なんとして:
However, the detested Kingdom army, which has driven the demons far from the Demon Realm, is after her.
We must protect her at all costs to fulfill our long-held ambition!

"Looks like" is a grave insult.
For the people of the Empire to speak so casually of the god they worship…
m920141.で……ですが、あと少しなんです！\n魔神さんさえ召喚できたら、私は帰れるんです！:
B-but, I'm almost there!
Once I summon the Demon God, I'll be able to go home!
m920141.で、ですが、本当によろしいのですか？\nきっと、いっぱいいっぱいご迷惑をおかけし:
B-But, are you really okay with this?
I'm sure I'll be a huge burden on you.
m920141.ですが、今は魔界とのつながりは……。: But the connection to the Demon Realm is…
m920141.とにかく放っておけません。\n被害が出る前に、討伐しましょう！:
We can't just leave it alone.

Let's eliminate it before it causes any damage!
m920141.な……ぜ……？\n魔神は……、我が、悲願は……。:
W-Why…?
The Demon God… my, my lifelong wish…
m920141.な、なんとか、です……。: I… I managed to hold on…
m920141.なんて、ため息ついてちゃダメですね！\n私は魔界へ帰って、立派な悪魔召喚士になる:
Oh, I shouldn't be sighing like that!

I'm going back to the Demon Realm and becoming a proper demon summoner!
m920141.なんて言ってるけど、他に行くあてもないみたいよ。: But it seems you don't have anywhere else to go.

I need to get some meat somehow.

The drafts aside, I can keep the rain out thanks to the Goblin who showed me this hut.
m920141.に、に、逃げなきゃ！\nいやぁ～！ 近づかないでください～！\n王子様ぁ！ どこ:
I-I have to run!
No way~! Don't come near me~!
Prince! Where are you~!? Prince~!!
m920141.に、逃げてください、優しい方……！\nこのままじゃ、私は、あなたたちを……！:
P-Please run, kind one…!
If this keeps up, I'll… I'll hurt you…!
m920141.はぁ……はぁ……。\nここまで来れば、安全でしょうか？:

m920176.いえ、休んでいる暇もあまりなく……。\n王子殿下、でよろしかったですか？\nこち: No, I don't have much time to spare……. Your Highness, the Prince, is that correct? Here is the invitation from Maless.
m920176.いえ、私は臨時の使いっぱしりなので、\nひとまず契約終了になりますね。:
No, I was only a temporary errand girl,
so my contract is effectively over.
m920176.いや、何も出場資格証を奪いあおうとは言っていないよ。\nここで奪ってしまったら、:
No, I'm not saying we're here to snatch the qualification tokens from you.
If we took them now,
we wouldn't be able to face you again in the main tournament, would we?
m920176.いやぁ、実は私もそろそろ限界で……。\n鎧って熱がすぐこもるんですよねぇ。:
Ah, well, I'm reaching my limit too…….
Armor tends to trap the heat, you know.
m920176.いわく、英雄譚とは\n巨大な怪物に挑まなければならないのだ、と。: Apparently, a true hero must face a giant monster.
m920176.うぅぅぅぅ……。\nどうして火山なんですかぁ、暑すぎますよぉ……。:
Ugh…
Why is it a volcano? It's way too hot…
m920176.うんうん、開幕直後にささっと集めたからね。\nこういうのは出だしの勢いが重要だろ:
Yep, yep, we grabbed them right after things kicked off.
Momentum is key at the start, right?
m920176.えぇ、ところでアラン、\n今までいったいどこに――:
Yes, by the way, Aran,
where have you been all this time—
m920176.えぇ、私たちももちろん、そのつもりです。\nシェミアさん、これからよろしくお願い:
Yes, and we certainly do, too.
Shemia, we look forward to working with you from here on.
m920176.えぇ、英雄王はもう、\n物質界では伝説上の人物になっているのよ。: Yes, the Hero King is now nothing more than a legend in the material world.
m920176.えぇと、それなら王国で暮らせばいいのでは……？\n一緒に予選を駆け抜けた仲ですし:
Uh, well, if that's the case, why don't you just live in the Kingdom?
We ran through the preliminaries together, didn't we? Right, Prince?
m920176.えっ、えぇっ！？\nそれって、王国の出場資格証あつめを\n妨害するということです:
W-What?!
You mean interfering with the Kingdom's collection of qualification certificates……?
m920176.お、お母さま、\nあれは私たちが勝利するために必要な――:
Goblin Princess Eldest Daughter: M-Mother,
that was necessary for us to secure a victory――
m920176.おだまり！\n戦神の大祭に挑むのだから、\nちゃんと女王の娘らしく振る舞いなさい:
Shut up!
We're challenging the War God's Grand Festival, so
act like proper princesses of the queen!
m920176.おだまり！ さぁ撤退するわよぉ！: Shut up! Now then, let's retreat!
m920176.おっと、いいのかい？\n――不意打ちでザクッと斬ったりしない？:
Oh, really?
—You're not going to try a sneak attack and slice me up, are you?
m920176.おっと、申し遅れた。\nわたしはシャジャル、砂漠の国より\n戦神マレスが大祭に参:
Oh, my apologies for the late introduction.
I am Shajar, a participant in the preliminaries
for the Grand Festival hosted by the War God Mares,
from a desert nation.
m920176.お姉さま、ここで招待状を奪えなくても、\n出場資格証を先んじて奪えば良いだけです:
Sister, even if we can't steal the invitation here,
we can just grab the qualification certificates first!
m920176.お姉ちゃんが大好き過ぎて威嚇しているだけかと……？:
I imagine she's just intimidating them
because she loves her sister so much…?
m920176.こいつは戦神マレス主催の祭りなんだろ？\n戦士にとっちゃ、これ以上ないほどの\n:
This is a festival hosted by the War God Maris, right?
For a warrior, it's the perfect chance
to make a name for themselves.
m920176.こういう、芯の通った強者に挑まれた時、\n王国の王子ってヤツは、\n受けて立たね:
When a man of such unwavering strength challenges him,
the Prince of the Kingdom
is the sort of man who simply cannot refuse to stand and fight.
m920176.こうした環境でも戦える戦士であることを、\n実力で証明せよ、ということかと思いま:
I suppose it's a way of demanding that we prove,
by our own strength, that we can fight in conditions like these.
m920176.この地に放たれし出場資格証の守護者は、\nあそこに見える巨大マグマジロです。:
The guardian of the qualification tokens released in this place
is the giant Magmajiro you can see over there.
m920176.この子はアラン、私の妹よ。\nどうやら亜神にも、招待状は送られていたみたいね。:
This is Aran, my sister.
It seems the Demi-gods received invitations too.
m920176.これが出場資格証、かな。\n……若干溶けかかっているけど、まぁよし！:
This must be the qualification certificate.
……It's a bit melted, but it should be fine!
m920176.これくらいの暑さがなんだ。\n騎士たる者、いかなる時でも平常心を――:
A little heat is nothing.
A knight must maintain composure at all times—
m920176.これだけ集めておけば、\n出場資格としては十分なはずです。:
With this many, we should have more than enough
to qualify for the main event.
m920176.これは本戦が楽しみだ、\nと言いたいところなのだけれど――:
I'd like to say I'm looking forward
to the main tournament, but—
m920176.ご、ごめんなさい王子！\n余計に怒らせちゃったみたい……！:
I-I'm sorry, Prince!
Looks like I made her even angrier…!
m920176.さぁファルア、わたしたちは他のチームの味見に行こうか。\nまだまだ楽しそうな選手:
Come, Falua. Let's go sample the other teams.
There are still so many promising competitors out there.
m920176.さぁ王子、出場資格証を渡してもらうわよぉ！\nゴブリン博士、飛行くぐつ隊を出しな:
Now then, Prince, hand over those qualification tokens!
Goblin Doctor, send out the Flying Craf Team!!
m920176.さぁ王子、覚悟はいいかしらぁ？\n出場資格証を賭けて勝負よぉ！！:
Well then, Prince, are you ready?
Let's settle this for the qualification certificate!!
m920176.さぁ王子ヨ！ 次の戦場へ向かうがヨイ！！: C-Come on, Prince! Let's head to the next battlefield!!
m920176.さて、王子殿下。\n次の予選会場は砂漠の国です。\n準備が終わり次第移動いたしま: Now then, Your Highness. The next qualifying venue is the Desert Kingdom. Let's depart as soon as we're ready.
m920176.しかしそれゆえに、\n王子殿下と剣を交えてみたいという、\n腕に覚えのある戦士た:
And for that very reason,
many skilled warriors who wish to cross swords
with Your Highness will surely gather.
m920176.しません！ 私を何だと思っているのですか！: I wouldn't! What do you take me for?
m920176.そう、そもそも最初に届く招待状がなければ、\n予選に参加することすらできないので:
That's right. Without the invitation that arrives first,
we can't even participate in the preliminaries, can we?
m920176.そういうわけなので、\nどうか全力で、ゴブリン軍団と相対してください。:
That's why, please give it your all
against the Goblin Army.
m920176.そういう戦士への気遣いだけは\nちゃんとできているのよね……。: At least they show proper consideration for the warriors in that regard…….
m920176.そうです、油断しちゃだめですよ？\nこういう時は慎重に、一歩一歩です！:
That's right. You can't be careless.
In situations like this, we need to proceed cautiously, one step at a time!
m920176.そうです姉様！ まだ姉様の魅力を伝えきっていません！: That's right, Sister! We haven't fully conveyed your charm yet!
m920176.そうは言っても、長時間ここに\nとどまっていたら身体を壊してしまいます。\n短期:
Even so, staying here for too long
will ruin our health.
Let's end this quickly and retrieve the qualification tokens.
m920176.そして、面倒事を押し付けてきたマレス様を、\n一発がつんとぶん殴ってやりましょう:
And let us give Males, who pushed all this trouble onto us,
a good, solid blow to the head!
m920176.そのために、物質界各地にばらまかれた、\n出場資格証を集めるのですよね。\nお姉: That's why we're here to collect the qualification certificates scattered across the material world. Let's do our best, sisters!
m920176.その中に、堕天したお前もいたんだろ？\n思い出してきたぜ、人類を愛してしまったの:
So you were one of them, too, huh?
I'm starting to remember. There was an angel who said she'd fallen
because she'd fallen in love with humanity.
m920176.それにしても、さっきは\n娘たちが迷惑をかけてしまったようね。: That said, it seems my daughters caused a bit of trouble earlier.
m920176.それに乗る武人たちもそうです！\nそんなに戦いたいなら、\n天界との戦いに参じれ:
Silver Moon Demi-god? : And the warriors who took part in it!
If they're so eager to fight,
they should join the war against the heavens!
m920176.それは格別にすぎる慈悲だなぁ。\nいやぁ、本音を言えばもう少し生きたかったけど、:
??? : What a generous offer.
Honestly, I'd have liked to live a little longer,
but dying at the hands of the Silver Moon Demi-god is quite the honor.
m920176.そんなことになったら……。\nマレス様が不機嫌になるところが目に浮かぶようです。:
If that were to happen…….
I can already picture Lord Maris getting upset.
m920176.そんなに怖がらなくても。\n気絶させただけだというのに。:
There's no need to be so frightened.
I only knocked them out, after all.
m920176.ただ本戦の前に、\n味見をしておこうと思っただけだというのに、ね？:
I merely intended to have a taste
before the main tournament, that's all, you see?
--- scene: The Proud Desert Sisters ---
m920176.ちぃっ、タイミングの悪い！\nゴブリン軍団、やーっておしまい！:
Tch, what bad timing!
Goblin Legion, let's wrap this up!
m920176.で、こちらは妹のファルア。\nえぇと、貴公が噂に名高い王子かな？:
And this is my sister, Falua.
Um, could you be the famous Prince?
m920176.で、どうなんだい？\n何か戦士として、\n正当な理由あって闇討ちを仕掛けようとし:
So, what is it?
Did you have some legitimate reason,
as warriors, to launch an ambush in the dark?
m920176.では、この戦いに意味はないのでは――: In that case, this battle would be meaningless――
m920176.では、最期にもう一発、\n反撃の機会をくれると嬉しいな――っとぉ！？:
??? : Then, as a parting gift,
I'd appreciate one more chance to strike back—?!
m920176.とはいえ、決定権は王子にあります。\n王子が戦うことを望まないなら――: Still, the decision rests with the Prince. If he has no desire to fight――
m920176.ともあれ、これで火山から出られるな。\n……正直、そろそろ溶けてしまいそうで。:
In any case, we can finally get out of this volcano.
……Honestly, I'm starting to feel like I'm going to melt.
m920176.どうやら、先客のようですね。\nというかこのまま放置すると、\nあちらの戦士が照:
It appears we have some company.
In fact, if we leave them be,
that warrior might get accidentally killed by her own fluster.
m920176.どう考えても無断でしょう。\n先程から、砂漠の空気が\nざわついているような気も:
It's certainly unauthorized.
Lately, the air in the desert has been feeling rather tense.
m920176.どこまでも勝利に貪欲な……。\nちっ、あの男を思い出しますね。\n本当に虫唾が走:
Silver Moon Demi-god? : You are insatiably hungry for victory…
Tch. You remind me of that man.
It truly makes my skin crawl…
m920176.な、なんでもありません！\nさぁ、ピラミッドの奥へ向かいますよ！: N-nothing! Come on, let's head deeper into the pyramid!
m920176.なっ……誰が優しいと……！？\nあぁもうっ、そのにまにました笑い方をやめなさい！:
Silver Moon Demi-god? : W-Who said I was kind?!
Oh, for heaven's sake, stop that smug grin!
This time, I'll truly finish you off!
m920176.なっ、何者ですのっ！？\n邪魔をするならあなたたちも……！:
What—who are you?!
If you try to interfere, you'll be just as…!
m920176.なので、予選とは魔物を退治し、\n出場資格証をかき集める戦いとなります。: So, the preliminaries consist of defeating these monsters to collect the qualification certificates.
m920176.なるほど、一理ある。\nとはいえ彼女らにも、\n何か事情があるかもしれないだろう:
I see, that's a fair point.
Still, perhaps they have
some extenuating circumstances?
m920176.なるほど、一理どころか全理ある。\n伝説の戦士が、巨大な怪物に挑まなければ嘘だか: I see. That's not just reasonable; it's the only logical conclusion! A legendary warrior who doesn't face a giant monster would be a fraud, after all!
m920176.はぁ……では、どうあがいても、\n戦神コロッセウムには、巻き込まれるしかなかった:
Haa… So no matter what we did,
we had no choice but to be dragged into the War God Colosseum.
m920176.はぁ？ 何を言っているの？\n優勝への最短コースが分かってないのかしら！:
Hah? What are you talking about?
Don't you understand the shortest path to victory?
m920176.はい、シャジャル姉様！\n姉様の魅力と実力、思い知らせてやりましょう！:
Yes, Sister Shajar!
Let's show them the full extent of your charm and skill!
m920176.はい、トラム様はよくご存知ですよね……。\nとはいえ、マレス様は勇気ある者には\: Yes, you know that well, Tram. That said, Maless is a deity who ensures that those with courage receive their rewards.
m920176.はい、出場資格証は、\nマレス様が各地に放った\n巨大化した魔物によって守られて: Yes. The qualification certificates are guarded by giant monsters that Lord Maless has unleashed across the land.
m920176.ははぁっ！！\n我ラがゴブリン軍団の誇ル最精鋭ノ飛行部隊！\n王子ヨ！ ソノ力を:
Hahaha!!
The pride of our Goblin Army, the finest flying unit!
Prince! Behold our might!!
m920176.ひっ……確かにそうですねぇ……。\n王子さま、慎重に、慎重に戦いましょー！:
Eep…… you're right, I suppose…….
Prince, let's fight carefully, very carefully!
m920176.ふふ、いやいや、\n物質界のために日々戦っている、\n王国軍の戦力をあまり消費さ:
Hehe, no, no.
We shouldn't wear down the military strength of the Kingdom
too much, should we? They have daily battles to fight for the Material World.
m920176.ふふっ、ご明察。\nとはいえ戦闘狂とは人聞きが悪いな。:
Heh, well spotted.
Though "battle maniac" is a rather harsh term.
m920176.ふんっ、きょ、教師がいいんだよ、教師が。\nそれより王子、戦闘態勢を解くなよ！\:
Hmph, it's just that my teacher is a good one, that's all. My teacher is.
Anyway, Prince, don't drop your combat stance!
We don't know where the enemies will come from—
m920176.ふんっ、そんな強気でいられるのも今のうちだけ。\nこんな僻地に助けなんて来な――:
Hmph. You can act tough for now,
but no help is coming to a backwater like this――
m920176.ま、まさか……招待状を配達する、\n天使さんを襲うということ――もごっ、もごごっ:
N-No way…… You're going to attack the angel
delivering the invitations――mmp, mmmph!?
m920176.まぁまぁ。\nところで王子、貴公の戦いぶり、\n実に見事だったというほかない。:
Now, now.
By the way, Prince, your performance in battle
was truly magnificent, I must say.
m920176.まさか、あの岩の塊のことですか！？\nあんなのが動き出したら手がつけられませんよ:
You can't mean that pile of rocks, can you!?
If that thing starts moving, we won't be able to handle it!
m920176.まさか、マレス様からの\nこの招待状を狙って……？:
Could it be…… they're after this invitation
from Lord Maless……?
m920176.まずはこの洞窟に放たれた、\n巨大スライムとの戦いですね。: To start, we must battle the giant slime that was released in this cave.
m920176.まったくそのとおりで。\n他の神に仕えていた上に、堕天した私を、\n昔のよしみで: You're absolutely right. On top of serving other gods, she summoned me as her errand girl just because of our old acquaintance.
m920176.め、メカゴブリンクイーン様！\nサァ、次の魔物を倒しにいきますゾ！:
M-Mecha Goblin Queen-sama!
S-Shall we go defeat the next monster!
m920176.もちろんですわ！\n千年に一度の戦神コロッセウム、\nゴブリン軍団がその優勝をか: Of course we do! It's the once-in-a-millennium War God Colosseum, and our Goblin Legion is going to snatch that victory!
m920176.やれやれ、これは本戦もたっぷり楽しめそうだ。\nそれじゃあ命の恩人たる王国軍諸君:
Oh, well. Looks like I'll have plenty of fun in the main event.
Well then, my saviors, the Royal Army—
see you in the main event at the War God Colosseum!
m920176.よし、動き出す前に魔法でぶん殴る！ これだな！\n王子、戦闘指揮は任せたぜ！:
Alright, let's smash it with magic before it even moves! Here goes!
Prince, I leave the battle command to you!
m920176.よしよし、全員同意の上と。\nそれじゃあ予選最後の\nエキシビジョンマッチという:
Alright, alright, unanimous consent.
Then, let's call this the final
exhibition match of the preliminaries――
m920176.わ、私はそんなに酷くないわよね？\n大丈夫よね？ ねっ？:
W-Well, I'm not that bad, am I?
I'm fine, right? Right?
m920176.わぁぁぁっ！？ 待った！ まじで待って！\n照れ隠しの威力が尋常じゃないんだけど:
??? : Waaah?! Hold on! Seriously, hold on!
Your flustered attacks are lethal!
m920176.ん、シェミアはどうするんだ？\nマレスの所へ戻るのか？:
Hm, what about you, Shemia?
Are you heading back to Males?
m920176.アラン、あなたもどうせ、\n勝手に招待状渡されて、そのまま神殿に\n出場資格証付:
Aran, you probably had an invitation handed to you too, and then
monsters with entry passes were sent to the temple
without your consent, right?
m920176.アランの力は、時が経つほど増幅していくわ。\n短期決戦で片付けないと大変なことに: Aran's power only grows with time. If we don't end this quickly, it'll get out of hand!
m920176.ウフッ、いいえ、いいえ。\nお礼なんて必要ないわよぉ……？:
Heh, no, no.
There's no need for thanks……?
m920176.ウフフ……やはり王子は只者じゃないわねぇ。\nますます欲しくなってしまうわぁ。:
Uhuhu……I knew the Prince was no ordinary opponent.
I want him even more now.
m920176.ウフフッ、さすがは王子ねぇ！\nこの距離から気づかれるなんて！:
Uhuhu, just as I expected of the Prince!
To spot me from this distance!
m920176.ウフフッ、口が悪いわよ三女。\nさぁ、王子たちの招待状を拝借しにいくわよぉ！:
Hehehe, watch your mouth, Third Daughter.
Now then, let's go borrow the Prince's invitation!
m920176.オーッホッホッホォ！ そのとおりよぉ！\nさぁ堕天使ちゃん、その招待状を渡しなさ:
Ohoho! That's exactly it!
Now then, fallen angel, hand over that invitation♪
m920176.キィィっ！ さすがは王国軍、やるわねぇ！: Kyaa! As expected of the Kingdom's army, you're tough!
m920176.ココデ足踏みしていてハ、\n出場資格証ヲ集められませんからナ！！:
I-If we keep stalling here,
we won't be able to collect the qualification certificates!!
m920176.ゴブリン軍団、どうやら本気のようですね。\n王子殿下、出場資格証が奪われたら、\:
The Goblin Army seems to be in earnest.
Your Highness, if they take the qualification tokens,
we won't be able to participate in the main event.
m920176.シェミア、今後も王国と関わっていくのなら、\nひとつ覚えておくといい。:
Shemia, if you intend to keep working with the Kingdom,
there's one thing you should keep in mind.
m920176.トラム様も、極めて変わり者だと\nかつての我が主より聞いています。: I have also heard from my former master that Lord Tram is an extreme eccentric.
m920176.ノンノン、美しき私たちはぁ、\nもう一歩手前から着手すべきだと思うのよぉ♪:
No, no, no. We, the beautiful ones,
believe we should strike one step earlier♪
m920176.マレス様、砂漠の神々には\nちゃんと許可を取っているのでしょうか……。: Does Maless have the proper permission from the desert deities……?
m920176.マレス様が興味を示すような方々ですから、\nおそらく今回遭遇したチーム以上に、\:
They are the kind of people who catch Males's interest,
so I imagine this group will be even more
full of individuality than the teams you've faced so far.
m920176.マレス様としても、王子殿下には\n何が何でも出場してほしいと思っているはずですし:
I'm sure Lord Maris also wants
His Highness to participate, no matter what.
m920176.マレス様の厚意で天使の真似事をしていましたが、\n実際には堕天使ですから、\nひ:
I was just playing the part of an angel
out of Males's kindness, but in truth, I am a fallen angel,
so I was thinking of settling down somewhere quietly――
m920176.マレス様は戦士の守護者を自任していますから、\n戦士以外は他の誰かに任せていると: Since Lord Maless considers himself the guardian of warriors, you could say he leaves everyone else to be handled by someone else.
m920176.メカゴブリンクイーン！\nそれは手間を掛けさせてしまいましたね。\n後でお礼をさ:
Mecha Goblin Queen!
I'm sorry to have put you to such trouble.
Please let me thank you properly later—
m920176.予選は、戦う力を持たない者を\n本戦に進ませないためのものですからね。: The preliminaries are designed to ensure that those without the strength to fight do not advance to the main event.

and keep up your daily training.

Melt――Hot?!
Cornelia, your armor is burning up!

Monster hunting is right up Prince's alley, isn't it?

hmm? Mmm……?

Lady Anatolia! Our eternal champion…!!

Yes. In my stead,

A former enemy—though I suppose we're still enemies.
We've crossed blades before, but
let us join forces for now, Prince.
m920183.くぅぅっ……はぁ……。\nあたしひとりじゃ、全然力が足りないのね……。:
Ugh…
I guess I really am not strong enough on my own…
m920183.くだらナイ……。\n兵タチよ、ここは退くぞ。\nディアス様のタメ、次ナル戦場へ向:
Nonsense…….
Soldiers, we retreat.
For the sake of Lord Dias, we move to the next battlefield.
m920183.この先の、ダークエルフの集落というと……。: The Dark Elf settlement ahead, you say…
m920183.この先のダークエルフの集落も、\n戦闘に入ってからは連絡が取れていない状況だ。:
As for the Dark Elf settlement ahead,
we've lost contact with them since the fighting started.
m920183.こらっ、飛び込もうとしないっ！！\nあなたひとりで行ったら殺されて終わりですよ！:
Don't you dare jump in!
If you go alone, you'll just get yourself killed!
m920183.これほどの軍勢を派遣するとは、\n亜神ディアスは、いったい何を企んでいるのでしょ:
To dispatch such a massive army……
What is the sub-god Dias really planning?
m920183.さぁ、王国の助力があるとなれば、\nもはや負ける要素は見つからぬ。\n王子よ、我:
Now then, with the Kingdom's help on our side,
there is no longer any chance of defeat.
Prince, let us show those angels just how strong our bond truly is.
m920183.さぁ、逃げるといい。\nここはワシが引き受けよう。\n未来の大商人、グレーターデ:
Now then, run along.
I'll handle this place.
I, the future great merchant, Greater Demon.
m920183.さぁ王子よ、先へ進むといい。\nワシは負傷者に恩を売る仕事があるからねぇ。:
Now then, Prince, you go ahead.
I have some goodwill to build with the wounded.
m920183.しかし……こんな時、デーモンシェフや王子ならば、\nどのように稼ぐ機会を掴むのか:
But then again…… in times like these, how would a Demon Chef or the Prince
seize an opportunity to make a profit……?
m920183.しかし、主の計画に狂いはありません。\nここで王国軍を殲滅します。:
However, there is no flaw in the Master's plan.

We shall annihilate the Kingdom's army right here.
m920183.しかし、幸いなことに、\nこの辺りは魔界の瘴気が比較的薄くなっています。\n一気:
However, fortunately,
the miasma of the Demon Realm is relatively thin in this area.
Let's sweep them away in one go!
m920183.すでにいくつかの集落は陥落してる。\nお嬢の指揮のもと、ダークエルフ、オークの助: They just linked a teleportation gate straight to the Demon Realm.
m920183.せめて、その到着の前に、\n最大にして最小の抵抗戦力たるあなたを、\nここで滅ぼ:
At the very least, before they arrive,

I shall destroy you here,

you who are both the greatest and the smallest of our resistance.
m920183.そうよ、ふたりでつるんで遊んでた頃の話。\nこの魔界の森にも来たことあったわよね:
That's right. The days when we were always hanging out together.
We even came to this forest in the Demon Realm, didn't we?
m920183.そう簡単に撃退されては困るのでな。\n何しろ、こちらは亜神ディアスの戦力を預かっ:
I cannot afford to be repelled so easily.
After all, I am entrusted with the Lesser God Dias's forces.
m920183.そしてヤハールよ、さすがは古き亜神の眷属だ。\n天界の軍勢による包囲を切り抜け、:
And Yahar, as befits a retainer of the ancient sub-gods,
you broke through the angelic encirclement
and successfully delivered the Kingdom's request for reinforcements.
m920183.そのお嬢のことよ。\n魔王軍がめちゃくちゃにしていった魔界を、\nようやく復興し: But we can't keep up this pace against the sheer numbers of the Angels……
m920183.それから、伝承どおりの\n触れた者を動けなくする力も健在のようです！\n接近戦は:
And, as the legends say,
her power to paralyze those she touches is still intact!
Getting close is dangerous!
m920183.それが破られるまでに、\nこちらも態勢を整えなければなりません。:
Before that seal is broken,
we must have our forces in order.
m920183.それに、私たちの王子は、\n困ったことに、困っている人を見捨てられない方なので…: ……Yahar, the man nodding along in front of you is the Prince in question.
m920183.それは残念でしたね。\n魔神ベルゼビュートに封じられていた時ならともかく、\n私:
How regrettable.

If I were still sealed by the Demon Lord Beelzebuth, perhaps.

But now that I have awakened, I cannot stand by and watch such barbarity.
m920183.それをどうにかしようと、\n何度も肉体を滅ぼしながらあれこれ画策していたのが、\:
In an effort to reverse that,
she repeatedly destroyed her own body while scheming all sorts of things.
That big-headed one is Yahar.
m920183.たかが魔物の集落ひとつ、\n一国が軍を動かすとでも思うのか？:
Heavenly Spear Cavalry Captain: For a mere monster settlement,

do you think a whole nation would move its army?
m920183.だから、お願い。\n一緒にロタンと、魔界を守ってほしいの。:
So, please.
Help me protect Lotan and the Demon Realm.
m920183.だから一言余計なのよ！: So don't say things like that!
m920183.だが、だからといって\n我らの領土を侵させるわけにはいかない。\n――ネヴィン、:
But that doesn't mean
we'll let them invade our territory.
—Nevin, the next wave of angels is coming!
m920183.ちぃっ……何だこのメチャクチャな戦場は。\n天界は兵を使い捨てだと思ってんのか？:
Tch… What kind of chaotic battlefield is this?
Does the Heavens think they can use their soldiers as disposable?
m920183.ちっ……もう追いついてきたの！？: Besides, our Prince has a tendency to be unable to turn a blind eye to those in need……
m920183.では、一度アスバール様の城館へ戻りましょう。\nロタンの救援に行くにも、天界の軍:
Then, let's return to Lord Asval's castle for now.
Whether we're rescuing Lotan or stopping the Heavenly Host,
we'll need information and a plan.
m920183.では、負傷者の治療と補給が終わり次第、\n全軍で魔王城へ向かいましょう。\n王子:
Then, once the wounded are treated and supplies are secured,
we shall march on the Demon King's Castle with our entire army.
Prince, please take a moment to rest as well.
m920183.でも、最後の瞬間まで、\n絶対に諦めてなんかやらないから……！！: Hurry up and get ready, okay?
m920183.ともあれ、今はロタンが魔王城を封印し、\nその維持を続けてくれています。:
In any case, Lotan has sealed the castle for now
and is maintaining that seal.
m920183.ともかく、このままじゃ魔界は陥落しちゃう。\nだからあたしは、魔王ガリウスを倒し: Hmm…… the young lady leading the defense, is that the one from Yahar's place?
m920183.どうして親友に嫌味を言わないといけないのよ！: Why would I be sarcastic to my best friend!
m920183.どうやら、既に助けに行くつもりでいるようですね。: Hey, so the "Royal Army" you're with…… that's the army of that Prince, right……?
m920183.なぜ魔界マーケットに天界兵が――ぐわぁぁぁぁッ！？: Why are angels at the Demon Realm market—Gwaaahh?!
m920183.なっ……貴様は王国軍の……！？: W-What?! You're with the Royal Army…!?
m920183.ならば、もうここで戦う必要もあるまい。\n全軍、次元の回廊を抜け、撤退するのだ。:
Then there is no need to continue fighting here.
All units, retreat through the dimensional corridor.
m920183.なるほど……。\nそれでは、どちらにせよ王国の戦力で、\nディアス率いる天界の軍:
I see…
In that case, we will need to face the Heavenly Host led by Dias
with the full might of the Kingdom, either way.
m920183.ねっ、それだけのことでしょ？\nそんな些細なことで、\nあたしたちの友情にヒビは:
See? It's that simple.
A trivial matter like that isn't going to crack
the bond of our friendship!
m920183.はぁ……本物に会うまで、本当に人間がベルゼビュートを\n倒したなんて信じられなか:
Haa… Until I met the real thing, I really couldn't believe
a human had defeated Beelzebub…
m920183.はぁっ、はぁっ……待って……ふぅ……。\n魔力の……乱れの発生源……やはり、\n:
Haa, haa……wait……phew…….

The source of the……magical disturbance……it was indeed

emanating from the gate here…….
m920183.ははっ、強がるな。\n顔に心配でたまらないと書いてあるぞ。:
Haha, don't put on a brave face.
Your face is practically screaming "I'm worried."
m920183.はははっ、言葉を選ばずとも良い。\nお前たちの関係はよく知っているからな。:
Hahaha, you don't need to hold back.
I know the nature of your relationship well enough.
m920183.ふぅ、討伐完了ね！\nそれにしても、王国軍って軍隊よね……？\n虫の討伐、ずいぶ:
Phew, mission accomplished!

By the way, the Kingdom's army is a proper military force, right…?

They seemed pretty used to exterminating bugs.
m920183.ふふ、やっぱり頭でっかちで石頭のヤハールですね。\n姿が変わっても、その強情さは:
Heh, you're still as headstrong and stubborn as ever, Yahar.
Even with your appearance changed, that stubbornness remains.
m920183.ふふん、デーモンの本体は精神体だもの。\nどれだけ肉体が滅び、生まれ変わったとし:
Hehe, a demon's true form is a spirit.
No matter how many times the body is destroyed and reborn,
the way of the soul that cannot be compromised never changes!
m920183.ふんっ、自信過剰すぎよ！\nあなたは魔王につくべきだと思ったから仲間になった。\:
Hmph! You're too full of yourself!
I joined the army because I believed you should serve the Demon King.
I didn't share that view, so I stayed behind.
m920183.ま、待って、あたしも手伝うわ！\nお嬢、いいわよね！？:
W-wait, I'm coming too!
Miss, that's okay, right!?
m920183.まさか、ワシが改心したとでも思っているのかな？\nこれもすべて、未来の稼ぎのため:
Don't get the wrong idea, thinking I've suddenly turned over a new leaf.
This is all for future profits, after all.
m920183.まさかあの竜人、我らと王国軍を衝突させるために、\nこんな誘導の仕方をしたという:
Could it be that Dragonkin deliberately set this trap
to force a clash between us and the Kingdom?
m920183.もういい。\nならば、その暑苦しい信念と共に散るが――:
Heavenly Spear Cavalry Captain: Enough.

Then, perish along with that suffocating conviction――
m920183.もしかしてヤハール？\n頭でっかちのヤハールですか？:
Could it be Yahar?

That big-headed Yahar?
m920183.やれやれ……。\nまさか、また魔界が戦場になるなんてな。:
Oh, bother…
To think the Demon Realm would become a battlefield again.
m920183.やれやれ……ようやく一休み、か。\n捨て身の連中を相手取るのは疲れるな。:
Well, well…… finally a moment to catch our breath.
Dealing with those suicide-charge types is exhausting.
m920183.ん……指揮を取ってるお嬢とは、\nヤハールのところのお嬢様のことですか？: Under the young lady's command, with help from the Dark Elves and Orcs, we've managed to hold the key strongholds…… for now.
m920183.アスバール様、お久しぶりです。\n……復活されていたのですね。:
Asbaal, it has been a long time.
…So you have been resurrected.
m920183.アスバール様は、魔神ベルゼビュートに力を奪われて、\nずっと封印されていたのよ。:
Asbaal had her power stripped away by the Demon Lord Beelzebub
and was sealed away for a long time.
m920183.アンブレ、ここは戦場だぞ。\n堅苦しい挨拶は勝利の後とするがいい。:
Umbre, this is a battlefield.
Save the formalities for after we've won.
m920183.ガード様、竜人の姫の行方が判明しました。: My Lord Guard, we have located the Dragonkin princess.
m920183.ソーマにモーティマ……！\nアンタらが来てくれるとはな。:
Soma and Mortimer…!
I didn't expect you two to show up.
m920183.ダークエルフ、オークは捨て置きましょう。\n街道の封鎖を急ぎなさい。:
Leave the Dark Elves and Orcs for now.
Hurry and seal off the roads.
m920183.ドロテアさんの統治する地域ですね。\n彼女ならば、きっと無事だとは思いますが……:
That's the territory under Dorothea's rule.
She's likely safe, but…
m920183.ドロテア様……！\n御身の剣がひとつ、只今帰還を――:
Dorothea-sama……!
Your sword has just returned to your side—
m920183.ドロテア陛下こそ、その戦いぶり、\nお嬢――こほん、我が主君もお喜びになるはずよ:
Your Majesty, Dorothea, your fighting spirit is truly impressive.
My lady—ahem, my master—would surely be pleased.
m920183.ハルモニアに言われたくないわね！\n――で、頭でっかちで石頭で甘やかし魔のハルモ:
Don't tell me that, Harmonia!
――So, headstrong, stubborn, and doting Harmonia,
have you noticed their presence?
m920183.フゥ……魔界マーケットがめちゃくちゃだ。\n賠償金請求は亜神ディアス宛てかな？:
Phew…… the Demon Realm market is in shambles.
Should I send the compensation claim to the Gorgon, Dias?
m920183.フシュシュ……弱い……なんと弱イ……。\n魔界の民トハこんなモノか……。:
Fushushu…… Weak…… How utterly weak…….
Is this all the Demon Realm folk are good for……?
m920183.フシュシュ……！\nナゼだ、ナゼデーモンと王国が手を取り合ウ……。:
Fushushu……!
Why, why are the demons and the Kingdom joining hands……?
m920183.フム……まさかこんな所で、\n王子と遭遇することになるとはねぇ。: Hmm…… I never imagined I'd run into you here, Prince.
m920183.フム……騒がしいねぇ……。\n仕入れを邪魔するとは、不届き者がいたものだ。:
Hmm…… so noisy…….
To disrupt my procurement. There are certainly some impertinent ones around.
m920183.ヤハールにも、ロタンにも、\n命を賭けさせてしまって……。\n私は、悪い主人です:
To Yahar, to Rotan,
I have put their lives on the line…
I am a terrible master.
m920183.ヤハールも無事でなにより――むぎゅっ！？\nこ、こらっ！ 人前ですよ！:
Yahar, I'm so glad you're alright too—Mmph!?
N-no! Not in front of everyone!
m920183.ヤハール殿が援軍を連れてくる！\n王子なら、あの男なら必ず駆けつけてくれる！！:
Lord Yahar is coming with reinforcements!

If it's the Prince, that man will surely come to our aid!!
m920183.一人より二人、二人より軍ですよ。\n仲間がきっと、あなたに力を貸してくれます。:
Two are better than one, and an army is better than two.
Your comrades will surely lend you their strength.
m920183.些細なことだ。\nさて、せめてディアスとの契約分は働くとしよう。:
A trivial matter.

Very well, I shall at least fulfill my contract with Dias.
m920183.亜神アスバール……。\nあなたが抵抗しなければ、\nもう少し苦労の度合いも少なく:
Demigod Asbaal…

Had you not resisted,

our troubles would have been considerably less.
m920183.仲間って、だってロタンは行方がわからな――: Comrades? But Lotan's whereabouts are still unknown――
m920183.企業買収のためにも資金は不可欠。\nここはひとつ、魔界との貿易をより強固にするの:
Capital is essential for corporate acquisitions.
Perhaps it's time we strengthened our trade ties with the Demon Realm—
m920183.助けると決めたのに、\n途中で投げ出すような人に見えますか？\n王子のお人好しっ:
I've already decided to help.
Does that look like someone who would give up halfway?
The Prince's good nature has become a legend by now.
m920183.商機は――そう、己の利益を捨てた先にある。\n小さな稼ぎではなく、大きな稼ぎのた:
Opportunity lies—yes, in abandoning one's immediate gain.
Not small profits, but investing for the big one is surely
the shortcut to becoming a great merchant of the future, isn't it?
m920183.天界による襲撃であれば、\n我々が対応しない理由がありません。: I'll do anything if it's within my power!
m920183.天界の軍勢、ここで削らせてもらうわよ！: Heavenly Host, I'm going to whittle you down right here!
m920183.女王陛下は？ ご無事なのか？: And the Queen? Is she safe?
m920183.対策なしに、普段の力を発揮するのは難しいでしょう。\n王子、各部隊の配置には細心:
It would be difficult to exert your full power without any countermeasures.
Prince, please pay close attention to the positioning of each unit!
m920183.我々は王国軍です。\n樹海の奥にて検出された、異常な魔力の揺らぎを\n調査するた:
We are of the Kingdom's army.

We came this far to investigate an abnormal fluctuation in magical energy

detected deep within the Forest of Trees…….
m920183.我が姉妹を滅ぼしタ、憎き王子と相まみえルトハ……。\nココデ、その息の根止めテや:
To face the detestable Prince who destroyed my sister…….
I shall end your life right here……!!
m920183.我らは諦めぬ！\n貴様ら天槍騎兵団を、決してお嬢の所へは向かわせない！:
We will not give up!

We will not let you Heavenly Spear Cavalry reach the young lady!
m920183.戦闘は久々だが――少し踊ってもらうとしよう。:
It has been a while since I fought—
but I suppose I shall dance a little.
m920183.所詮は竜人と侮った、こちらの落ち度だな。\n早々に撤退し、魔王城の封印解除の術式:
We underestimated the Dragonkin. That was our mistake.
We should retreat immediately and break the seal on the Demon King's Castle—
m920183.撤退せよ。\n魔界など、我らの住まう場所ではない。:
Retreat.

The Demon Realm is not a place for us to dwell.
m920183.敵が天界の軍勢である以上、安心はできませんね。\n王子、このままダークエルフの集:
As long as the enemy is the Heavenly Host, we can't be at ease.
Prince, let's advance to the Dark Elf settlement!
m920183.昔って、いったいどれだけ前の話ですか。\nまさかその身体になる前の話では？:
Memories? How far back are we talking?
You don't mean before you took on this form, do you?
m920183.時間がない、と言った理由がそれです。\nどうやら亜神ディアスは、\n魔王城にて何:
That is why I said we have no time.
It seems the Lesser God Dias
intends to perform some kind of ritual in the Demon King's Castle.
m920183.未来の利益のためには、\nまずは投資が必要だとようやく気付いてねぇ。:
I've finally realized that investment is necessary
for future profits.
m920183.正々堂々と戦う素振りを見せ、\nその上で魔界の深層まで我々を移動させた、のか。:
Showing no sign of fighting fairly,
only to teleport us to the depths of the Demon Realm.
m920183.正直に言って分が悪い。\n天使どもがうようよ湧いてくるからなァ。:
To be honest, the odds are against us.
Those angels keep swarming out of nowhere.
m920183.残酷なる魔神、ベルゼビュート。\nその表裏とも、零れ落ちた善性とも称される亜神。:
The cruel Demon Lord, Beelzebuth.

And the Demigod, called the overflow of his hidden benevolence.

Your existence was the only miscalculation.
m920183.消耗を怖れぬあの戦いぶり……。\nおよそ生命体とは思えぬ蛮勇だな。:
That reckless fighting, fearing no exhaustion…
It's a brute's courage that defies the nature of any living thing.
m920183.物質界より落下してきた魔王城跡に、\nレヴィアタンそのものに……。\nまったく、:
The ruins of the Demon King's castle that fell from the Material World,
Leviathan himself……
I can't even begin to guess……
m920183.王国の連中に聞いた話じゃ、\n亜神ディアスは天使を操る装置を持っているらしい。\:
I heard from the Royal Army that
the sub-god Dias possesses a device to control angels.
…Pitiful lot, those angels are.
m920183.王国軍が魔界スコーピオン如きに屈するはずがなかろう。\nさぁ王子よ、助けを求める:
The Kingdom's army will not bow to mere Demon Realm Scorpions.
Come, Prince. Let us run to the aid of those who call for help.
m920183.王国騎兵部隊、ただいま到着です！\nフローガさーん！ 予想がぴったり的中ですよー:
The Kingdom's cavalry unit has arrived!

Floga-san! You were spot on, just as you predicted!
m920183.王子、ここはグレーターデーモンに任せましょう。\n少々不安ではありますが……。:
Prince, let's leave this to the Greater Demon.
I'm a little uneasy, but...
m920183.王子、どれだけ力になれるか\n分からないけど、あたし頑張るから。:
Prince, I don't know how much I can help,
but I'll do my best!
m920183.王子、ギガエルは周囲の魚人に\n力を与える権能を持っています。\n兵たちには慎重:
Prince, Gigael has the ability to grant power to the surrounding Fish Men.

Please command the troops with caution!
m920183.王子、天使の部隊が来ます！\n急ぎ迎撃の指示をお願いします！:
Prince, the Angel's unit is approaching!
Please issue the order to intercept them immediately!
m920183.王子、気をつけて。\nゴルゴーンは強力な毒を備えているわ。:
Prince, be careful.
The Gorgon wields a potent poison.
m920183.王子、気をつけろ！\n次元に穴をあけやがった、増援が出てくるぞ！:
Prince, watch out!
He's torn a hole in the dimension!
Reinforcements are coming through!
m920183.王子、魔界スコーピオンは魔界特有の虫よ。\n体力を奪うだけじゃなく、\n麻痺させ:
Prince, Demon Realm Scorpions are insects unique to this realm.
Not only do they drain vitality,
they generate a paralyzing poison within their bodies.
m920183.王子よ、この地点は我らが守り抜く。\n王国軍の武運を祈るぞッ！！:

m920183.魔王城を封じ、その手勢で我らを撹乱し、\nどうやら王国軍にまで救援を求めたようだ:
